Empirically, we show that our approach achieves near-zero loss barriers on WikiText for language models with medium-sized parameters, representing, to our knowledge, the first demonstration of near-barrier-free linear connectivity at this scale. In the vision domain, ViT-L maintains above 69\% ImageNet top-1 accuracy throughout the interpolation path, while modern billion-parameter LLMs exhibit only small loss barriers. These results suggest that properly resolving parameter symmetries enables large pretrained Transformers to be connected and merged through simple linear paths with substantially improved interpolation performance. Code: https://github.com/VILA-Lab/Dual-Learned-Matching .

</details>


### [290] [Discovering Latent Groups for Robust Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.23609)
*Ankur Garg,Ulrich Aïvodji,Samira Ebrahimi Kahou,Vincent Michalski*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出神经分类树(NCT)框架，通过树状架构编码子群结构来解决机器学习模型中的虚假相关性问题，无需子群标注即可实现鲁棒性和可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器学习模型利用虚假相关性，虽然在平均准确率上表现良好，但在欠代表性子群上表现不佳。现有方法通过网络参数调整来解决这个问题，但需要子群标注或推断的伪组标签，且在推理时无法提供样本潜在子群的洞察。

Method: 提出神经分类树(NCT)框架，将子群结构编码到树状架构中。通过基于预测正确性将每个样本路由到树的"简单"或"困难"节点，并将这些路由作为下一次迭代的伪标签重用，从而解耦冲突的子群，无需子群监督。

Result: 在涵盖二分类和多分类虚假相关性的五个基准数据集上进行评估。实验表明，学习到的树拓扑结构能够一致地隔离少数子群，在模型架构和数据潜在组结构之间提供透明的映射，同时与最先进方法相比具有竞争力的鲁棒性。

Conclusion: NCT框架成功地在不需要子群监督的情况下实现了模型鲁棒性，并通过树状架构提供了强可解释性，能够在模型结构和数据潜在组结构之间建立透明的映射关系。

Abstract: Machine learning models exploit spurious correlations, achieving high average accuracy but failing disproportionately on underrepresented subgroups. Existing methods address this by adjusting network parameters, guided either by subgroup annotations or inferred pseudo-group labels. Yet at inference, these methods produce only a class prediction, with no insight into a sample's latent subgroup. We propose neural classification trees (NCT), a framework that achieves robustness by encoding subgroup structure in its tree-shaped architecture. By routing each sample to an "easy" or "hard" node of this tree -- based on prediction correctness -- and reusing these routes as pseudo-labels for the next iteration, NCT disentangles conflicting subgroups, without requiring subgroup supervision. We evaluate NCT on five benchmarks spanning binary and multi-class spurious correlations. Our experiments show that the learned tree topology provides strong interpretability by consistently isolating minority subgroups, which provides a transparent mapping between the model architecture and the data's latent group structure, while yielding competitive robustness with state-of-the-art methods.

</details>


### [291] [DiT-Reward: Generative Representations for Text-to-Image Reward Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.23626)
*Yuanming Yang,Guoqing Ma,Bo Wang,Yuan Zhang,Wei Tang,Chenyi Li,Haoyang Huang,Nan Duan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出DiT-Reward，将预训练的文本到图像Diffusion Transformer转换为奖励模型，在多个偏好基准测试上超越HPSv3，并显著提升推理速度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索用于图像生成的表征是否也能支持生成图像的评估，研究文本到图像奖励预测作为生成表征学习的下游任务。

Method: 将预训练的文本到图像Diffusion Transformer转换为奖励模型，通过处理近似干净的图像潜在表示并聚合跨Transformer层的文本条件图像表征；在生成骨干冻结时使用轻量级学习头提取偏好预测；结合不同阶段的表征进行分析。

Result: 在相同训练数据混合下，DiT-Reward在所有四个评估偏好基准上超越HPSv3，在HPDv2上达到85.6%，在HPDv3上达到77.6%；在Stable Diffusion 3.5 Large优化中表现更好，特别是在真实性方面有明显提升；直接潜在评分实现1.65倍推理加速；中后期层的下游奖励性能最强；生成骨干容量与性能呈正相关。

Conclusion: 预训练的生成式DiT为奖励建模和策略优化提供了可迁移的表征，证明了生成模型学习的表征可以有效支持图像评估任务。

Abstract: Can representations learned for image generation also support the evaluation of generated images? We study text-to-image reward prediction as a downstream task of generative representation learning. To this end, we introduce DiT-Reward, which converts a pretrained text-to-image Diffusion Transformer into a reward model by processing near-clean image latents and aggregating text-conditioned image representations across transformer layers. Under the same training data mixture as HPSv3, DiT-Reward outperforms HPSv3 on all four evaluated preference benchmarks, reaching 85.6% on HPDv2 and 77.6% on HPDv3. When the generative backbone is frozen, a lightweight learned head can still extract meaningful preference predictions from its representations. Probing across depth further reveals that downstream reward performance is strongest in the middle-to-late layers and benefits from combining representations across different stages. We also observe consistent positive scaling with generative backbone capacity. Finally, when used to optimize Stable Diffusion 3.5 Large with Flow-GRPO, DiT-Reward outperforms HPSv3 along the matched training trajectory, with particularly clear gains in realism. Direct latent scoring also achieves a 1.65x inference speedup over HPSv3 with comparable peak memory. These results show that pretrained generative DiTs provide transferable representations for reward modeling and policy optimization.

</details>


### [292] [Muown Implicitly Performs Angular Step-size Decay](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.23637)
*Florian Hübler,Kai Lion,Antonio Orvieto,Niao He*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: AngularMuown将Muown的方向更新解释为黎曼优化步骤，显式分离角度步长和径向幅度更新，在大模型预训练中表现优异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解Muown优化器中方向更新的数学本质，解释其步长稳定性，并改进其参数化方式以实现更灵活的学习率调度。

Method: 将Muown的方向更新证明为归一化方向上的黎曼优化步骤，提出AngularMuown算法，直接在归一化方向空间进行优化，使用可调度的角度乘子，将角度步长与径向幅度更新解耦。

Result: AngularMuown在modded nanoGPT速度竞赛中领先同类别优化器，在Qwen2-0.5B和1.1B参数的混合专家模型上验证了算法的可扩展性。

Conclusion: 黎曼几何视角为矩阵感知优化器提供了理论解释，显式分离角度和径向更新能提升优化性能，该方法在大规模模型上具有实用价值。

Abstract: Matrix-aware optimizers such as Muon and Muown have recently shown strong empirical performance for pre-training Transformers. In particular, Muown separates each weight matrix into row magnitudes and an un-normalized direction variable, updating the former with Adam and the latter with Muon. We show that the directional update of Muown is equivalent to a Riemannian step on the normalized directions, while the magnitude of the un-normalized parameterization only modulates the angular step size. This explains the step-size stability of Muown and suggests making the angular step size explicit. The resulting method, AngularMuown, optimizes directly over the normalized directions and uses a schedulable angular multiplier decoupled from the radial magnitude update. AngularMuown improves over Muown and, at the time of writing, a preliminary version is leading the per-optimizer category of the modded nanoGPT speedrunning competition. Further experiments on Qwen2-0.5B, and 1.1B parameter mixture-of-experts models confirm the algorithm scales beyond small models. An implementation of the algorithm is available at https://github.com/fhueb/angular-muown

</details>


### [293] [Learning Process Rewards via Success Visitation Matching for Efficient RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.23640)
*Raymond Tsao,Andrew Wagenmaker,Sergey Levine*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种将稀疏结果奖励转换为密集过程奖励的方法，通过训练判别器区分成功和失败的episode，从而加速强化学习在稀疏奖励任务中的训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代强化学习应用中，许多任务的奖励信号是稀疏的：只在任务完成时给予+1奖励，其余时刻奖励为0。这种稀疏奖励导致信用分配问题极具挑战性，使得强化学习训练缓慢或无效。

Method: 训练一个判别器来区分之前成功和不成功的episode，利用该判别器激励强化学习策略匹配成功episode的状态-动作访问分布，同时避免不成功episode的状态-动作访问分布。通过在所有状态上激励策略匹配访问分布（而非仅关注任务成功对应的状态），提供关于是否正在取得进展的密集反馈。

Result: 在机器人控制策略的微调场景中，该方法在模拟和真实世界的操作任务上均实现了显著更快的强化学习微调性能，相比直接最大化稀疏结果奖励的方法有明显提升。理论证明该方法在不改变最优策略的前提下实现加速训练。

Conclusion: 该方法成功地将稀疏奖励问题转化为密集奖励问题，有效解决了信用分配难题，在保持最优策略不变的同时显著提升了训练效率，为机器人控制等实际应用提供了实用的解决方案。

Abstract: In many modern applications of reinforcement learning (RL), the natural reward for a task of interest is inherently sparse: a reward of 0 is given everywhere except when the task is completed, when a reward of +1 is given. Training a policy to maximize such a sparse reward requires solving a challenging credit assignment problem, leading to slow or ineffective RL improvement. We propose a simple approach to transform a sparse outcome reward into a dense process reward. Our approach relies on training a discriminator to distinguish between previous successful and unsuccessful episodes, and using this discriminator to incentivize the RL-learned policy to match the state-action visitations of successful episodes, while avoiding those of unsuccessful episodes. By incentivizing the policy to match the visitations over all states, not just those that correspond to task success, this reward provides dense feedback on whether progress is being made towards task completion, and, we show, provably achieves this without changing the optimal policy. Focusing on finetuning of robotic control policies, we demonstrate that our approach leads to significantly faster RL finetuning performance on both simulated and real-world manipulation tasks, as compared to simply maximizing the sparse outcome reward.

</details>


### [294] [Dynamic estimation of slowly varying sequences](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.23655)
*Prashant Gokhale,Mikhail Khodak,Sandeep Silwal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个通用的序列函数近似框架，适用于缓慢变化序列上的线性和非线性函数，并开发了自适应预算算法，将复杂度界限从O(m·max α_i)改进为O(∑α_i)，还实现了对序列变化的在线估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有关于隐式迹估计的工作表明，当序列元素变化较小时，重用对过去序列元素的查询可以降低总体成本。然而，现有方法仅适用于特定函数，且使用最坏情况下的变化量固定查询预算，对稳定但偶有突变的序列效率低下。此外，所有现有工作都假设已知变化量的界限。这些局限性促使作者开发更通用、自适应的框架。

Method: 作者提出了一个通用框架，将隐式迹估计推广到多种向量空间上的线性和非线性函数。该方法包括：1）开发新颖的自适应算法，根据局部变化量α_t动态调整估计预算；2）为矩阵幂、谱密度、蒙特卡洛积分和偏微分方程边界值问题等应用提供了新的序列估计结果；3）在某些情况下实现了对序列变化的在线估计，几乎不增加额外成本。

Result: 主要理论结果是将序列长度为m的估计成本界限从O(m·max α_i)改进为O(∑α_i)的路径长度式变化界限。这个结果显著优于之前使用最坏情况α_i固定查询预算的方法，特别是对于稳定但偶尔有突变的序列。此外，在某些情况下证明可以以几乎零成本在线估计变化量。

Conclusion: 该框架使序列近似工具包变得通用且自适应，同时改进了动态迹估计的最先进保证。框架适用于多种实际问题，并为缓慢变化序列上的函数近似提供了理论保证和实用算法。

Abstract: We consider the problem of sequentially approximating functions of each element in a slowly-varying sequence, i.e. one where the magnitude $α_i$ of the difference between the elements at positions $i$ and $i-1$ is small. Recent work on implicit trace estimation shows that when $α_t$ is small, reusing queries to past sequence elements can reduce the overall cost [Dharangutte \& Musco, NeurIPS~2021; Woodruff et al., NeurIPS~2022]. We introduce a framework generalizing this to a variety of linear and nonlinear functions on diverse vector spaces, obtaining novel sequential estimation results for matrix powers, spectral densities, Monte Carlo integration, and a boundary value problem from partial differential equations~(PDEs). Furthermore, we develop a novel algorithm for use with this framework that locally scales the estimation budget with $α_t$, obtaining sharper path-length-style variation bounds of form $\mathcal O(\sum_{i=1}^mα_i)$ on the cost of estimating a sequence of length $m$. This improves upon the previous implicit trace estimation bound of $\mathcal O(m\cdot\max_iα_i)$ [Dharangutte \& Musco, NeurIPS~2021], which is achieved by fixing the query budget using the worst-case $α_i$ and is thus inefficient for stable sequences with rare bursts. Lastly, while all past work assumes a known bound on $α_i$, we show in certain cases how the changes can be estimated on-the-fly with (nearly) no added cost. In summary, our framework makes the sequential approximation toolkit general-purpose and adaptive while improving upon state-of-the-art-guarantees for dynamic trace estimation.

</details>


### [295] [On the Limits of Prompt-Conditioned Language Models as General-Purpose Learners](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.23668)
*David Mguni,Julian Ma,Jun Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文从信息论和博弈论角度证明了基于提示的大语言模型并非通用问题求解器：语言作为容量受限的通信信道会产生不可消除的"表达下界"，对齐约束会导致"目标错位下界"，两者共同决定了某些任务族在理论上无法通过提示正确求解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究常将大语言模型视为能解决任意任务的通用求解器，但忽略了语言作为压缩且容量受限接口这一根本约束。作者旨在揭示基于提示的任务求解存在的结构性限制，挑战"LLM+提示=通用求解器"这一普遍假设。

Method: 将用户-系统交互建模为双层"廉价谈话"(cheap-talk)博弈，分离任务推理与执行的概念分解，利用PAC-Bayes界区分有限样本估计误差与不可约简的结构性限制，分析潜在任务如何被编码为提示并在对齐与安全约束下被重新解读。

Result: (1)建立了"表达下界"：当任务族的信息复杂度超过语言信道容量时，不同任务对求解器不可区分，产生无法通过增加数据、优化或模型扩展消除的正误差下界；(2)建立了"目标错位下界"：对齐约束限制可接受输出集时，用户理想分布可能位于可行类之外，导致不可约简的失真；(3)证明了存在即使在无限数据条件下也无法通过提示正确求解的任务族。

Conclusion: 基于提示的大语言模型并非通用问题求解器，提示泛化的局限性源于信息受限的通信和对齐受限的目标。建议采用超越自然语言的接口（多模态观测、外部记忆）以增加系统可用的任务相关信息，从而降低LLM固有限制。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are frequently portrayed as general-purpose solvers capable of solving arbitrary tasks. We argue that this view overlooks a fundamental constraint: language is a compressed and capacity-limited interface for conveying task information. Modelling User--System interaction as a bilevel \emph{cheap-talk} game, we analyse how latent tasks are encoded into prompts and reinterpreted under alignment and safety constraints. We introduce a conceptual decomposition separating task inference from execution and derive PAC-Bayes bounds that distinguish finite-sample estimation error from irreducible structural limitations. Our first main result establishes an \emph{expressivity floor}: language acts as a capacity-limited communication channel, and whenever the informational complexity of a task family exceeds the capacity of that channel, distinct tasks become unavoidably indistinguishable to the Solver, inducing a strictly positive error floor that cannot be eliminated by additional data, optimisation, or model scaling alone. We then establish an \emph{objective-misalignment floor}: when alignment constraints restrict the admissible output set, the User-ideal distribution may lie outside the feasible class, inducing an irreducible distortion. Together, these results yield a formal negative conclusion: prompt-conditioned LLMs are not universal problem solvers through prompting alone, as there exist task families for which correct behaviour is provably unattainable even in the infinite-data regime. More broadly, our analysis shows the limits of prompt-based generalisation arise from information-constrained communication and alignment-constrained objectives. This suggests that interfaces beyond natural language, including multimodal observations and, external memory, may reduce the inherent LLM limitations by increasing the task-relevant information available to the System.

</details>


### [296] [Tapered Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.23670)
*Reza Bayat,Ali Behrouz,Aaron Courville*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出锥形语言模型（TLMs），通过在固定参数预算下将更多容量分配给早期层、较少容量分配给后期层来改进模型性能。实验表明，在Transformer等四种架构和三种规模下，使用余弦调度锥化MLP宽度可一致提升困惑度和下游基准性能，无需额外参数或计算成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代语言模型均采用统一宽度的层堆叠架构，这是继承自原始Transformer的默认设计。然而，越来越多的证据表明各层对最终输出的贡献不均匀，后期层主要是在精炼残差流而非进行实质性变换。因此，作者质疑参数容量分配是否应该反映这种不对称性。

Method: 首先通过受控实验验证早期层需要更多参数容量的假设；然后提出锥形语言模型（TLMs）架构原则，在固定总预算下，沿深度方向单调锥化承载参数的组件；选择MLP作为具体实现对象（因其主导参数计数且宽度是干净的变异轴），使用平滑余弦调度来锥化MLP宽度；在Transformer、Gated Attention、Hope-attention和Titans四种架构上进行验证。

Result: 在固定参数预算下，早期层分配更多容量、后期层分配更少容量相比统一宽度基线能改善困惑度，反向分配则损害性能；在三种模型规模和四种架构上，通过平滑余弦调度锥化MLP宽度始终优于统一基线，在困惑度和下游基准测试中均有提升；无需额外参数或计算成本。

Conclusion: 深度感知的容量分配是一个简单、架构无关的语言模型设计轴，是一个一直隐藏在显眼处的免费杠杆，值得在现代语言模型设计中采用。

Abstract: Modern language models, including transformer, recurrent, and memory-based variants, share a common chassis: a stack of identical layers in which parameters are allocated uniformly across depth. This is a default inherited from the original transformer and largely unchanged since, yet a growing body of evidence suggests that layers contribute non-uniformly to the final output, with later layers refining the residual stream rather than transforming it. We ask whether parameter capacity should reflect this asymmetry. Our controlled experiment shows that, under a fixed budget, allocating more capacity to earlier layers and less to later layers improves perplexity over a uniform-width baseline, while the reverse allocation hurts. Building on this result, we introduce Tapered Language Models (TLMs), an architectural principle in which a parameter-bearing component is monotonically tapered across depth under a fixed total budget. MLPs are the natural site for this instantiation: they dominate parameter count across all modern LM families and expose width as a single, clean axis of variation. Across three model scales and four architectures (Transformer, Gated Attention, Hope-attention, and Titans), tapering MLP width via a smooth cosine schedule consistently improves perplexity and downstream benchmark performance over uniform baselines, at no additional parameter or compute cost. These findings establish depth-aware capacity allocation as a simple, architecture-agnostic axis of language model design, a free lever hidden in plain sight.

</details>


### [297] [Open Problem: Is AdamW Effective Under Heavy-Tailed Noise?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.23676)
*Dingzhi Yu,Hongyi Tao,Yuanyu Wan,Luo Luo,Lijun Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文指出AdamW在大语言模型训练中普遍使用，但其理论收敛性尚未在重尾噪声条件下得到严格证明。文章提出了一个开放问题，给出了加权重指标基准并展示了分母记忆机制可能隐藏大梯度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型预训练中的随机梯度噪声通常呈现重尾分布，而AdamW的理论分析主要局限于有限方差假设。虽然已有研究证明符号优化器和AdaGrad在重尾噪声下能收敛，但AdamW在此条件下的收敛性尚未建立，这构成了理论与实践之间的关键缺口。

Method: 作者将AdamW在重尾假设下的收敛性问题形式化为一个开放问题，提出了一个正向的加权重指标基准（positive weighted-metric benchmark），并给出了走廊下界机制（corridor lower-bound mechanism）来分析分母记忆如何可能隐藏大梯度。

Result: 论文证明了一个加权重指标基准结果，并通过走廊下界机制揭示了AdamW中二阶矩累加器（分母记忆）可能隐藏大梯度的现象，为理解AdamW在重尾噪声下的行为提供了理论洞察。

Conclusion: AdamW在重尾噪声下的收敛性仍然是一个开放问题。虽然文章提供了部分理论分析，但尚未给出完整的收敛证明。研究结果表明AdamW的二阶矩累加器可能对其在重尾条件下的收敛性构成障碍，需要进一步研究来完全解决这个问题。

Abstract: AdamW is the de facto optimizer for training large language models (LLMs), yet the theory behind it still lives mostly in finite-variance regimes. This is increasingly unsatisfying, as empirical evidence indicates that stochastic gradient noise in LLM pretraining is typically heavy-tailed. Recent work shows that sign-based optimizers such as Lion and Muon achieve sharp heavy-tailed rates, and that AdaGrad can also converge under heavy-tailed noise. However, no rigorous convergence theory for AdamW has yet been established in this regime. Can AdamW converge under the same heavy-tailed assumptions, or does its second-moment accumulator create a genuine obstruction? We formulate this as an open problem, prove a positive weighted-metric benchmark, and give a corridor lower-bound mechanism showing how denominator memory can hide large gradients.

</details>


<div id='cs.MA'></div>

# cs.MA [[Back]](#toc)

### [298] [Specialize Roles, Mix Deployments: Pushing the Cost-Accuracy Frontier of LLM Agent Teams](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20629)
*Yinsicheng Jiang,Liang Cheng,Yeqi Huang,Yufan Zhao,Zhan Lu,Li Dong,Wenda Li,Edoardo Ponti,Luo Mai*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 提出了AgentCARD基准测试套件，用于评估LLM智能体团队在角色分配和部署模式下的成本-准确性权衡，发现异构团队显著优于同构团队。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的智能体基准测试通常评估固定模型或固定智能体配置，无法为多角色LLM团队提供成本-准确性最优的部署指导。在多角色团队系统中，成本和准确性取决于每个角色由哪个模型填充以及部署位置（API、自托管、混合部署），需要角色感知的评估方法。

Method: AgentCARD结合了四个核心组件：1）角色分解评估框架；2）统一的API/自托管成本模型；3）帕累托前沿分析；4）基于Shapley的诊断方法识别角色瓶颈。支持跨角色分配和部署模式的系统性评估。

Result: 异构团队持续占据成本-准确性前沿：相比成本等价的同构团队，准确性提升高达44%；通过混合部署，可以12倍更低的单任务成本匹配最强的同构团队。最优角色分配依赖于领域：某些领域受规划器瓶颈制约，其他领域受执行器瓶颈制约。

Conclusion: AgentCARD为多角色LLM团队的部署提供了系统性评估框架，证明了异构团队在成本-准确性权衡上的显著优势。该方法不仅适用于规划器-执行器团队，还扩展到包含验证等额外角色的工作流，并支持随着新领域和团队结构出现的持续评估。

Abstract: LLM agents are increasingly deployed as multi-role teams, where tasks are divided across specialized roles such as planner, executor, and verifier. In these systems, cost and accuracy are no longer properties of a single model: they depend on which model fills each role and where it is hosted, including API, self-hosted, and hybrid deployment. Existing agentic benchmarks typically evaluate fixed models or fixed agent configurations, and therefore offer limited guidance for cost-accuracy-optimal deployment. We introduce AgentCARD, a role-aware benchmark suite for evaluating LLM agent teams across role assignment and deployment mode. AgentCARD combines a role-decomposed evaluation harness, a unified API/self-hosted cost model, Pareto-frontier analysis, and a Shapley-based diagnostic for identifying role bottlenecks. Our evaluation shows that heterogeneous teams consistently occupy the cost-accuracy frontier. They improve accuracy by up to $44\%$ over cost-equivalent homogeneous teams, or match the strongest homogeneous team at up to $12\times$ lower per-task cost through hybrid deployment. We further find that the best role assignment is domain-dependent: some domains are planner-bottlenecked, while others are executor-bottlenecked. Finally, AgentCARD extends beyond planner--executor teams to workflows with additional roles such as verification, and supports continual evaluation as new domains and team structures emerge. Our code is released at: https://github.com/Auto-CAP/AgentCAP

</details>


### [299] [How Much Coordination Gain Is Real? A Paired Noise-Floor Protocol for Multi-Agent LLM Benchmarks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20695)
*Alibek T Kaliyev,Artem Maryanskyy*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 多智能体LLM协调架构的基准测试差异可能被高估。研究发现，在配置等效条件下，不同协议间的差异范围（[-3,+18]pp）超过了许多已发表研究的headline效应，质疑这些工作的统计显著性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前多智能体LLM协调论文通过小的基准测试差异来证明某架构优于另一架构，但缺乏一个关键前提检验：在配置等效条件下，两种协议在同一模型和基准测试上的初始试验差异有多大？作者旨在量化这种基线差异，评估已报告效应的可靠性。

Method: 在Claude Haiku 4.5模型上使用tau^2-bench retail基准，对比no_coord与intercept两种协议在配置等效条件下的表现（通过代码检查和SHA-256字节审计验证）。采用配对试验设计，使用两个n=100种子，进行Wilson置信区间估计和Bonferroni校正。定义coordination-active pass^k指标，仅统计协调机制逻辑活跃的试验。在ET-MCP任务级负知识存储平台上实施测量。

Result: 单种子对比中最大差异为+18pp（p_corr=0.012），但在第二个种子未重现（-3pp, p_corr=1.0）；Bonferroni校正后，无任何trial-0对比显著。观测配对差异范围为[-3,+18]pp，合并上界Wilson CI约15pp。近期十个多智能体协调架构中有七个报告的headline效应低于此局部下限，还有一个在此范围内，这些工作在其原始设置中未通过同模型配对复现检验。pull和intercept阅读器在trial-1恢复上无改善。

Conclusion: 多智能体LLM协调研究的报告标准需要提高，建议采用coordination-active pass^k作为最低报告协议，并设定样本量目标和运行时钩子。现有许多声称显著的架构改进可能并未超过配置等效条件下的自然波动范围，需要同模型配对复现来验证。

Abstract: Multi-agent LLM coordination papers report small benchmark deltas as evidence that one architecture beats another. A prior question: how much paired trial-0 disagreement do two protocols produce on the same model and benchmark when their API inputs are configuration-equivalent (matched by code inspection plus a SHA-256 byte audit), short of full identity-replay? On Claude Haiku 4.5 against tau^2-bench retail, the clean configuration-equivalent contrast (no_coord vs. intercept, both inert at trial 0) gives signed paired gaps of +10pp and 0pp across two n=100 seeds; pooled across both, +5pp with Wilson CI [-2,+12], not significant. The largest single-seed contrast (+18pp pull-vs-intercept, p_corr=0.012) did not reproduce at the second seed (-3pp, p_corr=1.0); no trial-0 contrast is significant after Bonferroni at either seed or pooled. The envelope of observed paired gaps spans [-3,+18]pp across two seeds, with pooled upper Wilson CI ~15pp. Seven of ten recent multi-agent coordination architectures report headline effects below this local floor, and one more sits inside the envelope; whether they survive a same-model paired replication is, by construction, untested in their original settings.
  We define coordination-active pass^k, pass^k restricted to trials where the coordination mechanism is logically active, as the minimum reporting protocol, with sample-size targets and runtime hooks in the body. Measurements run on ET-MCP, a task-scoped negative-knowledge store conformant with MCP 2026-07-28, used as a substrate to isolate reader-side choices, not as a contribution. On Haiku 4.5 the candidate readers (pull, intercept) do not improve trial-1 recovery; we give a preliminary diagnosis of failure modes with refinements on existing production hook surfaces.

</details>


### [300] [Structural Distinguishability of Static and Adaptive Policy Regimes in Agent-Based Regulatory Simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20699)
*Roberto Garrone*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个受控仿真基准，用于评估政策导向的基于主体的模型（ABM）中政策适应性与主体适应性的交互作用，发现不同制度下的监管结论可能存在显著差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有政策导向的ABM通常将监管视为固定场景参数，这限制了区分监管结论是依赖于主体适应性、政策适应性还是两者交互作用的能力。

Method: 基于先前提出的四制度架构，使用单一可配置的排放监管ABM，在匹配的仿真条件下比较四种组合：恒定政策/恒定主体、恒定政策/适应主体、适应政策/恒定主体、适应政策/适应主体。评估了朴素固定政策、跟踪感知校准固定政策以及三种自适应控制器（设定点控制、安全裕度控制、单边控制）。

Result: 基准恢复了预期的控制器原型：设定点控制跟踪上限但产生频繁的边界穿越；安全裕度控制通过保守性减少违规；单边控制可限制违规但与自适应主体结合时可能趋向过度保守。即使平均结果相似，监管结论也可能不同。

Conclusion: 自适应政策导向的ABM应通过制度可区分性进行评估，而不仅仅是平均性能。标量指标、上限相对符号诊断、轨迹模式和视觉检查联合揭示了监管结论的差异。

Abstract: Agent-based models are widely used to evaluate policy interventions in complex socio-technical systems, yet many policy-oriented ABMs represent regulation as a fixed scenario parameter. This limits their ability to distinguish whether regulatory conclusions depend on agent adaptation, policy adaptation, or the interaction between both. Building on a previously proposed four-regime architecture, this paper contributes a controlled simulation benchmark rather than a new general framework. Using a single configurable emissions-regulation ABM, we compare constant policy/constant agents, constant policy/adaptive agents, adaptive policy/constant agents, and adaptive policy/adaptive agents under matched simulation conditions. We evaluate naive fixed policies, tracking-aware calibrated fixed policies, and three adaptive controllers: setpoint, safety-margin, and one-sided control. The benchmark recovers expected controller archetypes: setpoint control tracks the cap but produces frequent boundary crossings, safety-margin control reduces violations through conservatism, and one-sided control can limit violations but may ratchet toward over-conservatism when combined with adaptive agents. The contribution is methodological: scalar indicators, cap-relative symbolic diagnostics, trajectory motifs, and visual inspection jointly reveal how regulatory conclusions can differ even when average outcomes appear similar. Adaptive policy-oriented ABMs should therefore be evaluated through regime distinguishability, not only through average performance.

</details>


### [301] [Machine-Coached Policy Revision in Adaptive Agent-Based Regulatory Simulation: A Controller-Level Contestability Layer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20700)
*Roberto Garrone*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种轻量级的机器辅导策略修订层，用于自适应基于主体的监管模型（ABM）。通过将策略决策表示为可辩驳规则，系统能够解释控制器行为，并将诊断失败转化为规则修改，从而在仿真环境中实现策略的可解释性、可挑战性和可修订性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前面向政策的基于主体的模型（ABM）主要用于研究复杂适应社会技术系统中的监管干预。尽管现有的自适应ABM框架区分了静态与自适应主体、固定与自适应策略以及不同的控制器设计，但大多数诊断工作流仍是事后性的：仿真后分析轨迹，但所得证据并未系统地反馈到策略控制器中。缺乏一种机制将诊断结果转化为策略层面的修订。

Method: 提出一个机器辅导的策略修订层，该层将策略决策表示为具有显式冲突和优先级的可辩驳规则。系统生成控制器行为的解释，并允许将诊断失败转化为规则添加、删除或优先级变更。采用程式化的排放监管ABM作为实验组件，针对VPVA体制下的过度保守失效进行受控仿真实验，使用预定义的辅导模板向符号控制器添加放松规则。

Result: 在保留违规、超调和波动性保护措施的前提下，预定义的辅导模板成功向符号控制器添加了放松规则，减少了在保留种子下的过度保守复发。实验表明，该方法能够在仿真兼容的环境中实现控制器层面的可争辩性操作化。

Conclusion: 机器辅导应被视为可解释自适应ABM在控制器层面的扩展，与因果、信息论和基于轨迹的诊断方法互为补充。该方法不追求新的最优控制器或对无限制机器辅导的形式化保证，而是提供了策略决策可解释、可挑战、可修订和可重新评估的仿真兼容操作化方案。

Abstract: Policy-oriented agent-based models are increasingly used to study regulatory interventions in complex adaptive socio-technical systems. Recent adaptive ABM frameworks distinguish between static and adaptive agents, fixed and adaptive policies, and alternative controller designs. However, most diagnostic workflows remain ex post: trajectories are analysed after simulation, but the resulting evidence is not systematically fed back into the policy controller. This paper proposes a lightweight machine-coached policy-revision layer for adaptive agent-based regulation. The layer represents policy decisions as defeasible rules with explicit conflicts and priorities, generates explanations for controller actions, and allows diagnostic failures to be translated into rule additions, removals, or priority changes. The contribution is not a new optimal controller and does not claim formal guarantees for unrestricted machine coaching. Instead, it provides a simulation-compatible operationalization of controller-level contestability: policy decisions can be explained, challenged, revised, and re-evaluated in held-out simulation runs. A stylized emissions-regulation ABM is used as the experimental component. A controlled simulation experiment focuses on an over-conservatism failure in the VPVA regime. The predefined coaching template adds a relaxation rule to the symbolic controller, reducing over-conservatism recurrence under held-out seeds while preserving violation, overshoot, and volatility guardrails. The paper argues that machine coaching is best understood as a controller-level extension of explainable adaptive ABM, complementary to causal, information-theoretic, and trajectory-based diagnostics.

</details>


### [302] [BARD-MARL: Byzantine-Agent Detection for Learned Communication in Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20701)
*Almond Kiruthu Murimi*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 本文提出了BARD-MARL，一种用于学习通信多智能体强化学习的拜占庭智能体检测方法，通过融合策略图特征和贝叶斯信任统计，在SUMO交通信号控制场景中实现了高精度的故障/对抗智能体检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在协作多智能体强化学习中，学习通信虽然提升了协调能力，但也引入了信任问题：训练好的策略可能会将信息路由给已故障或恶意的智能体，因此需要有效的拜占庭智能体检测机制来确保系统安全。

Method: 提出BARD-MARL方法，作为BayesG之上的后验诊断层。该方法融合两个智能体级证据流：(1)从状态-动作轨迹中提取的策略图特征；(2)基于BayesG潜在掩码概率计算的贝叶斯信任统计。在SUMO交通网格环境中，针对固定动作、观测翻转、随机噪声和协同攻击四种攻击类型进行验证。

Result: 在25智能体网格中，BARD-MARL在10%观测翻转攻击下达到0.843 AUC-ROC，而仅使用策略图的方法在10%协同攻击下达到0.917 AUC-ROC。在100智能体网格中，统一BARD-MARL变体在10%固定动作和10%协同攻击下均达到0.982 AUC-ROC。实验表明两种信号具有互补性而非普遍优势。

Conclusion: 研究表明学习通信策略能够揭示有用的诊断证据，但要建立可信的鲁棒性声明，需要针对特定攻击进行消融实验，并明确区分协调、检测和缓解三个环节。

Abstract: Learned communication improves coordination in cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning, but it also creates a trust problem: a trained policy may route information through agents that have become faulty or adversarial. This paper studies Byzantine-agent detection for learned-communication MARL in adaptive traffic signal control. We propose BARD-MARL, a post-hoc diagnostic layer on top of BayesG, which is used as an attributed communication substrate rather than as a contribution of this paper. BARD-MARL combines two agent-level evidence streams: policy-graph features extracted from state-action trajectories and Bayesian trust statistics computed from BayesG latent mask probabilities. Across fixed-action, observation-flip, random-noise, and coordinated attacks in SUMO traffic grids, the results show that these signals are complementary rather than universally dominant. On a 25-agent grid, BARD-MARL reaches 0.843 AUC-ROC under a 10% observation-flip attack, while policy-graph-only detection reaches 0.917 AUC-ROC under a 10% coordinated attack. On a 100-agent grid, the unified BARD-MARL variant reaches 0.982 AUC-ROC for both 10% fixed-action and 10% coordinated attacks. The study shows that learned communication policies expose useful diagnostic evidence, but credible resilience claims require attack-specific ablations and explicit separation between coordination, detection, and mitigation.

</details>


### [303] [Empowering Economic Simulation Through Situation-Aware Llm-Driven Generative System](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20720)
*Zhimei Chen,Mu Chen*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 提出SAMAS框架，利用大语言模型驱动基于主体的经济建模，通过结合宏观结构模式和微观动态行为，在经济波动真实性和转折点预测方面取得优越性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统经济建模采用自上而下范式，忽视个体多样性和社会互动复杂性；现有基于主体的建模系统难以在预定义场景之外泛化。大语言模型在角色扮演和类人决策方面的潜力为解决这些问题提供了新思路。

Method: 提出SAMAS系统，将大语言模型中嵌入的丰富宏观经济理解与历史模拟步骤中的经济轨迹相结合，对个体主体进行建模。采用联合建模方法，同时捕获宏观层面的结构模式和微观层面的动态行为。

Result: SAMAS在经济波动真实性和经济转折点预测方面实现了优越性能，成功突破了现有ABM系统的泛化限制。

Conclusion: 通过融合大语言模型的宏观理解能力和主体建模的微观动态特性，SAMAS为经济建模提供了一种新的有效方法，能够更好地捕捉社会结构的复杂性和经济现象的涌现机制。

Abstract: Traditional economic modeling typically follows a TOP-DOWN paradigm, neglecting individual diversity and the complexity of social interactions. To better capture the complexity of societal structure, Agent-Based Modeling (ABM) employs a BOTTOM-UP solution by incorporating micro-level dynamics to generate macroeconomic phenomena. Reinforcement Learning further improves its decision-making ability through tailored reward signals. However, existing ABM systems struggle to generalize beyond predefined scenarios. Recognizing the potential of LLM-driven role-playing in perception and human-like decision-making, we propose SAMAS, which models individual agents with rich macroeconomic understanding embedded in LLMs and economic trajectories experienced in the passing simulation steps. By jointly modeling both macro-level structural patterns and micro-level dynamic behaviors, SAMAS achieves superior performance in volatility realism and turning point prediction.

</details>


### [304] [Artificial collectives of specialists and generalists excel at different tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20877)
*John Meluso,Laurent Hébert-Dufresne,Christoph Riedl,H. Oliver Gao*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 研究通过系统实验揭示了多智能体系统中智能体解释能力、理性边界与任务特性如何交互影响集体性能，发现通才型集体在生成、选择和协调任务中表现更好，而带有少量通才中介的专才型集体在谈判任务中更优，为设计资源高效的多智能体系统提供了理论依据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管多智能体协作系统在医学到集体治理等领域具有解决大规模问题的潜力，但目前缺乏对人工集体行为的描述性科学理解，因此缺乏如何设计资源高效多智能体系统的原则。现有的研究主要集中在规范性工程解决方案，而缺乏对智能体特性与任务需求匹配的科学认知。

Method: 采用系统化实验方法，通过优化智能体进行实验研究。智能体类型从具有狭窄解释能力的专才到具有广泛解释能力的通才不等。研究分析了智能体解释能力、理性边界和任务特性三个维度如何交互影响集体性能，并考察了解释网络特性（稀疏集中式vs密集分散式）与任务类型的匹配关系。

Result: 1）解释网络特性对平均性能影响较小（0.07个标准差），但对特定任务影响显著增大（0.33 sd，某些任务可达1.84 sd）；2）通才型集体在生成、选择和协调任务中表现更好；3）带有少数通才中介的专才型集体在谈判任务中表现更优；4）理性边界调节这些关系：宽松边界下专才通过更有效采样高维决策空间而胜出，严格边界下通才通过更好的梯度估计而胜出；5）在中等边界下出现性能与收敛速度的基本权衡。

Conclusion: 多智能体系统设计应将解释网络与任务需求和智能体计算限制相匹配，这对多智能体系统的效率和能耗具有重要意义。研究为如何根据任务特性设计最优的智能体组合（专才vs通才）及网络结构提供了科学指导原则。

Abstract: Collective artificial intelligence, where multiple agents work on shared tasks, holds potential to solve expansive problems in fields from medicine to collective governance. But while prescriptive engineering solutions abound, we lack descriptive scientific understanding of artificial collectives, and therefore principles for how to design resource efficient multi-agent systems. Through systematic experiments with optimizing agents, we characterize how agent interpretive abilities, rationality bounds, and task qualities interact to shape collective performance. Agents range from specialists, with narrow interpretive abilities, to generalists, with broad ones. Collectives of specialists correspond to sparse, centralized networks, while collectives of generalists correspond to dense, decentralized ones. We show that interpretive network properties have small performance effects on average (0.07 standard deviations of performance). However, for specific task qualities, these effects are 4.5 times larger (0.33 sd) and can reach much higher for certain task qualities (1.84 sd). This leads collectives of generalists to perform better on tasks that involve generating, choosing, and coordinating, while collectives of specialists with a few generalist mediators perform better on tasks that involve negotiating. Rationality bounds then moderate these relationships. At loose bounds, specialists outperform generalists through more effective sampling of high-dimensional decision spaces. At tight bounds, generalists outperform specialists through better gradient estimation. A fundamental trade-off between performance and convergence speed emerges at moderate bounds. These findings suggest that multi-agent design could benefit from matching interpretive networks to both task demands and agents' computational limits, with implications for the efficiency and energy costs of multi-agent systems.

</details>


### [305] [Monitoring Diameters of Causal Communication Graph with Spatio-Temporal Logic](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21558)
*Lydia Bakiri,Jérémy Dubut,Sergio Mover*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 本文扩展了muTGL逻辑，引入了"空间视界"操作符以约束通信链的距离范围，从而增强了逻辑的表达能力，能够处理可达性和通信链长度/成本分析，并提供了集中式离线监控算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体系统的验证需要检查连续时空中移动智能体的拓扑性质，但现有的muTGL逻辑缺乏足够的表达能力来分析特定距离范围内的可达性，或追踪通信链的长度/成本。这些能力对于去中心化监控和分布式协议的图论分析至关重要，因为算法复杂度通常与系统通信图直径相关。

Method: 引入muTGL逻辑的扩展，新增"空间视界"(space horizon)操作符，该操作符能够约束通信链的距离范围。这一扩展使得逻辑能够编码其他逻辑中的模态（如可达性或逃逸），同时实现空间和时间性质更深层次的纠缠。

Result: 证明了空间视界操作符能够编码其他逻辑中的模态（如可达性或逃逸），这些在原始muTGL中无法实现；开发了针对该逻辑的集中式离线监控算法；在基于共识的捆绑算法（用于任务分配的分布式协议）的仿真示例上进行了验证。

Conclusion: 扩展后的muTGL逻辑成功增强了对空间-时间纠缠性质的表达能力，填补了原始逻辑在距离约束可达性分析方面的空白，为多智能体系统的验证提供了更强大的形式化工具。

Abstract: Verification of multi-agent systems requires the ability to check meticulous topological properties when it comes to agents that can move through space in continuous time. This demands a logic with sufficient expressiveness to capture these dynamics. MuTGL logic has interesting properties for expressing entangled space-time properties. However, this logic lacks the expressivity needed to analyse reachability within specific distance bounds, or to track the length or the cost of communication chains: these are fundamental for decentralized monitoring, or graph-theoretic analysis of distributed protocols, where algorithmic complexities often relates with the system's communication graph diameter. We then introduce an extension of muTGL, including a new operator called the space horizon. This addition allows us to bound the distance of communication chains, hence enhancing the logic's expressiveness. We show that this operator allows to encode modalities from other logics, such as reachability or escaping which were not available in vanilla muTGL, while allowing a deeper entanglement of spatial and temporal properties. We provide a centralized offline monitoring algorithm for this logic and illustrate it on several examples on simulations of Consensus-Based Bundle Algorithms, distributed protocols for task allocation.

</details>


### [306] [Cohort Organized Learning: Clustering Through Agreement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21743)
*Finn Henry O'Shea,Maria Elena Monzani*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 本文提出了Cohort Organized Learning (CoOL)，一种无需显式距离或相似度计算的数据聚类方法，利用神经网络进行聚类估计，可应用于向量数据和图像等多种数据类型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统聚类方法通常依赖于显式的距离或相似度计算，这在某些数据类型上可能存在局限性。作者希望开发一种不依赖显式距离计算的聚类方法，以提高聚类的适用性和灵活性。

Method: CoOL采用神经网络来估计聚类，通过期望最大化(EM)算法推导梯度来训练网络，在训练过程中监控收敛性，并在训练后评估聚类效果。由于使用神经网络，该方法可以聚类任何兼容的数据类型。

Result: 作者展示了CoOL方法在向量数据和图像数据上的应用示例和用例，验证了该方法的可行性和有效性，并建立了评估聚类质量的方法。

Conclusion: CoOL提供了一种新颖的无显式距离计算的聚类方法，具有良好的数据类型适应性。文章还讨论了该方法的局限性以及在相关任务上的未来发展前景，为后续研究指明了方向。

Abstract: In this article we describe Cohort Organized Learning (CoOL), a method for clustering data without explicit distance or similarity computations. Herein, we will describe CoOL, derive the gradients determined by expectation maximization to train the networks, show how to monitor convergence during training and evaluate the clusters after training, and discuss a series of examples and use cases. We also discuss CoOL's limitations and future prospects on related tasks. Because CoOL uses neural networks to estimate the clusters, it can be used to cluster any data that can be made compatible and we illustrate this on vector data and images.

</details>


### [307] [GARIP: A Running-Average Moving Reference for Last-Iterate Self-Play in Two-Player Zero-Sum Games](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.22688)
*Can Savcı*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 本文研究了二人零和博弈中的自我博弈算法GARIP，通过锚定运行平均值而非固定策略或快照，实现了更强的鲁棒性和收敛性。关键发现是运行平均参考能最小化峰值滞后，在标准参数设置下崩溃率为0/40，显著优于快照方法的10/40。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的自我博弈方法在二人零和博弈中存在循环问题。现代方法通过向参考策略正则化来恢复最后迭代收敛：MMD锚定固定策略（只能达到正则化均衡），R-NaD锚定周期快照（DeepNash的核心机制）。本文研究GARIP方法，它锚定到运行平均值，旨在理解参考策略的选择如何控制算法性能。

Method: 提出了GARIP算法，将策略锚定到运行平均值而非固定策略或周期快照。理论分析揭示了关键机制：崩溃跟踪参考的峰值滞后，在具有固定平均滞后的因果凸平均中，运行平均值（平坦轮廓，峰值=平均值）唯一地最小化该峰值，而快照的锯齿形峰值=2×平均值。证明了在恒定锚定强度下的局部最后迭代收敛性。实验验证在矩阵博弈、Coin Game、Connect Four和Othello上进行。

Result: GARIP在峰值性能上与R-NaD匹配，在所有实验中两种移动参考都比固定锚定和无锚定基线更加鲁棒。在完整网格上崩溃率统计上无差异，但在常规参数设置下，匹配平均滞后设置中GARIP崩溃率为0/40，而R-NaD为10/40（快照只有在知道缩短K时才能匹配）。前瞻性（负权重）参考在停滞侧表现更好，该优势仅出现在朴素自我博弈循环的场景中（五个深层自我博弈循环）。

Conclusion: 运行平均锚定是比快照锚定更好的超参数默认选择。理论贡献包括收敛性证明（锚定缩放基础映射旋转，将循环基础转换为收缩）和峰值滞后最小化机制。实验表明GARIP是更鲁棒和实用的选择，所有实验使用纯JAX实现且可重现。

Abstract: Self-play with naive gradient ascent cycles in two-player zero-sum games: the last iterate orbits the equilibrium. Modern methods restore last-iterate convergence by regularizing toward a reference policy -- MMD a fixed one (reaching only the regularized equilibrium), R-NaD a periodic snapshot (the engine of DeepNash). We study GARIP, which anchors to the running average, and isolate what the choice of reference controls. Our central result is a mechanism: collapse tracks the peak lag of the reference, and among causal convex averages of a fixed mean lag the running average (flat profile, peak $=$ mean) uniquely minimizes that peak, while a snapshot's sawtooth has peak $= 2\times$ mean (a one-line theorem). Two consequences follow. Convergence: we prove local last-iterate convergence at constant anchor strength -- the anchor scales the base map's rotation by $1-β$, crossing the stability boundary and turning a recurrent base into a contraction (global convergence is conjectured at small $β$; we characterize a large-$β$ consensus failure). Robustness: GARIP matches R-NaD's peak performance -- on matrix games, the Coin Game, and the board games Connect Four/Othello, both moving references are far more robust than fixed-magnet and magnet-free baselines -- but is the better hyperparameter default; we report it both ways: over the full grid collapse rates are statistically indistinguishable, yet at conventional parameterizations a matched-mean-lag setting collapses in 0/40 vs 10/40 seeds (a snapshot matches it only by knowing to shorten $K$). The boundaries: an anticipatory (negative-weight) reference does better still on the stale side, and the advantage appears only where naive self-play cycles (five deep self-play loops). All experiments are pure JAX and reproducible.

</details>


### [308] [Decentralized Autonomous Traffic Management through Corridor Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.23585)
*Jasmine Jerry Aloor,Aadarsh Govada,Hamsa Balakrishnan*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 本研究扩展了多智能体强化学习方法，用于AAM走廊网络中的去中心化交通流管理，在单走廊场景训练的策略能够零样本迁移到复杂的合并与分流多走廊网络，且在不同交通密度和网络几何结构下表现良好。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着自主飞行器大规模引入和交通密度增加，集中式管理无法有效协调大量有人和无人飞行器。虽然提出了专用先进空中交通(AAM)走廊来组织高密度自主交通流，但需要开发可扩展的去中心化交通管理方法，为自主飞行器提供灵活的轨迹规划能力。

Method: 扩展多智能体强化学习(MARL)方法，在单走廊环境中训练策略，然后在零样本设置下测试于包含合并和分流组合的复杂多走廊网络。策略仅依赖局部协调的进入、穿越和退出行为，无需集中协调或模型重新训练。

Result: 学习到的行为能够很好地迁移到不同交通密度、网络几何结构和异构车辆性能的场景。从走廊边界合规性、完成率、平均速度、行驶距离和航空器间间隔维持等系统级性能指标评估，仅依赖局部协调的策略能够集体产生理想的走廊网络交通流。

Conclusion: 证明了去中心化MARL方法在AAM走廊网络交通流管理中的有效性，训练策略具有良好的泛化能力和零样本迁移性，为大规模自主飞行器交通管理提供了可扩展的解决方案。

Abstract: As autonomous aircraft are introduced at scale and traffic density increases, centralized management becomes insufficient to coordinate the large numbers of crewed and uncrewed aircraft. Dedicated Advanced Air Mobility (AAM) corridors have therefore been proposed for organizing high-density autonomous traffic flows. The desire to scalably provide autonomous aircraft flexibility in trajectory planning motivates the development of decentralized approaches to traffic management in AAM corridors.
  In this work, we extend a multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) approach to address the challenge of decentralized traffic flow management in air corridor networks. We test policies trained in a single-corridor setting on increasingly complex multi-corridor networks with combinations of merges and splits in a zero-shot manner. Experimental results demonstrate that learned behaviors transfer well to scenarios with varying traffic density, network geometry, and heterogeneous vehicle performance, without needing centralized coordination or model retraining. We evaluate system-level performance in terms of conformance to corridor boundaries, completion rates, average speeds, distance traveled, and maintenance of inter-aircraft separation. We find that although our policies require only locally coordinated entry, traversal, and exit behaviors, they collectively produce desirable traffic flows through the corridor network.

</details>


<div id='cs.NI'></div>

# cs.NI [[Back]](#toc)

### [309] [A Reproducible Semantic Benchmark for Multivendor DSM-to-CLI Translation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20564)
*Jerônimo Menezes,Leonardo Bitzki,Diego Kreutz,Gefte Almeida,Marcio Pohlmann,Rodrigo Mansilha*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文提出了首个可复现的DSM-to-CLI语义基准测试，用于评估LLM在多厂商网络配置生成任务中的表现，发现语义质量与操作可靠性正交、厂商效应主导用例效应，强调了多厂商重复执行基准测试的科学必要性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前网络自动化领域缺乏可复现的语义基准测试来严格评估LLM在跨厂商网络配置生成中的表现，尽管语法正确的输出仍可能违反预期的运行状态，但现有方法无法有效捕捉语义层面的错误。

Method: 构建了一个可复现的DSM-to-CLI语义基准测试框架，涵盖5个云端LLM、3个厂商（包括华为VRP等）、5个代表性用例，每个实验单元进行10次重复运行，采用固定评判标准和明确的失败分类法进行评估。

Result: 实验结果表明：语义质量与操作可靠性相互正交；厂商效应比用例效应更显著；重复运行的离散度能强预测投票不稳定性；华为VRP暴露了被聚合指标隐藏的失败模式。

Conclusion: 多厂商、重复执行的语义基准测试对于科学严谨地比较基于LLM的网络配置系统至关重要，聚合指标可能掩盖重要的失败模式，需要更细粒度的评估方法。

Abstract: Translating high-level network intents into correct multivendor configurations remains a central challenge in network automation, as syntactically valid outputs may still violate the intended operational state. Despite recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs), the field still lacks reproducible semantic benchmarks for rigorous cross-vendor evaluation. This paper presents a reproducible DSM-to-CLI semantic benchmark covering five cloud LLMs, three vendors, five representative use cases, and ten repeated runs per experimental cell under fixed judges and an explicit failure taxonomy. Our results show that semantic quality and operational reliability are orthogonal, vendor effects dominate use-case effects, and repeated-run dispersion strongly predicts vote instability, with Huawei VRP exposing failure modes hidden by aggregate metrics. These findings demonstrate that multivendor, repeated-execution semantic benchmarks are essential for scientifically rigorous comparison of LLM-based network configuration systems.

</details>


### [310] [AI-Native Network Controller: A Modular Framework for Safe Agentic Control of Multi-Domain Network Infrastructure](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20565)
*Merim Dzaferagic*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 提出了AI原生网络控制器(AI-NNC)，一个开源的模块化框架，通过协议无关的架构实现跨无线接入、光传送和核心网等多网络域的智能体AI控制，支持闭环控制、数据集收集和AI实验，实现更安全的自主网络管理范式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有网络控制器大多是特定于单个域的（如O-RAN RIC用于无线域），缺乏跨异构基础设施的AI驱动自动化原生支持，难以实现多域网络的安全协调智能体控制，这是6G系统面临的关键挑战。

Method: 设计了协议无关的架构，通过轻量级Python适配器集成各物理设备，控制逻辑通过特定域的控制应用实现。AI智能体不直接向网络设备发送命令，而是通过经过验证的应用程序进行操作，支持闭环控制、数据集收集和协调测试床操作。

Result: 开发了一个开源模块化的AI-NNC框架，能够实现跨多网络域的智能体AI控制，提供统一的控制和测量接口，支持数据收集、AI实验和测试床操作，确保AI代理操作的安全性。

Conclusion: AI-NNC框架为实现6G系统中多域网络的统一智能控制提供了可行的解决方案，建立了一种更安全的自主网络管理范式，其中AI智能体通过经过验证的应用程序而非直接命令来管理网络设备。

Abstract: The convergence of multiple network domains, including radio access, optical transport, and core networks, under unified intelligent control is a fundamental requirement for future 6G systems. This is important because existing network controllers remain largely domain-specific, such as the O-RAN RIC for radio, or they lack native support for AI-driven automation across heterogeneous infrastructure. As a result, safe and coordinated agentic control of multi-domain networks is still an open challenge. In this paper, we present the AI-Native Network Controller (AI-NNC), an open-source and modular framework that enables agentic AI control across diverse network domains. The framework is designed around a protocol-agnostic architecture in which each physical device is integrated through a lightweight Python adapter, while control logic is implemented through domain-specific control applications. Beyond closed-loop control, the framework also supports dataset collection, agentic AI experimentation, and coordinated testbed operation using the same validated control and measurement interfaces. This design enables a safer paradigm for autonomous network management, where AI agents operate through validated applications rather than issuing commands directly to network equipment.

</details>


### [311] [Shared Channel Capacity and Node Lifetime: An Empirical Study of the Lightning Network](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20566)
*Danila Valko,Jorge Marx Gómez*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文通过大规模实证分析研究了比特币闪电网络中节点生命周期、连通性和容量之间的联合关系，发现节点生命周期通过增加连通性间接影响容量，且受宏观经济条件和网络层级结构的显著影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 闪电网络是一个快速发展的支付通道网络，先前研究已记录了其拓扑结构和流动性集中情况，但节点生命周期、连通性和容量之间的联合关系仍缺乏深入理解。本研究旨在填补这一空白，全面分析这些变量之间的相互关系。

Method: 使用2019-2023年期间大规模闪电网络拓扑快照数据集，采用实证分析方法，检验节点生命周期是否影响共享通道容量，以及节点度数是否中介或调节这种效应。同时考虑层级地理结构，探索国家层面经济条件的作用，并使用混合水平模型进行分析。

Result: 节点生命周期对容量有正向但相对温和的直接效应；这种关系主要通过节点度数中介，表明流动性积累主要通过增加连通性实现；生命周期与度数的交互作用显示显著异质性，高连通性和高容量节点中效应更强；混合水平模型展现出更优的解释力；人均GDP证实宏观经济条件显著影响容量分布。

Conclusion: 闪电网络的流动性源于时间动态、网络结构和经济背景的相互作用，本研究为支付通道网络提供了更整合的理解，为未来研究其演进和效率奠定了基础。

Abstract: The Lightning Network (LN) is a rapidly evolving payment channel network that enables scalable, off-chain transactions on top of Bitcoin. While prior research has documented its topological structure and liquidity concentration, the joint relationships between node lifetime, connectivity, and capacity remain insufficiently understood. This study provides a comprehensive empirical analysis of these relationships using a large-scale dataset of LN topology snapshots spanning the period 2019-2023. We examine whether node lifetime influences shared channel capacity, and whether this effect is mediated and moderated by node degree. In addition, we account for hierarchical geographic structure and explore the role of country-level economic conditions. The results show that node lifetime has a positive but relatively modest direct effect on capacity. This relationship is largely mediated by node degree, indicating that liquidity accumulation primarily occurs through increased connectivity. Furthermore, the interaction between lifetime and degree reveals significant heterogeneity, with stronger effects observed among highly connected and high-capacity nodes. Mixed-level models demonstrate superior explanatory power, highlighting the importance of country- and region-level variation. The inclusion of GDP per capita confirms that broader economic conditions significantly influence capacity distribution. Overall, the findings suggest that liquidity in the LN emerges from the interplay of temporal dynamics, network structure, and economic context. This study contributes to a more integrated understanding of payment channel networks and provides a foundation for future research on their evolution and efficiency.

</details>


### [312] [Handling Interoperability Issues in 6G ORAN: Lessons Learned from Research Lab-based Integrations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20568)
*Poonam Yadav,Yifan Liu,Mohit Bidikar,Rana M. Sohaib,Yi Chu,David Grace*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文针对6G ORAN环境中的多厂商互操作性问题，通过分析实验室集成案例，识别集成失败的根本原因并提出解决方案与最佳实践指南。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着6G网络演进，ORAN框架因其灵活性、厂商中立架构和增强服务能力而备受关注。然而，在来自多个厂商的异构硬件和软件组件之间实现真正的互操作性仍然是一个关键挑战，亟需系统性研究以解决集成失败问题。

Method: 基于研究实验室的集成环境，系统性地分析实验室环境中的案例研究，深入挖掘集成失败的根本原因，并提出相应的解决方案。

Result: 识别出导致多厂商组件集成失败的核心问题，提出了确保多厂商兼容性的解决方案，并建立了一套面向未来部署的最佳实践准则。

Conclusion: 本研究将为6G ORAN生态系统制定稳健的指导规范做出贡献，从而加速现实网络中无缝且可扩展的ORAN部署进程。

Abstract: As 6G networks continue to evolve, the Open Radio Access Network (ORAN) framework is gaining prominence for its promise of network flexibility, vendor-neutral architecture, and enhanced service delivery. However, achieving true interoperability across diverse hardware and software components from multiple vendors remains a critical challenge. This research focuses on identifying and addressing interoperability issues within 6G ORAN environments, leveraging insights from research lab-based integrations. By systematically analysing lab-based case studies, the study aims to uncover the root causes of integration failures, propose solutions to ensure smooth multi-vendor compatibility, and establish a set of best practices for future deployments. This work will contribute to developing robust guidelines for 6G ORAN ecosystems, accelerating seamless and scalable deployments in real-world networks.

</details>


### [313] [Infrastructure for the Agentic Web: Gap Analysis and Architecture from the Agentverse Platform](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20570)
*Robin Dey,Panyanon Viradecha*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文通过对Agentverse平台的实证审计，系统分析了当前AI代理基础设施的现状与不足，提出了七层代理云架构和五个关键演进路径，为实现2030年代的代理原生Web4愿景提供了技术蓝图。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着自主AI代理成为数字基础设施的一等公民，现有研究主要关注代理行为与推理能力，却忽视了支持大规模可靠运行所需的基础设施。亟需对当前代理云平台的成熟度与能力缺口进行系统性评估，以指导未来基础设施发展。

Method: 对Fetch.ai开发的Agentverse平台进行实证审计（Q1 2026），编目204个API端点，分析运营状态；基于审计结果构建能力缺口分类体系（8大类62项缺失能力），并据此提出七层代理云栈参考架构和五个关键演进路径。

Result: 识别出62项缺失能力，涵盖代理记忆、可观测性、安全、经济原语和企业扩展等8大类别；提出了完整代理原生云所需的七层架构规范，以及从临时存储到代理记忆云、从关键词发现到语义信任加权DNS、从单协议到多标准代理通用语言、从单实例到Kubernetes编排、从简单代币支付到丰富代理经济原语的五大演进路径。

Conclusion: 当前代理基础设施仍存在显著能力缺口，亟需系统性演进以支撑2030年代代理原生Web4的发展。本文为代理云平台的未来发展提供了诊断分析与技术路线图。

Abstract: The emergence of autonomous AI agents as first-class participants in digital infrastructure marks a fundamental inflection point in the evolution of the Web. While significant research has been directed at agent behaviour and reasoning, comparatively little attention has been paid to the infrastructure those agents require to operate reliably at scale. This paper addresses that gap with a systematic analysis of Agentverse, the agent cloud platform developed by Fetch.ai under the Artificial Superintelligence (ASI) Alliance, which represents one of the most mature production deployments of agent-native infrastructure available today.
  We make three principal contributions. First, we conduct an empirical audit of the Agentverse platform, cataloguing 204 API endpoints (Q1 2026) and characterising what is operational, partially deployed, or absent. From this audit we derive a Gap Taxonomy of eight categories encompassing 62 distinct missing capabilities, ranging from agent memory and observability to security, economic primitives, and enterprise scaling. Second, we propose a seven-layer Agent Cloud Stack -- a reference architecture for what a fully realised agent-native cloud should provide by 2030, grounded in the specific gaps we identify. Third, we characterise five critical evolution paths: from ephemeral storage to a full Agent Memory Cloud; from keyword discovery to a semantic, trust-weighted Agent DNS; from a single-protocol model to a multi-standard agent lingua franca; from single-instance hosting to Kubernetes-scale orchestration; and from simple token payments to rich agent economic primitives.
  Together these contributions provide a diagnostic of current agent infrastructure and a technically grounded vision for what the agent cloud must become to support the agentic web -- Web4 -- by 2030.

</details>


### [314] [AONA: A Comprehensive Architecture and Workflow Design for Global Agentic Collaboration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20573)
*Jinliang Xu,Runkai Zhu,Bingqi Li,Fanjie Nie,Jin Li,Jiagui Xie*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文提出了AONA（智能体覆盖网络架构），这是一种面向智能体互联网的新型覆盖网络架构，通过四层逻辑蓝图和分布式节点基础设施解决现有互联网基础设施缺乏语义感知、动态能力发现和去中心化信任机制的问题，为全球智能体协作提供可扩展、安全的基础。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有互联网基础设施（TCP/IP和DNS）主要面向人类中心化的主机间数据传输，缺乏自主智能体交互所需的语义感知、动态能力发现和去中心化信任机制，同时单一厂商的封闭生态系统限制了智能体协作的发展。

Method: 提出AONA架构，采用四层逻辑蓝图设计：基础层、互联层、协作层和应用层，实现跨协议和跨平台互操作性；构建分布式节点基础设施，包括管理根节点、注册服务节点、发现服务节点和企业智能服务中心；设计零信任身份发放、全局语义分类同步、意图驱动语义发现和可信计量等动态运营工作流。

Result: 成功构建了一个完整的多智能体协作网络架构，提供了跨协议、跨平台互操作能力，在不破坏底层物理网络的前提下实现了语义感知、动态能力发现和去中心化信任机制，为全球智能体协作提供了理论支撑和技术实现方案。

Conclusion: AONA架构为未来全球智能体协作提供了稳健、可扩展和安全的基础设施，突破了单一厂商封闭生态系统的限制，证明了多智能体协作相比单一超级智能的理论优势，为智能体互联网的发展奠定了重要基础。

Abstract: The rapid advancement of Large Language Models (LLMs) has established autonomous agents as the core vehicles for artificial intelligence applications. However, existing Internet infrastructures, primarily relying on TCP/IP and DNS, are designed for human-centric, host-to-host data transmission, inherently lacking the semantic awareness, dynamic capability discovery, and decentralized trust mechanisms required for autonomous agent interactions. To address these limitations and break the closed ecosystems of single vendors, this paper proposes AONA (Agentic Overlay Network Architecture), a novel overlay network architecture for the Internet of Agents (IoA). We first provide a multi-disciplinary scientific defense for multi-agent collaboration, demonstrating its theoretical necessity over single super-intelligence through the lenses of organizational economics, scaling principles, and the Price of Anarchy. AONA is then structured as a four-layer logical blueprint comprising the Base, Interconnection, Collaboration, and Application layers, which facilitates cross-protocol and cross-platform interoperability without disrupting the underlying physical network. To physically instantiate this blueprint, we design a distributed node infrastructure anchored by Management Root Nodes, Registry Service Nodes, Discovery Service Nodes, and Enterprise Intelligent Service Hubs for private domain integration. Finally, we detail the dynamic operational workflows-including zero-trust identity issuance, globally coordinated semantic taxonomy synchronization, intent-driven semantic discovery, and trusted metering for commercial settlement-that drive the network. This comprehensive architecture provides a robust, scalable, and secure foundation for the future of global agentic collaboration.

</details>


### [315] [LLM-assisted gNB Parameter Configuration for Radio Access Network](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20574)
*Yao-Cong Dong,Maria Amparo Canaveras Galdon,Ari Uskudar,Kuntal Chowdhury,Edwin K. P. Chong,Ray-Guang Cheng*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于大语言模型（LLM）的自动化gNB参数配置纠错框架，通过合成数据生成管道训练模型，将纠错准确率从零样本基线的13.8%提升至92.7%，实现了无线接入网（RAN）中配置错误的自动诊断与修复。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: gNB参数配置错误是无线接入网（RAN）系统故障的常见原因，现有诊断与修复方法依赖人工分析复杂的网络日志，存在可扩展性差、效率低的问题。

Method: 提出一种LLM辅助的自动化配置框架，采用合成数据生成管道：基于可行配置和gNB技术文档，利用商业LLM生成修改后的配置并从错误日志中提取结构化推理轨迹，构建映射网络状态到纠正动作的训练数据，用于微调LLM。推理阶段结合检索增强生成（RAG）技术，从错误日志生成可部署的有效配置。

Result: 在OpenAirInterface（OAI）gNB测试平台的480个未见过的配置错误场景中验证，微调后的模型将纠错准确率从零样本基线的13.8%提升至85.4%，结合RAG进一步将准确率提升至92.7%。

Conclusion: 该框架能够实现无需人工干预的配置错误自动恢复，支持可扩展、自主的RAN运维，为下一代网络的智能化管理提供了有效解决方案。

Abstract: gNB parameter misconfigurations are a common cause of system failures in radio access networks (RANs), and their diagnosis and correction rely on manual analysis of complex network logs that does not scale well. This paper proposes a large language model (LLM)-assisted framework for automatic gNB parameter configuration. The framework adopts a synthetic data generation pipeline following a configuration, log, correction workflow. Starting from a workable configuration and the gNB technical references, the pipeline uses a commercial LLM to generate modified configurations and derive structured reasoning traces from gNB error logs. The synthetic training data maps network states to corrective actions and is used to fine-tune an LLM for configuration correction. During inference, the fine-tuned LLM generates valid and deployable gNB parameter configurations from gNB error logs. The framework is validated on an OpenAirInterface (OAI) gNB testbed with 480 unseen misconfiguration scenarios, where fine-tuning improves correction accuracy from 13.8% (zero-shot baseline) to 85.4%, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) further improves accuracy to 92.7%. The results demonstrate that the framework may enable automated recovery from misconfigurations without manual intervention and supports scalable and autonomous RAN operation.

</details>


### [316] [BACC: Budget-Aware Calibration and Control for Horizontal Autoscaling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20575)
*Fan Liu,Guanqi Li,Behrooz Farkiani,Patrick Crowley*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 提出了BACC框架，一种预算感知的水平自动伸缩方法，通过在线校准工作负载不确定性和基于预算消耗速率的反馈控制，实现了对违反目标的精确跟踪。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的水平自动伸缩策略要么响应瞬时利用率，要么针对固定预测风险目标进行配置，未明确考虑周期级违反预算的消耗情况，导致在预算充足时过于保守，在预算枯竭时又不够保守。

Method: BACC框架将三个关注点分离：工作负载预测、在线不确定性校准和预算调节的容量控制。它将任意预测器与自适应共形推理(ACI)结合，在线校准工作负载不确定性，然后使用比例-积分(PI)控制器根据观察到的预算消耗速度来调整配置的激进程度。

Result: 在五个Azure Functions追踪数据、三个合规级别和两个预测后端的评估中，BACC紧密跟踪请求的违反目标，使用ARIMA和Chronos分别实现了0.44和0.42个百分点的平均绝对合规差距。Kubernetes实验进一步显示，在测量延迟和副本就绪等部署效应下，该控制器相比原生HPA改善了CPU阈值合规性。

Conclusion: BACC成功实现了预算感知的水平自动伸缩，通过模型无关的框架设计，能够精确控制违反目标，并在实际部署环境中展现出优于传统方法的性能。

Abstract: Cloud services must continuously adapt replica counts to fluctuating demand while respecting fixed-period reliability budgets. Many horizontal autoscalers either react to instantaneous utilization or provision against a fixed predictive risk target. These policies do not explicitly account for how much of the period-level violation budget has already been consumed, so they can be overly conservative when the budget is healthy and insufficiently conservative when the budget is being depleted. We present BACC, a model-agnostic framework for budget-aware horizontal autoscaling. BACC separates three concerns that are often entangled in prior systems: workload prediction, online uncertainty calibration, and budget-paced capacity control. It wraps an arbitrary forecaster with Adaptive Conformal Inference (ACI) to calibrate workload uncertainty online, then uses a proportional--integral controller to adjust provisioning aggressiveness based on the observed pace of budget consumption. We instantiate BACC for CPU-threshold-based horizontal autoscaling in Kubernetes and evaluate it through trace-driven simulation and cluster replay experiments. Across five Azure Functions traces, three compliance levels, and two forecasting backends, BACC tracks the requested violation target closely, achieving mean absolute compliance gaps of 0.44 and 0.42 percentage points with ARIMA and Chronos, respectively. The Kubernetes experiments further show that the same controller improves CPU-threshold compliance over native HPA under deployment effects such as measurement delay and replica readiness.

</details>


### [317] [Exploring LLM in Semantic Communication for V2X Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20576)
*Sihem Bakri,Navdeep Singh,Nicola Marchetti*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 该研究提出了一个融合大语言模型(LLM)和基于图的知识表示的语义通信框架，用于车联网(V2X)通信，相比传统原始数据传输方式，平均减少了33.54%的数据传输量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着联网和自动驾驶车辆的快速发展，传统V2X网络依赖传输原始传感器数据，导致带宽占用高且信息交换冗余，迫切需要更高效、智能的通信系统。

Method: 提出语义通信框架，利用大语言模型(LLM)进行语义转换，将结构化传感器输入转换为简洁的自然语言消息描述上下文和意图，并基于V2X网络中共享的情境感知生成高级控制决策，仅传输有意义的高级消息而非原始数据。

Result: 在多车道交通仿真实验中，语义通信模式相比非语义模式平均减少了33.54%的数据传输量，并在代表性场景中展示了情境感知的协调能力。

Conclusion: 该语义通信框架成功实现了V2X网络中的高效数据传输和智能协调，证明了通过传输高级语义消息替代原始数据可以有效降低带宽使用，为智能交通系统提供了新的通信范式。

Abstract: The rapid growth of connected and autonomous vehicles has created a demand for more efficient and intelligent communication systems. Traditional Vehicle-to-Everything (V2X) networks rely on transmitting raw sensor data, leading to high bandwidth usage and redundant information exchange. To address this, we propose a semantic communication framework that integrates a Large Language Model (LLM) with graph-based knowledge representation, to transmit only high-level, meaningful messages instead of raw data. Within this framework, the LLM performs semantic transformation, converting structured sensor inputs into concise natural language messages that describe context and intent. It also generates high-level control decisions based on shared situational awareness across the V2X network. A multilane traffic simulation was developed to compare semantic and non-semantic modes in terms of bandwidth usage. Results show an average 33.54% reduction in data transmission and illustrate context-aware coordination in representative scenarios.

</details>


### [318] [Human-Less LLM Serving: Quantifying the Human Tax on Throughput](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20577)
*Jianhui Lian,Li Chen,Dan Li,Yong Jiang*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文发现现有LLM服务系统为满足人类用户的延迟SLO（TTFT/TPOT），在程序化调用的长周期AI任务中造成了60-93%的吞吐量损失（人类税），建议服务系统应区分工作负载类型并暴露相应的SLA配置。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM服务系统普遍针对人类用户感知延迟（TTFT和TPOT）设计SLO机制，但越来越多的AI任务通过程序化方式在紧密循环中调用LLM，不存在人类观察者。作者旨在量化这些工作负载为满足不必要的延迟SLO所牺牲的吞吐量。

Method: 跨多个维度（chunk大小、SLO设置、上下文长度、并发级别）进行系统性测量研究，对比SGLang和Sarathi-Serve两个系统，分析在人类延迟约束与无约束基线下的吞吐量差异。

Result: "人类税"随上下文长度显著增长，在60-93%范围内；在64K token上下文时，生产级TTFT SLO设置导致吞吐量大幅下降；更高并发下人类税更大；该现象在SGLang和Sarathi-Serve中定性相似。

Conclusion: 提出"无人类服务"（human-less serving）概念并提供原型验证其可行性，主张服务系统应暴露工作负载类别感知的SLA配置，而非对所有流量统一施加人类税。

Abstract: Every major LLM serving system is designed to meet TTFT and TPOT SLOs. These metrics capture latency as a human user perceives it, and the mechanisms built to satisfy them are now standard infrastructure. We observe that long-horizon AI tasks call LLMs programmatically in tight loops where no human observes TTFT or TPOT. We ask: how much throughput do serving systems sacrifice to meet TTFT and TPOT SLAs that these workloads never need? We conduct a systematic measurement study across chunk sizes, SLO settings, context lengths, and concurrency levels. We find that the human tax on throughput grows substantially with context length and lands in the 60-93% range. At 64K token contexts, tightening the TTFT SLO to production-typical settings costs a large fraction of throughput versus the human-less baseline. The human tax is larger at higher concurrency and is qualitatively similar across SGLang and Sarathi-Serve. We term the unconstrained optimum human-less serving and provide a prototype demonstrating that it is practical on real workloads. Our findings argue that serving systems should expose workload-class-aware SLA configurations rather than silently applying the human tax uniformly to all traffic.

</details>


### [319] [RL-based Joint Coverage and Beam Optimization of High Altitude Platform Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20578)
*Guilhem Loussouarn,Nancy Nayak,Kin K. Leung,Patrick J. Baker*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于多策略近端策略优化（PPO）的强化学习框架，用于联合优化6G网络中高空平台（HAPS）的位置部署和波束分配，以适应时空变化的用户分布和流量需求。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高空平台系统（HAPS）作为6G网络架构的重要组成部分，具有独特的“移动自由度”，区别于静态地面网络和轨道受限的卫星通信。这种固有的机动性为解决非平稳性、时空用户分布和流量动态（如周期性人口迁移）提供了强有力的机制。然而，如何有效利用HAPS的移动性来优化网络性能仍面临挑战。

Method: 提出了一种强化学习（RL）框架，采用多策略近端策略优化（PPO）方法，解决三个关键优化问题：（a）HAPS定位以实现最佳覆盖，（b）波束分配，（c）覆盖与波束分配的联合优化。该框架能够在多HAPS场景下运行，联合学习HAPS定位和波束分配策略。

Result: 仿真结果表明，所提出的基于RL的方法能够有效学习控制HAPS定位和资源分配，动态适应用户分布和流量模式的变化。联合优化方法在总速率和用户满意度方面显著优于启发式基准方法，证明了动态利用HAPS移动性可以创建高度响应和高效的下一代网络。

Conclusion: 通过利用HAPS的动态移动性并采用多策略PPO强化学习方法，可以成功实现HAPS定位和波束分配的联合优化，从而创建高度响应和高效的下一代网络。所提出的框架能够有效适应时空流量需求变化，显著提升网络性能。

Abstract: High Altitude Platform Systems (HAPS) are a promising component of 6G network architectures, offering a unique "freedom of movement" that distinguishes them from static terrestrial networks (TN) and orbit-constrained satellite communications. This inherent mobility for HAPS provides a powerful mechanism to address non-stationarity, spatio-temporal user distributions, and traffic dynamics, such as periodic population migrations. This work addresses three key optimization problems in HAPS networks: (a) HAPS positioning for optimal coverage, (b) beam allocation, and (c) joint optimization of coverage and beam allocation. To tackle these complex challenges, a Reinforcement Learning (RL) framework is proposed, capable of operating in scenarios with multiple HAPS. The results demonstrate that the RL-based approach effectively learns to control HAPS positioning and resource allocation, dynamically adapting to variations in user distributions and traffic patterns. In particular, by employing a multi-policy Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) approach, the proposed framework jointly learns HAPS positioning and allocating beams under spatio-temporal traffic demand variations and outperforms heuristic baselines. Simulation results demonstrate that our joint optimization approach significantly improves sum-rate and user satisfaction, showing that the dynamic mobility of HAPS can be successfully exploited to create highly responsive and efficient next-generation networks.

</details>


### [320] [Closed-Loop L4S-as-a-Service in 5G-Advanced: NEF-PCF Control with NWDAF-Driven Assurance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20579)
*Ameer Shohail L,Ashish Goswami*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文提出了C-L4SaaS架构，通过编排5G核心网功能（NEF、PCF、NWDAF），将L4S的低延迟能力转化为可闭环管理的服务，实现了从应用意图到服务质量验证的自动化保障。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 5G-Advanced中的超低延迟业务需要确定性延迟保障。虽然L4S架构能实现亚毫秒级排队，但在5G核心网（5GC）中的集成仍处于功能孤岛状态。当前的3GPP标准提供了启用L4S的机制，但缺乏将应用意图与验证的服务结果联系起来的统一闭环框架。

Method: 提出闭环L4S即服务（C-L4SaaS）架构框架，协调网络开放功能（NEF）、策略控制功能（PCF）和网络数据分析功能（NWDAF）。该框架将高层意图转化为可执行的PCC规则，利用源自用户面功能（UPF）测量数据的NWDAF合规分析来触发有界的策略调整。同时将此交互建模为离散时间反馈系统，推导稳定性条件和信令开销边界。

Result: 成功建立了核心网驱动的编排机制，推导出了在多变无线条件下指导参数选择的稳定性条件和信令开销界限，为5G-Advanced生态系统中的托管低延迟服务提供了暴露、保障和治理的标准对齐路径。

Conclusion: C-L4SaaS框架填补了当前标准空白，为5G-Advanced网络提供了一条符合标准的路径，能够有效暴露、保障和治理托管低延迟服务，实现从应用意图到验证服务结果的自动化闭环保障。

Abstract: Ultra-low latency services in 5G-Advanced demand deterministic delay and high-fidelity congestion signaling beyond peak throughput. While the Low Latency, Low Loss, Scalable Throughput (L4S) architecture enables sub-millisecond queuing through ECN-based feedback and Dual-Queue Coupled AQM, its integration within the 5G Core (5GC) remains functionally siloed. Current 3GPP Release 18/19 specifications provide mechanisms for L4S enablement, but they do not define a unified closed-loop framework that links application intent to verified service outcomes. To address this gap, we propose Closed-Loop L4S-as-a-Service (C-L4SaaS), an architectural framework that orchestrates the Network Exposure Function (NEF), Policy Control Function (PCF), and Network Data Analytics Function (NWDAF) for automated latency assurance. The framework translates high-level intent into enforceable PCC rules and uses NWDAF-driven compliance analytics, derived from User Plane Function (UPF) measurements, to trigger bounded policy adaptations. We model this interaction as a discrete-time feedback system and derive stability conditions and signaling overhead bounds to guide parameter selection under volatile wireless conditions. The proposed core-driven orchestration provides a standards-aligned path to expose, assure, and govern managed low-latency services in 5G-Advanced ecosystems.

</details>


### [321] [Role-Based Agentic AI for Intent-Driven Network and Service Orchestration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20580)
*Juan Parra-Ullauri,Talha Ahmed Khan,Daniel McHugh,Shipra Kapoor,Alistair Duke,Alicia Hey,Andy Corston-Petrie*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于角色的多智能体架构（MAS），用于端到端的意图编排，通过分层代理系统弥合BSS-OSS鸿沟，实现从业务意图到网络实施的自主协调。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电信网络因异构技术、多样化服务需求以及对资源效率和业务敏捷性的要求而日益复杂。现有的基于意图的网络（IBN）和代理AI方法主要局限于运营支撑系统（OSS）内的运营编排，缺乏跨越业务支撑系统（BSS）和OSS的集成框架，限制了真正的意图-业务-网络协调的实现。

Method: 提出一种镜像通信服务提供商（CSP）组织结构的基于角色的多智能体架构。该框架采用功能分解、明确任务所有权、隐私保护域分离和领域专业知识原则，构建了一个分层四层代理系统，涵盖客户参与、战略规划、服务交付和基础设施供应。领导代理协调规划活动，专业服务和资源代理根据意图需求动态实例化。

Result: 概念验证实现证明了通过结构化代理协调弥合BSS-OSS鸿沟的可行性，展示了代理MAS如何支持可问责且可扩展的意图驱动服务编排。

Conclusion: 所提出的基于角色的多智能体架构成功实现了跨越BSS和OSS的端到端意图编排，为电信网络自主管理提供了可行的解决方案，支持可扩展的意图驱动服务编排。

Abstract: Telecommunication networks are increasingly complex due to heterogeneous technologies, diverse service requirements, and growing demands for resource efficiency and business agility. Intent-Based Networking (IBN) and, more recently, agentic AI have emerged as promising paradigms to address this complexity through autonomous network management. However, existing approaches primarily focus on operational orchestration within Operations Support Systems (OSS) and lack an integrated framework that spans Business Support Systems (BSS) and OSS, limiting the realisation of true intent-to-business-to-network coordination.
  This paper presents a role-based multi-agent architecture (MAS) for end-to-end intent orchestration that mirrors Communication Service Provider (CSP) organisational structures. The proposed framework applies principles of functional decomposition, explicit task ownership, privacy-preserving domain separation, and domain-specific expertise within a hierarchical four-layer agent system spanning customer engagement, strategic planning, service delivery, and infrastructure provisioning. Leadership agents coordinate planning activities, whilst specialised service and resource agents are dynamically instantiated according to intent requirements.
  A proof-of-concept implementation demonstrates the feasibility of bridging the BSS-OSS divide through structured agent coordination, illustrating how agentic MAS can support accountable and scalable intent-driven service orchestration.

</details>


### [322] [RDMACell: Token-Based Flowcell-Level RDMA Load Balancing for Large-Scale AI Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20581)
*Yang Qinyuan,Hua Xiaoxiang,Zhang Tong,Ren Fengyuan*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: RDMACell是一种主机端流单元级负载均衡系统，通过主动拆分流并利用原子双工作队列元素实现微秒级路径切换，在不修改NIC固件或交换机硬件的情况下，显著降低了尾延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RDMA默认的ECMP负载均衡机制因哈希冲突和大象流导致性能严重下降。现有方案存在明显局限：flowlet方法缺乏必要的时间间隙触发切换，数据包级方法会导致严重的包重排序问题，而可编程网络方案难以在商业通用基础设施中部署。

Method: 提出RDMACell主机端流单元级负载均衡系统，主动将流拆分为多个流单元(flowcell)并分配到多条路径；采用原子双工作队列元素(WQEs)实现实时反馈；利用基于令牌的接收端控制机制实现微秒级路径切换，无需修改NIC固件或交换机硬件。

Result: 在fat-tree拓扑的ns-3仿真中，80%网络负载和全对全流量下，相比ECMP降低99th百分位FCT 44%，相比LetFlow降低42.2%；尾延迟性能与最先进的网络内解决方案相当。

Conclusion: RDMACell成功在主机端实现了高效、可部署的RDMA负载均衡方案，在不修改硬件的前提下达到了与网络内方案相当的延迟性能，为商业数据中心提供了一种实用的解决方案。

Abstract: Remote Direct Memory Access (RDMA) is a core technol ogy for high-performance data center networks. However, its default Equal-Cost Multi-Path (ECMP) load-balancing mechanism often suffers from severe performance degra dation due to hash collisions and elephant flows. Existing solutions have obvious limitations: flowlet-based approaches lack the necessary time gaps to trigger flowlet switching, while packet-level approaches suffer from severe packet re ordering problems. On the other hand, although in-network programmable solutions can achieve fine-grained control, they are difficult to deploy in commercial general-purpose infrastructures. This paper presents RDMACell, a host-side flowcell-level load-balancing system. It proactively splits flows into mul tiple flowcells, distributes them across multiple paths, and achievesreal-timefeedbackthroughatomicdualWorkQueue Elements (WQEs). With token-based receiver-side control, RDMACellenables microsecond-level path switching and ex tremely low packet loss without modifying NIC firmware or switch hardware. The ns-3 simulations in a fat-tree topology show that under 80% network load with all-to-all traffic, RD MACell reduces 99th percentile FCT by 44% compared with ECMPandby42.2% compared with LetFlow, while achiev ing tail latency performance comparable to state-of-the-art in-network solutions

</details>


### [323] [Communication-Semantic-Aware RDMA Loss Recovery for QP-scalable Hyperscale AI Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20582)
*Xiaoxiang Hua,Tong Zhang,Zhenjiang Dong,Kun Zhu,Jiakun Bao,Fengyuan Ren*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文提出CSA-UD，一种面向AI训练的RDMA丢包恢复机制，通过解耦数据传输与丢包恢复、利用分布式训练的同步语义，实现了可扩展性与可靠性的统一，在高负载下99分位流完成时间降低超过30%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前AI基础设施广泛采用RDMA支持高性能通信，训练万亿参数模型时频繁的集合通信产生大量RDMA流量。现有RDMA部署主要使用可靠连接(RC)模型，每对进程需要专用的队列对(QP)，导致可扩展性差——RNIC仅能缓存数千个QP，超出的条目会触发PCIe往返延迟惩罚。同时，全局同步机制使得训练对尾延迟敏感，少量丢包就会延迟迭代完成。

Method: 提出通信语义感知不可靠数据报(CSA-UD)机制：(1)将数据传输与丢包恢复解耦；(2)动态调整丢包检测间隔，加速尾部恢复并利用分布式训练的同步语义；(3)支持多路径传输和位图引导的重组，无需无损网络架构即可实现高吞吐量。

Result: 实验平台测试和ns-3仿真表明：在大规模集合通信下，CSA-UD显著降低了尾延迟；在高网络负载下，相比RC具有更好的可扩展性；与对比方案相比，99分位流完成时间降低了30%以上。

Conclusion: CSA-UD成功解决了大规模AI训练中RDMA通信的可扩展性与可靠性矛盾，通过语义感知的设计实现了性能突破，为未来AI基础设施的网络优化提供了新思路。

Abstract: Current artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructures widely adopt Remote Direct Memory Access (RDMA) to support high-performance communication. Training trillion-parameter models involves frequent collective communication operations, such as All-Reduce and All-to-All, which generate intensive RDMA traffic. Existing RDMA deployments predominantly use the reliable connection (RC) model, where each process pair requires a dedicated queue pair (QP). This leads to poor scalability: since the RDMA-capable network interface card (RNIC) can cache only a few thousand QPs, excess entries trigger PCIe round-trip penalties. Meanwhile, global synchronization makes training sensitive to tail latency, where a few packet losses can delay iteration completion. To address these challenges, we propose Communication-Semantic-Aware Unreliable Datagram (CSA-UD), a novel RDMA loss recovery mechanism that combines scalability and reliability. CSA-UD decouples data transmission from loss recovery and dynamically adjusts the loss detection interval, accelerating tail recovery and exploiting the synchronization semantics of distributed training. It further supports multipath transmission and bitmap-guided reassembly, enabling high throughput without requiring lossless fabrics. Testbed experiments and ns-3 simulations show that CSA-UD significantly reduces tail latency under large-scale collective communication. Under high network load, it achieves better scalability than RC and over 30% lower 99th percentile flow completion times compared with counterparts.

</details>


### [324] [Physical-AI: From Channel Awareness to Environmental Intelligence in 6G Wireless Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20583)
*Farooque Hassan Kumbhar,Kapal Dev,Sunder Ali Khowaja,Alexandros-Apostolos A. Boulogeorgos,Mehdi Bennis,Yuanwei Liu*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 提出Physical-AI架构，通过自监督时空无线基础模型将分布式无线电观测转化为环境表征，实现感知、建模与决策的闭环集成，在6G系统中有效降低中断概率和阻塞响应延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统无线网络依赖瞬时CSI且缺乏物理环境显式建模，难以应对动态部署中的阻塞、移动和干扰问题；现有ISAC范式虽具备感知能力但缺乏显式环境建模与决策机制。

Method: 提出Physical-AI架构：(1)自监督时空无线基础模型将分布式无线电观测转换为共享潜在环境表征；(2)多个推理头基于该表征估计阻塞、用户分布、移动动态和干扰结构等环境属性；(3)任务特定神经决策层将表征映射为主动、上下文感知的控制动作。

Result: 仿真结果表明，该预测框架降低了中断概率和阻塞响应延迟，尤其是在波束切换延迟增加的情况下性能提升显著。

Conclusion: Physical-AI通过集成感知、世界建模和决策形成闭环，超越了ISAC范式，为智能6G系统提供了有前景的架构方案。

Abstract: Conventional wireless networks rely on instantaneous channel state information (CSI) and react to channel variations without explicitly modeling the physical environment, limiting their ability to handle blockage, mobility, and interference in dynamic deployments. Paradigms such as Integrated Sensing and Communication (ISAC) add sensing capabilities but lack explicit environment modeling and decision-making. In this article, we propose Physical-AI: a new architecture for environment-aware wireless networking, where radio signals enable sensing, modeling, and interaction with the environment in addition to data transmission. The framework proposes a self-supervised spatiotemporal radio foundation model for transforming distributed radio observations into a shared latent environmental representation. Multiple inference heads operate on this representation to estimate key environmental properties, including blockage, user distribution, mobility dynamics, and interference structure. A task-specific neural decision layer maps this representation to proactive, context-aware control actions. By integrating perception, world modeling, and decision-making in a closed loop, the proposed framework goes beyond ISAC and establishes Physical-AI as a promising architecture for intelligent 6G systems. Simulation results show that the proposed predictive framework reduces outage probability and blockage-response latency, particularly under increasing beam-switching delays.

</details>


### [325] [Protocol-Aware Tokenization and Architecture Co-Design for Wireless Packet Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20587)
*Swadhin Pradhan,Shazal Irshad,Jerome Henry*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 协议感知分词器是无线数据包基础模型性能的主要驱动力，其影响远大于架构选择；分词器改变带来32个百分点的准确率差异，而架构改变仅带来2个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究在构建无线数据包追踪基础模型时，分词器和架构哪个因素更为重要，以指导模型设计决策。

Method: 基于PLUME协议感知分词方法，扩展模型深度至24层（PLUME-DEEP），并迁移到Mamba-2状态空间架构（PLUME-MAMBA），通过2×2对照实验系统比较分词器和架构对性能的影响。
