Result: PLUME-DEEP达到98.2% top-1准确率，较原始12层设计提升32个百分点；PLUME-MAMBA达到96.1%准确率，吞吐量提升1.7倍，上下文长度扩展2倍。对照实验显示：改变分词器导致32个百分点的准确率波动，改变架构仅导致2个百分点的波动。

Conclusion: 协议感知分词是提升模型性能的主要杠杆，架构选择可作为部署时的调节旋钮，用于在准确率和推理速度之间进行权衡。

Abstract: What matters more for building foundation models for wireless packet traces: the tokenizer or the architecture or both? To answer this question, we build on PLUME Anonymous [2026], which introduced protocol-aware tokenization for 802.11 traces; we scale model depth and transfer the same tokenizer to a fundamentally different architecture family. A deeper GPT (PLUME-DEEP, 24 layers) reaches 98.2% top-1 accuracy, gaining 32 points over the original 12-layer design, while a Mamba-2 state-space variant (PLUME-MAMBA) achieves 96.1% with 1.7x higher throughput and 2x longer context. The key insight emerges from a controlled 2x2 comparison across tokenizers and architectures: changing the tokenizer swings accuracy by 32 points; changing the architecture moves it by only 2. Protocol-aware tokenization is the primary performance lever, and the backbone becomes a deployment knob trading accuracy for speed.

</details>


### [326] [Optimization-as-a-Service via Multi-Agent Large Language Model for Radio Access Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20590)
*Chaoqun You,Yueyue Dai,Xingqiu He,Yue Gao,Rahim Tafazolli,Yong Liang Guan*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文提出基于大语言模型多智能体系统的优化即服务框架，通过智能体动态构建优化问题实现6G无线接入网物理资源块分配，并引入一次性反思蒸馏机制在保证近最优性能的同时实现超低推理延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统物理资源块分配依赖逐案手工建模或标准AI算法，面对6G无线接入网中前所未有的服务多样性、基站与用户规模的指数级动态变化以及严格的QoS要求时，这些方法缺乏灵活性和自适应演化能力，无法有效应对波动剧烈的网络环境。

Method: 将PRB分配问题重构为大语言模型多智能体系统提供的优化即服务：构建包含场景理解、目标生成、求解器和反思智能体的闭环架构，实现上下文感知和自我修正的问题建模；为消除迭代反思的计算延迟，提出一次性反思蒸馏机制，训练轻量级学生模型直接预测优化目标参数。

Result: 理论分析给出了一次性策略的性能差距上界；实验结果表明该框架在超低推理延迟下实现了近最优的资源分配性能。

Conclusion: 该工作为6G RAN资源分配提供了统一的即服务解决方案，证明了LLM多智能体系统在动态网络优化中的有效性，为复杂通信网络的自适应资源管理开辟了新方向。

Abstract: The physical resource block (PRB) allocation in Radio Access Networks (RANs) traditionally relies on case-by-case manual problem construction or, more recently, learning-based artificial intelligence (AI) methods. However, the sixth-generation (6G) RAN environments confront unprecedented service diversity and exponential dynamics, featuring volatile fluctuations in active base stations (BSs), user scale, and stringent Quality-of-Service (QoS) requirements. Faced with such conditions, both manual models and standard AI algorithms remain fundamentally rigid, lacking the flexibility to adapt and self-evolve. To provide a one-size-fits-all solution, we propose treating the PRB allocation problem as an Optimization-as-a-Service (OaaS) provided by a large language model multi-agent (LLM-MA) system. This fundamentally reshapes RAN resource allocation by utilizing agents to dynamically construct optimization problems and automatically determine objectives tailored to real-time scenarios. Our closed-loop architecture, integrating scene understanding, objective generation, solver, and reflection agents, enables context-aware, self-correcting formulation. To eliminate the computational latency of iterative reflection, we introduce a one-shot reflection distillation mechanism, training a lightweight student model to directly predict refined objective parameters. We theoretically bound the performance gap of this one-shot policy. Experimental results demonstrate our framework achieves near-optimal resource allocation with ultra-low inference latency.

</details>


### [327] [Delay-Adaptive Speculation Control for Low-Latency Edge-Cloud LLM Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20591)
*Kangkang Sun,Jianhua Li,Xiuzhen Chen,Junyi He,Minyi Guo*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文针对分布式边缘云推理中的投机解码问题，通过理论分析与在线学习算法实现了草稿长度的自适应控制，在真实测试平台上将每词元延迟降低了高达22.4%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在分布式边缘云推理场景下，投机解码的草稿长度需要在通信延迟与接受率之间权衡：长草稿可摊薄通信开销但降低接受率，短草稿保持接受率但增加通信轮次。现有方法缺乏对这一动态权衡的理论建模与在线自适应控制。

Method: 将该权衡建模为比率型最优停止问题，证明了最优草稿长度为有限延迟单调阈值；针对时变网络扩展至马尔可夫调制信道并建立状态依赖阈值策略；针对未知环境提出UCB-SpecStop在线控制算法，并在Jetson Orin Nano边缘节点与RTX 3090 Ti云节点的真实测试平台上实现，使用Qwen和Llama草稿-目标模型对进行验证。

Result: 理论分析揭示了临界延迟阈值，最优长度仅与通信延迟呈对数增长；实验验证了预测的相变行为（过渡点约83ms和111ms）；UCB-SpecStop相比SpecDec++降低延迟高达22.4%，在通信主导场景下离线最优策略差距仅0.2-2.4%，相比朴素UCB提升达7.5%，消除静态调优在延迟漂移下14.0-18.7%的性能损失，利用信道状态信息额外提升3.0-6.8%。

Conclusion: 投机解码的最优草稿长度可通过理论分析确定，结合在线学习算法可实现高效自适应控制，为分布式边缘云LLM推理优化提供了理论框架与实用解决方案。

Abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model (LLM) inference by using a lightweight draft model to propose tokens and a larger target model to verify them in parallel. In distributed edge-cloud inference, however, draft length must be controlled online: longer drafts amortize communication delay but reduce token acceptance, whereas shorter drafts preserve acceptance but trigger more communication rounds. We formulate this tradeoff as a ratio-type optimal stopping problem and prove that the optimal draft length is a finite delay-monotone threshold. The analysis identifies a critical delay below which single-token speculation is optimal and shows that the optimal length grows only logarithmically with communication delay. For time-varying networks, we extend the model to Markov-modulated channels and establish, under a bounded horizon and monotone stopping-region conditions, a state-dependent threshold policy. For unknown environments, we propose UCB-SpecStop, an online control algorithm with gap-free and gap-dependent expected regret bounds of $O(L_{\max}\sqrt{K_{\max}T\log(K_{\max}T)})$ and $O(\sum_{k:Δ_k>0}L_{\max}^2\log(K_{\max}T)/Δ_k)$. We implement the method on a real edge-cloud testbed with a Jetson Orin Nano Super edge node and an RTX~3090 Ti cloud node, using Qwen and Llama draft--target pairs. Experiments validate the predicted phase transition, with transition points near 83~ms and 111~ms. Qwen matches the geometric prediction, while Llama requires empirical-prefix calibration due to heavy-head acceptance. Across the tested delay grid, UCB-SpecStop reduces per-token latency over SpecDec++ by up to 22.4\%, approaches an offline oracle within 0.2--2.4\% in communication-dominated regimes, improves over naive UCB by up to 7.5\%, removes the 14.0--18.7\% gap caused by static tuning under delay drift, and gains 3.0--6.8\% with contextual channel-state information.

</details>


### [328] [Empowering Embodied AI in 6G Networks: Architecture, Enablers, and Open Challenges](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20592)
*Junaid Sajid,Sheikh Salman Hassan,Wenshuai Liu,Yan Kyaw Tun,Yaru Fu,Nguyen H. Tran,Zhu Han,Cedomir Stefanovic,Tharmalingam Ratnarajah,Muhammad Mahtab Alam*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个面向具身AI原生的6G系统整体框架，将通信、感知、计算和控制统一设计为闭环基础设施，以支持大规模任务驱动的具身智能，主张未来6G系统应从智能通信平台演进为具身物理智能的主动赋能者。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 具身AI（如机器人、自动驾驶车辆、XR设备）通过感知-通信-动作（PCA）闭环交互在动态物理环境中运行，其通信性能直接影响物理行为、控制稳定性和任务成功。然而，现有AI原生无线架构仍以连接为中心，无法大规模支持任务驱动的具身智能。

Method: 提出了一个具身AI原生6G系统的整体框架，将通信、感知、计算和控制联合设计为统一的闭环基础设施；引入了系统级PCA架构，讨论了关键使能技术和代表性应用。

Result: 建立了具身AI原生6G系统的理论框架，识别了多模态智能、边缘感知部署、评估、可信度和实际实现等方面的主要开放挑战。

Conclusion: 未来6G系统必须从智能通信平台演进为具身物理智能的主动赋能者，以支持大规模具身AI应用的发展。

Abstract: Embodied artificial intelligence (AI) is emerging as a key driver of the sixth-generation (6G) wireless networks by enabling agents that continuously perceive, communicate, and act in dynamic physical environments. Unlike conventional AI systems that process disembodied data, embodied agents such as robots, autonomous vehicles, and extended reality (XR) devices operate through closed-loop perception-communication-action (PCA) interactions, where communication performance directly affects physical behavior, control stability, and task success. However, existing AI-native wireless architectures remain largely connectivity-centric and are not designed to support task-driven embodied intelligence at large scale. Therefore, we present a holistic framework for embodied AI-native 6G systems, in which communication, sensing, computation, and control are jointly designed as a unified closed-loop infrastructure. We introduce a system-level PCA architecture, discuss key enabling technologies and representative applications, and highlight major open challenges in multimodal intelligence, edge-aware deployment, evaluation, trustworthiness, and practical implementation. Our central argument is that future 6G systems must evolve from intelligent communication platforms into active enablers of embodied physical intelligence.

</details>


### [329] [Performance evaluation of Secure DSRC (S-DSRC) protocol for Vehicular Adhoc Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20594)
*Surender Kumar,Vikram Singh*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种安全的专用短程通信协议（S-DSRC），通过密钥交换机制实现车辆间安全通信，在中型网络中性能优于现有DSRC协议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 车载自组网（VANETs）在高速公路等场景下为车辆间通信、事故报告、医院警报和保险理赔等提供重要支持，但现有网络连接技术（如4G/5G、IEEE 802.11p和DSRC）在安全性方面存在不足，缺乏有效的安全通信机制。

Method: 提出了一种安全的专用短程通信协议（S-DSRC），该协议在车辆之间实现了秘密密钥、私钥和公钥的交换机制，从而能够以安全的方式发送安全消息。

Result: 实验结果表明，在中型网络规模下，所提出的S-DSRC协议在性能上优于现有的DSRC协议。

Conclusion: S-DSRC协议成功实现了车辆间的安全通信，为VANETs提供了更可靠的安全保障，证明了该方法在车联网安全通信领域的有效性和实用价值。

Abstract: Vehicular adhoc networks (VANETs) provides communication between the vehicles like V2V and also provides communication between the Vehicles and the Road side Units. Recently, VANETs have greater scope in establishing interconnectivity between the vehicles on road and off road. These networks ensure the timely report of accidents happening in highways, alerting the nearest hospital, insurance claims if the vehicle is breakdown, etc. Vehicles often travels in highways lack the network connectivity, which then can be ensured through many technology implementations like 4G, 5G, LTE networks and protocols like IEEE 802.11p and DSRC were helpful in achieving the effectiveness of vehicular networks. In this paper, we have proposed a protocol Secure Dedicated Short-Range Communication (S-DSRC) protocol that can establish connectivity between the vehicles in a secure way. There will be a secret key, private kay and public key exchange between the vehicles so that the safety message can be sent to vehicles in a secure way. Our results show that S-DSRC protocol outperforms the existing DSRC protocol for a medium sized network.

</details>


### [330] [Frequency Lock Encoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20813)
*Joshua Montierth,Michael Rice,Philip Lundrigan*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种协议无关的次级信令层，通过在现有通信信号中引入受控的小频率偏移，在同步余量带宽中嵌入并行信息流，实现主次通信共存且对主系统透明。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代无线系统为应对最坏情况预留了过量同步带宽，在常规条件下存在未被充分利用的同步余量，作者旨在挖掘这一冗余资源实现额外信息传输。

Method: 在现有通信信号中故意引入微小且可控的频率偏移，采用频移键控叠加层设计，确保偏移量在传统载波同步环的稳定工作范围内，从而被主接收机的载波频偏校正机制自然吸收。

Result: 针对单载波协议进行了系统分析，通过仿真和基于软件无线电的空中实验验证，结果表明次级通信可靠，对主链路性能影响可忽略不计。

Conclusion: 该方法实现了对遗留接收机的后向兼容与透明，适用于战术边缘的临时频谱共享和去中心化协调场景。

Abstract: Modern wireless systems are designed with excess synchronization bandwidth to ensure reliable operation under worst-case conditions. This paper presents a protocol-agnostic secondary signaling layer that exploits this unused synchronization margin by intentionally introducing small, controlled frequency offsets into an existing communication signal to embed a parallel stream of information. These offsets are naturally absorbed by the primary receiver's carrier frequency offset (CFO) correction mechanisms, allowing the primary data stream to remain intact while enabling simultaneous secondary communication. The proposed signaling method employs a frequency-shift-keyed overlay engineered to remain within the stable operating region of conventional carrier-synchronization loops, ensuring backward compatibility and transparency for legacy receivers. We analyze the system for single-carrier protocols, characterize the trade-offs between secondary throughput and the impact on the primary link, and validate performance through both simulation and over-the-air experiments using software-defined radios. Results demonstrate reliable secondary communication with negligible degradation to primary performance, making our system well-suited for ad hoc spectrum sharing and decentralized coordination at the tactical edge.

</details>


### [331] [Can Quantum Receiver Beat the SIC Limit in Multiple Access Networks?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20956)
*Shiqian Guo,Huaiyu Dai,Jianqing Liu*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种全栈量子接收机，通过集成前端量子传感和后端量子信号处理，在某些工作条件下实现了超越传统串行干扰消除（SIC）信道容量极限的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 虽然串行干扰消除（SIC）技术已被证明在多址网络的多种场景中能够逼近信道容量极限，但尚未明确是否存在一种先进且实际可实现的量子接收技术能够突破这一极限。本文旨在探索并实现这一目标。

Method: 提出了一种全栈量子接收机，集成前端量子传感和后端量子信号处理。该技术利用简单的量子比特系综，不依赖复杂的纠缠资源，能够并行提取多用户干扰信号，并通过量子关联测量和叠加态实现的并行处理来提升性能。

Result: 在低信噪比（SNR）环境下，所提量子接收机在频谱效率和检测效率方面显著超越传统的SIC算法及多址信道容量极限，展示了量子优势。

Conclusion: 所提出的量子接收机技术在特定条件下能够突破传统SIC的信道容量限制，展示了量子通信技术在多址接入网络中的潜在优势和实际应用价值。

Abstract: Successive interference cancellation (SIC) is an important technique for 5G/B5G wireless receivers to resolve interfering signals from multiple users. While SIC has been proven to approach the channel capacity limit in many settings of multiple access networks, it remains unknown if this limit can be surpassed by an advanced yet practically implementable quantum receiver technique. In this work, we answer this quest by proposing a full-stack quantum receiver that integrates front-end quantum sensing with back-end quantum signal processing. The proposed technique leverages simple qubit ensembles without using any complex entanglement resources to parallelly extract interfering multiuser signals, with a channel capacity beyond the limit of SIC in some operational corners. In performance evaluation, we report notable quantum advantage over the ultimate multiple-access channel capacity limit and practical SIC algorithms in low-SNR regimes in terms of spectral efficiency and detection efficiency due to the receiver's ability to exploit quantum correlated measurements and superposition-enabled parallel processing.

</details>


### [332] [SHACR: A Graph-Augmented Semi-Autonomous Framework for Multi-Class Conflict Resolution in Smart Home IoT Automation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.22312)
*Leena Marghalani,Walid Aljoby,Suayb S. Arslan*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文提出了SHACR框架，通过将大语言模型（LLM）的推理锚定在形式化的有向知识图谱上，解决了智能家居自动化中跨规则交互导致的隐藏冲突问题。实验表明，该方法将分类错误降低了36.7%，F1分数从0.59提升至0.79（经校准后可达0.95），证明了结构化知识表示比提示工程或模型架构对可靠IoT自动化管理更为关键。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能家居自动化日益依赖用户定义的跨异构IoT设备规则。虽然这些规则单独看似无害，但其并发执行会通过共享设备、环境变量和物理拓扑产生隐藏的跨规则交互。这些交互会导致不安全、浪费或威胁隐私的行为，且对纯文本分析完全不可见。现有冲突检测器各自孤立，只能捕获静态语法冲突或特定环境介导的交互，未能统一两者，也无法为非专业用户提供可操作的修复方案。

Method: 本文提出SHACR框架，将大语言模型的不可预测性锚定在形式化的有向知识图谱中。具体方法包括：(1) 将设备、能力、物理状态和触发-条件-动作规则编码为可遍历的类型化实体；(2) 将物理因果关系提升为一等图边，将冲突检测从脆弱的文本推理转变为确定性的多跳图遍历，统一了逻辑、语义和物理冲突类别；(3) 驱动闭环的扫描-解释-修复-验证工作流，使用图谱约束LLM的行动空间。

Result: 在一个部署于智能建筑中70个公寓的203条规则测试床上评估SHACR。结果表明：保持底层LLM固定并引入SHACR的知识图谱后，分类错误降低36.7%，F1分数从0.59提升至0.79；小样本校准进一步将F1提升至0.95，而相同的校准对无图谱的LLM几乎无帮助。这证明了知识图谱对性能提升的关键作用。

Conclusion: 这项工作挑战了当前的AI范式，证明了结构化知识表示是可靠IoT自动化管理的远比提示工程或底层模型架构更为关键的因素。通过将物理因果关系形式化为知识图谱并约束LLM的推理空间，SHACR实现了对智能家居规则冲突的有效检测、解释和修复，为依赖LLM的关键系统提供了新的设计思路。

Abstract: Smart home automation increasingly relies on user-defined rules across heterogeneous IoT devices. While these rules appear harmless in isolation, their concurrent execution creates hidden, cross-rule interactions via shared devices, environmental variables, and physical topology. These interactions result in unsafe, wasteful, or privacy-threatening behaviors that are completely invisible to text-only analysis. Existing conflict detectors remain siloed, catching either static syntactic conflicts or specific environment-mediated interactions without unifying the two or providing actionable repairs for non-expert users.
  This paper presents SHACR, a smart home conflict resolution framework that anchors Large Language Model (LLM) unpredictability by grounding its reasoning in a formal, directed knowledge graph. SHACR encodes devices, capabilities, physical states, and Trigger-Condition-Action rules as typed, traversable entities. By elevating physical cause-effect relationships to first-class graph edges, SHACR transforms conflict detection from fragile text inference into deterministic multi-hop graph traversal, unifying logical, semantic, and physical conflict classes. It drives a closed-loop Scan-Explain-Repair-Validate workflow that uses the graph to bound the LLM's action space. We evaluated SHACR on a testbed of 203 rules deployed across 70 apartments within a smart building. By holding the underlying LLM fixed and introducing SHACR's knowledge graph, classification errors drop by 36.7\%, F1 rises from 0.59 to 0.79, and few-shot calibration further lifts F1 to 0.95, whereas the same calibration barely helps a graph-free LLM. Ultimately, this work challenges the current AI paradigm, establishing that structured knowledge representation is a far more critical factor for dependable IoT automation management than prompt engineering or underlying model architecture.

</details>


### [333] [HOWLR: A Client-Driven Approach to BGP Hijack Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21845)
*Constantine Doumanidis,Anya Kalogerakos,Maria Apostolaki*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文提出HOWLR工具，利用同一IP前缀下的TLS认证服务作为见证者，使终端主机能够独立检测BGP劫持攻击，无需依赖网络运营商。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统BGP劫持检测依赖网络运营商，导致终端主机在攻击发生数小时内处于暴露状态。作者发现BGP劫持虽然会转移整个IP前缀的流量，但攻击者难以在规模上冒充该前缀内所有的共置服务，特别是当这些服务由不同的证书颁发机构认证时。

Method: 提出HOWLR工具，利用IP前缀内的TLS认证共置服务作为见证者。当客户端无法再认证这些见证服务时，即可证明正在发生BGP劫持攻击。研究评估了该方法在实际环境中的可行性，量化了见证服务的存在性和多样性。

Result: HOWLR能够保护89%的Tor中继前缀和75%的比特币矿池网关前缀，证明了该方法在实际部署中的有效性。

Conclusion: 终端主机可以独立检测前缀级别的BGP劫持攻击，通过利用共置TLS认证服务作为见证者，无需依赖网络运营商，为关键基础设施（如Tor和比特币网络）提供了有效保护。

Abstract: BGP hijacking enables impersonation attacks in which adversaries divert traffic at the prefix level and serve malicious content to unsuspecting clients. Detecting such attacks has traditionally been the responsibility of network operators, leaving end hosts exposed for hours. We argue that end hosts can detect prefix-level impersonation independently, exploiting a fundamental asymmetry: a BGP hijack diverts traffic for an entire IP prefix, but impersonating every co-hosted service within that prefix is prohibitively difficult at scale, especially if each service is authenticated by a different Certificate Authority. We propose HOWLR, a tool that operationalizes this insight by using co-hosted, TLS-authenticated services as witnesses: if a client can no longer authenticate them, it has evidence of an ongoing attack. This work evaluates the feasibility of this method by quantifying the existence and diversity of witnesses in the wild. We show that HOWLR can protect 89% of Tor relay prefixes, and 75% of Bitcoin pool gateway prefixes.

</details>


### [334] [From RAN Control to Agentic Intelligence: Architecture and Vision for Energy Efficient AI-RAN](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21955)
*Sabrine Aroua,Alexis I. Aravanis,Ilias Chatzistefanidis,Hamza Abbar,Anh-Khoa Dang,Anastasios Giovanidis,Salah-Eddine El Ayoubi,Stephane Senecal,Martha Vlachou Konchylaki,Navid Nikaein*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种代理式AI原生RAN架构，利用语义意图抽象和LLM驱动协调，实现了跨异构工作负载的自适应编排与能耗优化，为可持续6G网络铺平道路。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 未来6G网络将采用高度分布式的AI原生RAN架构，通信与AI工作负载共享基础设施，预计将显著增加能耗。现有O-RAN方法主要基于策略驱动，限制了多应用间的自适应能耗感知协调；AI-RAN虽促进融合，但联合优化性能、时延和能耗的机制仍是开放挑战。

Method: 提出代理式AI原生RAN架构，融合O-RAN结构化控制与AI-RAN统一愿景。采用语义意图抽象技术和大语言模型(LLM)驱动的协调机制，实现自适应编排、冲突解决以及跨异构工作负载的能耗感知多目标优化。

Result: 通过AI-for-RAN和AI-on-RAN代表性用例验证，所提框架能够提高资源效率，降低运营能耗，实现了性能、时延与能耗的联合优化。

Conclusion: 该代理式AI原生RAN架构成功弥合了O-RAN结构化控制与AI-RAN统一愿景之间的差距，通过语义意图抽象和LLM协调实现了自适应多目标优化，为构建可持续发展的6G网络提供了有效解决方案。

Abstract: Future 6G networks will rely on highly distributed, AI-native Radio Access Networks (RANs), where communication and AI workloads share a common infrastructure. This evolution, combined with increasing deployment density and continuous AI processing, is expected to significantly increase RAN energy consumption. While Open RAN (O-RAN) introduces a programmable and modular control framework through the RAN Intelligent Controller (RIC) and Service Management and Orchestration (SMO), current approaches remain largely policy-driven, limiting adaptive energy-aware coordination across multiple applications. In parallel, AI-RAN promotes the convergence of AI and RAN infrastructures through AI-for-RAN, AI-on-RAN, and AI-and-RAN paradigms, yet efficient mechanisms to jointly orchestrate performance, latency, and energy remain an open challenge. This article proposes an agentic AI-native RAN architecture that bridges O-RAN's structured control with AI-RAN's unified vision. Leveraging semantic intent abstraction and Large Language Model (LLM)-driven coordination, the framework enables adaptive orchestration, conflict resolution, and energy-aware multi-objective optimization across heterogeneous workloads. Through representative AI-for-RAN and AI-on-RAN use cases, we show how such coordination can improve resource efficiency and reduce operational energy consumption, paving the way toward sustainable 6G networks.

</details>


### [335] [When Cooperation Should End: Maneuver Coordination Cancellation for Connected Automated Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.22052)
*Rafael Molina-Masegosa,Sergei S. Avedisov,Miguel Sepulcre,Javier Gozalvez,Onur Altintas*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文首次设计了完整的 maneuvers 协调取消机制，包括状态机、消息集和决策逻辑，评估表明取消机制能显著减少无效协调时间，提高协调成功率，从而提升协同驾驶效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的协同自动驾驶研究主要关注如何启动和执行 maneuvers 协调，但对于如何终止不再适合的正在进行协调过程关注甚少。当协调无法成功时，缺乏有效的取消机制会导致车辆长时间处于无效协调状态，影响系统效率和新的协调机会。

Method: 本文提出了首个完整的 maneuver 协调取消设计方案，包括三个核心组件：(1) 状态机模型用于描述协调取消的状态转换；(2) 专门的消息集用于支持取消通信；(3) 决策逻辑用于判断何时触发取消操作。通过 V2X 通信实现车辆间的取消协商。

Result: 评估结果表明，取消机制显著减少了车辆在无法成功的协调中停留的时间，使车辆能够更快地变为可用状态并参与新的 maneuvers 协调。这增加了触发的协调数量，并提高了成功的 maneuver 协调数量。

Conclusion: 研究证明 maneuver 协调取消机制能够有效改善协同驾驶性能，为未来进一步优化奠定基础。该机制提升了网联自动驾驶的效率和鲁棒性，为后续相关研究提供了重要的技术基础和改进方向。

Abstract: Maneuver coordination is essential for cooperative connected automated driving, enabling vehicles to negotiate maneuvers and interactions through V2X communication. While prior work has largely focused on how to initiate and execute coordinations, considerably less attention has been given to how ongoing coordinations should be terminated when they become unsuitable. This paper introduces the first complete design and implementation of maneuver coordination cancellation, including a state machine, message set, and decision-making logic. Our evaluation shows that cancellation significantly reduces the time vehicles spend in coordinations that cannot succeed, allowing them to become available for new maneuvers sooner. This increases the number of triggered coordinations and improves the number of successful maneuver coordinations. Overall, the study demonstrates that maneuver coordination cancellation improves cooperative driving, and establishes a foundation for further refinements that can enhance the efficiency and robustness of connected automated driving.

</details>


### [336] [Multi-Target Maneuver Coordinations: Unlocking Coordination Opportunities in Connected Automated Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.22055)
*Rafael Molina-Masegosa,Sergei S. Avedisov,Miguel Sepulcre,Takayuki Shimizu,Javier Gozalvez,Onur Altintas*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于多目标选择的机动协调方法，允许车辆从多个潜在协调车辆中进行选择，从而显著提高协调触发的成功率，同时保持较低的计算成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的机动协调方法通常假设仅与单个预定义目标车辆进行协调，这限制了协调机会的数量，无法充分利用协作驾驶的潜力。

Method: 提出基于多目标选择的机动协调方法。该方法不改变机动执行逻辑或底层协调协议，而是扩展了协调前的决策过程，使车辆能够识别并从多个潜在协调车辆中进行选择，从而利用更广泛的可行协作交互。

Result: 多目标机动协调显著增加了触发和成功执行的协调次数，同时保持了较低的计算成本，因为该方法无需分析大量潜在目标车辆即可实现这些增益。这些改进在保持协调成功率的同时，还实现了更早的机动启动。

Conclusion: 多目标选择方法有效扩展了机动协调的适用范围和效率，为联网自动驾驶提供了更灵活、更高效的协作机制，在不增加系统复杂度的前提下显著提升了协调性能。

Abstract: Maneuver coordination is a key enabler of connected and automated driving, allowing vehicles to negotiate and execute maneuvers that would otherwise be difficult, inefficient or unsafe. Existing approaches and use cases typically assume coordination with a single predefined target vehicle, which limits the number of coordination opportunities. This paper introduces a maneuver coordination approach based on multi-target selection, which allows a vehicle to identify and select among multiple potential coordination vehicles for a given maneuver. Multi-target maneuver coordination does not require modifications to the maneuver execution logic or to the underlying coordination protocol. Instead, it extends the decision-making process preceding coordination, enabling vehicles to exploit a broader set of feasible cooperative interactions. Results show that multi-target maneuver coordination significantly increases triggered and successfully executed coordinations while maintaining a low computational cost, as the proposed approach achieves these gains without requiring the analysis of a large number of potential target vehicles. These improvements preserve coordination success rates while enabling earlier maneuver initiation.

</details>


### [337] [Game-Theoretic Framework for Private Data Sharing in Vehicular Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.22115)
*Yousef AlSaqabi,Yinan Zhou,Faisal Nawab,Bhaskar Krishnamachari*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于博弈论的混合架构框架，通过安全多方计算和Stackelberg竞争模型，实现了去中心化车辆数据收集系统中的隐私保护与经济激励平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在去中心化车辆数据收集系统中，如何在保护车辆隐私的同时建立有效的数据市场并激励车辆参与数据共享是一个关键挑战。现有系统难以平衡隐私风险与经济激励之间的关系。

Method: 提出混合架构，包含数据供应车辆、独立服务器（通过安全多方计算处理数据）、协调器节点和数据消费者；采用Stackelberg竞争博弈理论动态平衡隐私风险与经济激励，确保只有数据消费者能访问聚合数据。使用真实车辆位置数据进行实证验证，通过评估 adversaries 重构车辆路径的准确度来量化隐私风险。

Result: 实验和仿真表明，该框架能够有效保护车辆隐私（防止原始数据泄露），同时支持活跃的数据市场运作；系统在隐私保护方面展现出良好的鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 所提出的博弈论框架成功实现了隐私保护与可扩展性的平衡，为车辆数据共享提供了一个实用且保护隐私的市场平台。

Abstract: We present a novel game-theoretic framework designed to enhance privacy and scalability in decentralized vehicular data collection systems. The proposed hybrid architecture comprises vehicles that supply sensor data, independent servers that process data via secure multiparty computation, a coordinator node that manages data flow, and data consumers that set economic incentives. Crucially, our framework ensures that only the data consumer can access the fully aggregated data, preventing individual raw data exposure and significantly reducing privacy risks. By integrating principles of the Stackelberg competition from game theory, our approach dynamically balances privacy and economic incentives, enabling vehicles to make participation decisions based on perceived privacy risks and incentives. We empirically validate our framework using real-world vehicular location data, quantifying privacy risks by evaluating the accuracy with which a potential adversary can reconstruct a vehicle's path using only a subset of the shared data. This paper details the development and deployment of a data-trading platform within this framework, introducing a practical and privacy-preserving marketplace for profitable vehicle data sharing. Through experiments and simulations, we evaluate the effectiveness of the system in preserving privacy and explore the dynamics that influence vehicle participation. Our findings highlight the robustness of the proposed framework in preserving privacy while supporting an active data market.

</details>


### [338] [Radio Resource Management for the Uplink of Hybrid Beamforming Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.22643)
*Yuan Quan,Haseen Rahman,Catherine Rosenberg*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文研究了多信道蜂窝上行链路的混合波束成形无线资源管理问题，提出了离线和在线两种启发式算法，在大幅降低计算复杂度的同时实现了接近联合优化问题的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在混合波束成形系统中，由于用户设备功率预算需按时隙分配到未知的信道上，且射频链路数量有限无法选择所有模拟波束，因此需要按时隙进行联合RRM优化。然而，该优化问题的变量数量随用户数呈指数增长，仅能求解极少数用户的场景，这促使研究高效的低复杂度算法。

Method: 首先建立包含波束选择、用户选择、功率分配、调制编码方案选择和数字波束成形的按时隙联合RRM优化问题；然后提出离线启发式算法，将运行时间减少两个数量级；最后基于离线算法获得的工程洞察和目标性能，验证所提出的低复杂度在线启发式算法。

Result: 所提出的离线启发式算法将运行时间减少了两个数量级，同时实现了接近联合优化的性能；该算法不仅能够获得系统参数影响的工程洞察，还为在线启发式算法提供了验证基准。

Conclusion: 本文提出的离线和在线启发式算法有效解决了混合波束成形系统中按时隙联合RRM优化问题的高复杂度难题，为实际系统中的无线资源管理提供了可行的低复杂度解决方案和重要的工程洞察。

Abstract: This paper studies radio resource management (RRM) for the uplink of a multi-channel cellular system with hybrid beamforming based on analog beamforming using predefined codebooks and zero-forcing digital beamforming. We first formulate a per-time slot joint RRM optimization problem, which includes beam selection, user selection, power allocation, modulation and coding scheme selection, and digital beamforming. A per-time slot formulation of the RRM problem is necessary because the power budget of a user equipment (UE) needs to be allocated per time slot to its assigned channels which are not known a priori, and because we consider the case where the number of radio frequency chains is not large enough to select all possible analog beams, thereby requiring per-slot beam selection. This problem can be solved for at most a few UEs because the number of variables grows exponentially with the number of UEs. In order to obtain results with more UEs, we propose an offline heuristic that reduces the runtime to obtain results by two orders of magnitude, while achieving performance close to the joint optimization. This offline heuristic allows us to obtain engineering insights on the impact of different system parameters as well as a target performance that we use to validate the low-complexity online heuristic that we propose.

</details>


### [339] [Performance Evaluation of Selection Strategies for Inter-Satellite Paths in Walker-Delta Constellations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.23135)
*Marvin Felix Braun,Moritz Flüchter,Michael Menth*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文研究了LEO卫星星座中路径选择策略对通信延迟和控制复杂度相关指标的影响，发现在Walker-Delta星座中路径选择显著影响延迟和路径抖动。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LEO卫星星座中，卫星绕地球旋转导致用户终端与网关间的路径需要频繁重选，不同路径选择策略会影响通信延迟和资源管理复杂度，需要量化分析其影响程度。

Method: 提出了三种启发式路径选择策略，在包含1156颗卫星的单层Walker-Delta星座中，针对大量用户终端-网关场景进行了路径候选生成和策略评估，分析了路径长度（欧氏距离和跳数）、路径变更率、链路使用率等指标。

Result: 实验结果表明路径选择策略对延迟相关指标（路径长度）和路径抖动（路径变更率）具有显著影响，不同策略在这些关键性能指标上表现出明显差异。

Conclusion: 路径选择策略是LEO卫星星座网络设计中的关键因素，需要根据延迟要求和管理复杂度进行针对性优化，合理的策略选择能够有效改善网络性能。

Abstract: In LEO satellite constellations, traffic between a user terminal and a gateway is carried over a satellite path. As the satellite constellation rotates around Earth, a new path must be reselected repeatedly from a set of path candidates. In this paper, we study the impact of path selection strategies on several metrics: path length in terms of Euclidean distance and hop count, path-change rate, and rate of used links. These metrics are relevant because they affect either communication latency or the complexity of control and resource management. We explain how path candidates are generated, define three heuristic path selection strategies, and evaluate them over a large set of UT-GW scenarios within a single shell of a Walker-Delta constellation with 1,156 satellites. Overall, the results show that path selection has a significant impact on both latency-related metrics and path churn.

</details>


### [340] [LLM-Aided A* Search in Non-Geometric Network Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.23136)
*Nouf Alabbasi,Esraa Ghourab,Omar Alhussein*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 提出了一种LLM辅助的A*算法，利用大语言模型生成中间路径点来引导搜索，在非几何网络图中将节点扩展数量减少约50%，同时路径成本仅略微增加。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非几何网络图（如网络延迟或货币成本作为边权重）中最短路径搜索面临挑战：传统启发式搜索算法依赖几何距离作为启发式信息，但在非几何图中缺乏这种空间距离信号，导致搜索效率低下。

Method: 提出LLM辅助的A*算法，核心是利用地标距离（landmark distances）同时作为ALT启发式和紧凑结构特征。LLM基于这些结构特征生成中间路径点，引导A*搜索向有希望的图区域扩展，从而为非几何图恢复目的地距离信号。

Result: 在多达2000个节点的多种图拓扑上的综合实验表明，LLM生成的路径点将扩展节点数量减少约50%，同时相比最优解仅产生边际路径成本增加。研究还发现，融入紧凑结构特征比高级提示工程技术更有效。

Conclusion: 该研究证明了将LLM引导与经典搜索算法相结合在网络优化中具有巨大潜力，为非几何图的高效寻路提供了新思路。

Abstract: Finding the shortest path in non-geometric network graphs, where edge weights encode arbitrary metrics such as latency or monetary cost rather than spatial distance, poses a challenge for informed search algorithms. Their efficiency depends on an informative heuristic, typically supplied in spatial domains by geometric distances that have no counterpart on non-geometric graphs. We propose a large language model (LLM)-aided A* algorithm in which an LLM generates intermediate waypoints that guide the A* expansion toward promising graph regions. At the core of the approach are landmark distances, which serve both as an admissible landmark-based (ALT) heuristic for the search and as a compact structural feature that, supplied to the LLM, restores the distance-to-destination signal it would otherwise lack on non-geometric graphs. Our comprehensive experiments on multiple graph topologies with up to 2,000 nodes demonstrate that LLM-generated waypoints reduce the number of expanded nodes by around 50% while incurring only a marginal path cost increase compared to the optimal solution. We further analyze the impact of prompt engineering and show that incorporating compact structural features, namely heuristic estimates, is more effective than advanced prompting techniques. These findings demonstrate the potential of combining LLM- based guidance with classical search algorithms for efficient network optimization.

</details>


### [341] [Wireless Personal Agent: Extending Wireless Intelligence from Networks to Terminals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.23255)
*Jiedan Tan,Fang Liu,Jingwen Tong,Shengli Zhang,Jun Zhang,Wing Shing Wong*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文提出了WISPA框架，利用大语言模型（LLM）智能体实现终端侧无线资源的自动化管理，通过分离在线执行和离线反思克服终端资源限制，成功实现了个性化、自适应的无线连接决策。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有无线智能主要关注网络侧优化（如吞吐量、时延、覆盖），而忽视了用户感知体验，包括应用上下文、移动轨迹、服务成本、隐私偏好和长期使用行为等因素。需要开发能够理解和适应个人用户需求的终端侧智能资源管理方案。

Method: 提出WISPA（无线智能自演化个人智能体）框架，基于大语言模型智能体，采用解耦架构：离线LLM智能体分析终端轨迹、完善用户画像、更新偏好参数；轻量级在线执行器使用可解释偏好参数进行确定性的资源决策，克服终端资源约束并保证实时性。

Result: 在校园通勤路线的实验验证中，WISPA成功学习到用户特定的连接风格，并能够根据用户偏好变化自适应调整接入决策，证明了该框架在终端侧资源分配方面的实用性和有效性。

Conclusion: WISPA框架实现了从以连接为中心的无线基础设施向智能化、个性化服务平台的演进，通过LLM驱动的终端侧智能体成功将用户感知体验纳入无线智能范畴，为未来无线网络的个性化服务提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Wireless networks are evolving from connectivity-oriented infrastructures into intelligent and personalized service platforms. Existing wireless intelligence remains centered on network-side optimization, improving objectives such as throughput, latency, and coverage. Nevertheless, besides network performance, wireless intelligence also depends on user-perceived experience via application context, mobility routine, service cost, privacy preference, and long-term usage behavior. This article proposes WISPA, a Wireless Intelligent Self-evolving Personal Agent framework for automated terminal-side resource management based on large language model (LLM)-based agent. To overcome the resource constraints on terminals, WISPA decouples the latency-sensitive online resource execution from offline LLM agent reflection. In this way, a lightweight online executor makes deterministic resource decisions using interpretable preference parameters; While an offline LLM agent analyzes terminal-side traces, refines user profiles, and updates online preference parameters for subsequent decisions. At last, we demonstrate the practical applicability and benefits of WISPA for terminal-side resource allocations on a campus commute route. Numerical results show that WISPA learns user-specific connection styles and adapts access decisions as preferences change.

</details>


### [342] [Protection Switching in Hybrid Hollow-Core and Single-Mode Fiber Networks: Challenges, Analysis, and Mitigation Strategies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.23554)
*Md Ghulam Saber,Zhiping Jiang*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文研究了空芯光纤与单模光纤混合网络中的保护切换问题，发现在50%空芯光纤部署下，1+1保护方案会产生4000-22000 ps/nm色散阶跃、1.6-3.1 dB GSNR惩罚及38-59%节点对需调制降级，且切换方向存在根本性不对称，最终得出1+1专用保护优于共享备份路径保护的结论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着空芯光纤从实验室走向大规模商用部署，云运营商网络中工作路径和保护路径将不可避免地穿越不同类型的光纤，这在同构单模光纤网络中是不存在的全新保护切换挑战，亟需系统性研究这种混合光纤网络中的保护切换问题。

Method: 采用蒙特卡洛仿真方法，在六种参考网络拓扑（1602个节点对）上进行随机逐链路光纤分配，对1+1专用保护和共享备份路径保护两种架构进行对比分析，量化了色散阶跃、广义信噪比惩罚和调制格式降级等关键指标，并进行了跨光纤极端情况分析。

Result: 在50%空芯光纤部署下，平均色散阶跃为4000-22000 ps/nm，GSNR惩罚为1.6-3.1 dB，1+1保护下38-59%的节点对需要调制降级。切换方向具有不对称性：空芯光纤到单模光纤切换会使色散阶跃翻倍并造成约10 dB GSNR惩罚，而反向切换则产生负GSNR惩罚。共享备份路径保护在稀疏连接拓扑中表现较差，容量保持率随空芯光纤渗透率提升而改善。

Conclusion: 在混合空芯光纤和单模光纤网络部署中，1+1专用保护方案优于共享备份路径保护方案。文章提出了包括DSP预加载、频谱预均衡和网络规划指南在内的缓解策略，为混合光纤网络的保护切换设计提供了指导。

Abstract: Hollow-core fibers (HCF) are transitioning from laboratory curiosities to production-deployed infrastructure, with cloud providers operating thousands of kilometers of hollow-core links. As operators upgrade their networks, working and protection paths will inevitably traverse different fiber types, creating a class of protection switching challenges absent in homogeneous single-mode fiber networks. This article provides a comprehensive overview of these challenges and presents a comparative analysis of protection switching under two architectures - 1+1 dedicated and shared backup path protection (SBPP) - in hybrid hollow-core and single-mode fiber networks. Using Monte Carlo simulation with random per-link fiber assignment across six reference topologies (1,602 node pairs), we quantify chromatic dispersion (CD) steps, generalized signal-to-noise ratio (GSNR) penalties, and modulation-format degradation for both architectures. At 50% HCF deployment mean CD steps range from 4,000 to 22,000 ps/nm, with GSNR penalties of 1.6-3.1 dB and 38-59% of node pairs requiring modulation downgrade under 1+1 protection. A complementary cross-fiber extreme analysis reveals that the two switching directions are fundamentally asymmetric: HCF-to-SMF switching doubles the CD step and inflicts about a 10 dB GSNR penalty while SMF-to-HCF switching delivers a negative GSNR penalty (the protection path is higher quality than the working path). SBPP shows up to 7% higher CD steps and 4 percentage points more downgrade in sparsely connected topologies due to its greedy shortest-first path selection. Capacity retention improves with HCF penetration for both architectures, reaching 85-99% at full HCF deployment. We present mitigation strategies including DSP pre-loading, spectral pre-equalization, and network planning guidelines, concluding that 1+1 dedicated protection is preferable to SBPP for hybrid deployments.

</details>


<div id='cs.DC'></div>

# cs.DC [[Back]](#toc)

### [343] [DPIFrame: A Dual-Level Parallelism Acceleration Framework for CTR Model Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21101)
*Dezhi Yi,Huifeng Guo,Kunpeng Xie,Zhaolong Jian,Haochi Yu,Wenxuan He,Zhenhua Dong,Ruiming Tang,Ye Lu*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 提出了DPIFrame，首个双并行化框架，通过模块内和模块间并行、高效多表查找算法和广度优先流调度策略，显著加速CTR模型在GPU上的推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度学习提升了CTR预测模型的学习能力和预测准确性，但在GPU上部署CTR模型并高效推理存在巨大挑战，因为串行计算模式与并行模型结构之间存在严重不匹配。

Method: 提出DPIFrame双并行化框架，包含三个核心技术：a)双并行化架构，实现模块内和模块间的并行CTR模型推理；b)通过提前预判整体工作负载的高效多表查找算法，优化嵌入操作；c)广度优先流调度策略，对GPU上的并行计算进行细粒度管理，进一步支持双并行执行。

Result: 在两个真实数据集上进行了广泛实验，结果显示DPIFrame相比PyTorch将嵌入延迟降低了23.0倍；与PyTorch、TorchRec、HugeCTR和OneFlow相比，DPIFrame在GPU上实现了最先进的推理性能，加速比分别为5.83倍、4.29倍、2.15倍和2.0倍。

Conclusion: DPIFrame作为首个双并行化框架，有效解决了CTR模型在GPU上推理时的串行-并行不匹配问题，显著提升了推理性能，为CTR模型的GPU部署提供了高效解决方案。

Abstract: Deep learning technology has enhanced the ability of Click-through rate (CTR) prediction models to learn features and improve prediction accuracy. However, it is challenging to deploy CTR models on GPU smoothly and perform inference efficiently, because there is a huge mismatch between the serial computational pattern and the parallel model structure. In this paper, we propose DPIFrame, the first dual parallelizable framework to accelerate CTR model inference. In DPIFrame, a) a dual parallelizable architecture is proposed to perform parallel CTR model inference in both intra-module and inter-module; b) an efficient multi-table lookup algorithm is presented for embedding operations through anticipating the whole workload in advance; c) a breadth-first stream scheduling strategy is designed for fine-grained management of parallel computation on GPU to further supporting the dual parallel execution. Extensive experiments are conducted on two real-world datasets, and the results highlight that DPIFrame can reduce the embedding latency efficiently by \textbf{23.0$\times$} compared to PyTorch. Compared with PyTorch, TorchRec, HugeCTR, and OneFlow, DPIFrame can achieve state-of-the-art inference performance on GPU with speedups of \textbf{5.83$\times$}, \textbf{4.29$\times$}, \textbf{2.15$\times$}, and \textbf{2.0$\times$}, respectively.

</details>


### [344] [Constant-Time Certificate Selection for Local Broadcast Repair in Dense Gaussian and Eisenstein--Jacobi Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21132)
*Bader Albader*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文针对密集高斯和Eisenstein-Jacobi网络中的故障修复问题，提出了常数时间的证书选择器，仅需故障坐标即可完成修复，避免线性扫描。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的基于搜索的修复方法需要对网络进行线性扫描来选择修复方案，时间开销大。本文旨在开发一种仅需故障坐标即可操作的常数时间修复方法。

Method: 提出证书选择器，根据故障坐标分类相对故障几何关系，选择坐标归约方向，并返回有界的有序修复边集合。针对一故障和两故障场景分别设计算法。

Result: 对于密集高斯网络G_k，所有源外故障集(|F|≤2)在深度至多k+2内被修复；对于密集EJ网络H_t，一故障在深度t+1内修复，两故障在深度t+2内修复。修复边数量均为c-1条。通过大规模严格验证确认算法正确性。

Conclusion: 所提出的常数时间证书选择器能够有效修复密集高斯和EJ网络中的一至两个处理器故障，在连通性、无环性、修复数量和深度界限方面均通过严格验证，显著优于传统线性扫描方法。

Abstract: Dense Gaussian and Eisenstein--Jacobi (EJ) networks are algebraic interconnection networks with compact coordinate balls, fixed degree, and simple modular addressing. A source-centered coordinate-reduction tree gives a non-redundant one-to-all broadcast in the fault-free network, but processor faults can split the tree into multiple healthy components. Unlike search-based repair methods that require a linear scan of the network to select the repair plan, the certificate selectors introduced here operate in $O(1)$ time and $O(1)$ memory, consulting only the fault coordinates. This paper develops this stronger formulation for the one- and two-fault regime: a constant-time certificate selector. Given only the faulty coordinates, the selector classifies the relative fault geometry, chooses a coordinate-reduction orientation, and returns a bounded ordered set of component-crossing repair edges. For dense Gaussian networks $G_k$, every source-free fault set with $|F|\le2$ is repaired with depth at most $k+2$ and with exactly $c-1$ external component-crossing edges for the selected fault-pruned orientation. For dense EJ networks $H_t$, every one-fault placement is repaired within depth $t+1$, and every two-fault placement is repaired within depth $t+2$, again with exactly $c-1$ external repair edges. Exhaustive strict validation confirms the Gaussian selector over $146{,}156$ one- and two-fault cases for $k=5,\ldots,12$ and the EJ selector over $52{,}395$ cases for $t=2,\ldots,8$, with zero failures in connectivity, acyclicity, exact repair count, or depth bound.

</details>


### [345] [Re-Rooting-Assisted Edge-Minimum Runtime Repair for Node and Link Failures in Dense Eisenstein--Jacobi Broadcast Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21133)
*Bader Albader*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种针对稠密Eisenstein-Jacobi网络的联合节点/链路故障恢复方法，通过引入选择三元组(r,θ,Kcomp_{r,θ})作为分析单元，证明了混合修复成功的充要条件是健康EJ图G'连通。实验验证了100%恢复率且显著减少修复边数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稠密Eisenstein-Jacobi网络中的"一对全"广播依赖于直径级生成树，当节点或链路故障时会导致生成树碎片化，现有方法无法有效处理联合节点/链路故障的恢复问题。

Method: 提出选择三元组(r,θ,Kcomp_{r,θ})作为联合节点/链路故障恢复的基本分析单元，其中r为选定根节点，θ为选定的EJ坐标归约方向，Kcomp_{r,θ}为该选择诱导的健康分量图。通过判断健康EJ图G'=Ht-Fv-Fe的连通性来确定混合修复是否成功，当G'连通时，Kcomp_{r,θ}的生成树映射为恰好c-1条跨分量修复边。采用重根操作和最浅层入口选择策略进行确定性修复。

Result: 证明了混合修复成功的充要条件是健康EJ图G'连通；给出了确定性保证：通过重根操作可使1-2个故障节点始终位于距离-t边界；单条故障链路要么被避开要么被恰好一条跨边修复；在最浅层入口选择下修复深度满足D_{r,θ}≤2t+1。260,000次试验验证显示：在5种网络规模（最高达N=120,601节点）下实现100%恢复率，相比固定源修复显著减少修复边数。全局BFS、近邻缺失和容量敏感性审计阐明了可达性、转发状态变化与排序根选择之间的权衡关系。

Conclusion: 本文为EJ网络的联合故障恢复提供了理论基础和实用方法，证明了选择三元组框架下的修复方法具有确定性的性能保证，在保持100%恢复率的同时显著降低了修复开销，为容错广播网络设计提供了新的解决方案。

Abstract: One-to-all broadcasting in dense Eisenstein--Jacobi (EJ) networks relies on diameter-level spanning trees that fragment when nodes or links fail. This paper introduces the selected triple $(r,θ,\Kcomp_{r,θ})$--a chosen root, a chosen EJ coordinate-reduction orientation, and the healthy component graph induced by that choice--as the fundamental unit of analysis for joint node/link fault recovery. The central result is a necessary and sufficient condition: hybrid repair succeeds if and only if the healthy EJ graph $G'=\Ht-\Fv-\Fe$ is connected. When $G'$ is connected, a spanning tree of $\Kcomp_{r,θ}$ maps to exactly $c-1$ component-crossing repair edges, which is minimum for the selected pruned tree. Deterministic guarantees include: one/two faulty nodes are always placed on the distance-$t$ boundary by re-rooting; a single failed link is either avoided or repaired by exactly one crossing edge; and the repaired depth satisfies $D_{r,θ}\le 2t+1$ under shallowest-layer entry selection. A 260,000-trial validation campaign confirms 100\% recovery and substantial repair-edge reduction over fixed-source repair across five network scales up to $N=120601$ nodes, while global-BFS, near-miss, and cap-sensitivity audits clarify the tradeoff between reachability, forwarding-state changes, and ranked root selection.

</details>


### [346] [Re-Rooting-Assisted Edge-Minimum Runtime Repair for Node and Link Failures in Dense Gaussian Broadcast Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21134)
*Bader Albader*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出了密集高斯广播网络的运行时恢复框架，通过重新选择根节点和最小化修复边来应对静态故障和实时发现的单链路故障，实验显示恢复成功率超过99.96%，修复边数量减少80-100%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 密集高斯网络是具有紧凑直径和基于坐标路由的四度代数网络，其直径级广播树虽然在正常运行时高效，但在节点故障、链路故障和运行时发现的故障下非常脆弱，缺乏有效的运行时恢复机制。

Method: 提出运行时恢复框架：(1)重新选择源节点，使已知故障节点尽可能成为边界叶子节点；(2)过滤故障链路并修剪树；(3)通过连接健康组件来修复间隙。对于选定的根节点和连通的健康组件图，证明恰好需要c-1条外部修复边。还包括确定性单链路修复、常量大小边界交集原语、链路避免排除测试等机制。

Result: 在k∈{10,25,50,100,200}、多达80,401个节点的网络上进行实验，280,000次静态试验和15,000次瞬态试验显示：确定性情形100%恢复，多链路故障99.998%恢复，启发式情形99.963%恢复。重新选择根节点使平均修复边数量相比固定源修复减少80-100%。修补后的高斯链路Noxim模拟确认了完整的数据包执行。

Conclusion: 证明了外部修复边的必要性和充分性理论界限，实现了确定性单链路修复，解释了高阶割随k增长而消失的原因。框架在保证高恢复率的同时最小化修复边数量，但不声称在所有情况下都达到最优完成时间。未恢复的试验均可归因于组件不连通或重定位失败。

Abstract: Dense Gaussian networks are degree-four algebraic networks with compact diameter and coordinate-based routing. Their diameter-level broadcast trees are efficient but fragile under node, link, and runtime-discovered faults. This paper develops a runtime recovery framework for dense Gaussian broadcast networks under static node/link faults and mixed faults, plus single-link faults discovered live. The method re-roots the source so known node faults become boundary leaves whenever possible, then filters failed links and repairs gaps by connecting healthy components of the pruned tree. For a selected root with connected healthy component graph, we prove exactly $c-1$ external repair edges are necessary and sufficient. We also prove deterministic single-link repair, give a constant-size boundary-intersection primitive for source selection, derive a link-avoidance exclusion test, and add a local-obstruction bound explaining why high-order cuts vanish as $k$ grows. Experiments over $k\in\{10,25,50,100,200\}$, up to $80{,}401$ nodes, $280{,}000$ static trials, and $15{,}000$ transient trials show 100\% recovery for deterministic and bounded regimes, $99.998\%$ for multi-link faults, and $99.963\%$ for heuristic regimes; non-recovered trials are explained by disconnected components or relocation failure. Re-rooting reduces average repair edges by 80--100\% versus fixed-source repair. Patched Gaussian-link Noxim replays confirm packet-complete execution and show re-rooting reduces repair edges, components, and depth. A completion-cycle audit separates repair benefit from latency: ablations confirm completion time depends on relocation, scheduling, delivery tail, and selector objective, so the paper claims edge-minimum repair rather than universal completion-cycle dominance.

</details>


### [347] [Recency/Frequency Adaptive KV Caching for Large Language Model Serving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21238)
*Yang Shen,Meghana Madhyastha,Robert Underwood,Bogdan Nicolae,Randal Burns*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种自适应KV缓存管理策略，通过动态分配缓存空间给近期和高频KV块，解决了LRU策略在多样化推理负载下的缓存冲突问题，显著提升了缓存命中率和生成效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的大型语言模型推理工作负载规模大且多样化，传统LRU缓存管理策略会导致不同工作负载之间相互驱逐缓存块，降低缓存效率。因此需要一种能够适应多样化工作负载的缓存策略。

Method: 提出自适应缓存机制，在近期访问和高频出现的KV块之间动态分配缓存空间，替代传统的LRU策略，以更好地适应多样化的推理负载模式。

Result: 在合成文档问答任务中，KV缓存命中率提升高达10.8%，首令牌生成时间减少高达12.6%；在真实对话任务中，分别提升2.1%和2.0%。方法在批量推理中泛化良好，并具有清晰的可解释性。

Conclusion: 自适应KV缓存策略有效解决了多样化工作负载下的缓存冲突问题，显著提升了大语言模型推理效率，具有良好的泛化能力和可解释性，适用于实际部署场景。

Abstract: Key-value (KV) caching is a powerful technique for accelerating large language model inference and generation. Inference workloads are large and diverse, which makes them difficult to cache effectively. Existing cache management strategies adopt the least-recently-used policy for evicting cache blocks. However, LRU leads to multiple unrelated workloads flushing each other's caches. To address this, we integrate adaptive caching that dynamically allocates cache space between recently and frequently occurring KV blocks. Evaluations show that it improves the KV cache hit rate by up to 10.8% and reduces time to first token by up to 12.6% over naive vLLM on synthetic document question answering workloads, and 2.1% and 2.0% respectively on real-world conversation workloads. The method generalizes well to batch inference and demonstrates clear interpretability while effectively accommodating diverse workloads.

</details>


### [348] [SwarmX: Agentic Scheduling for Low-Latency Agentic Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21401)
*Yeqi Huang,Yanwei Ye,Guomin Chen,Wenhao Su,Bin Gong,Jialian Li,Zhan Lu,Yangshen Deng,Xuan Sun,Le Xu,Luo Mai*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: SwarmX是一种面向Agent AI应用的低延迟调度系统，通过神经预测器捕获提示、设备、运行时和模型特征，将分布预测暴露给路由器和扩缩容组件，在千级GPU生产环境中将尾延迟降低高达61.5%，吞吐量提升至生产调度器的2倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Agent AI应用由多个模型调用和工具执行组合而成，其推理时间和模型调用结构常依赖于提示语义，这给GPU-CPU集群带来了新的调度挑战，使得传统调度方法在低延迟服务场景下效果不佳。

Method: 提出SwarmX系统，采用调度专用神经预测器捕获提示、设备、运行时及目标模型特征；将分布预测暴露给路由器和扩缩容组件以实现尾延迟感知决策；提供预测器训练和在线自适应机制，并将其集成到调度器-智能体框架中。

Result: 在近千GPU和百万CPU核心的生产部署及128 GPU测试床上评估，涵盖多智能体代码生成、深度研究和多模态Agent工作流。SwarmX相比最先进调度器将尾延迟降低高达61.5%，在相同SLO下吞吐量可达生产调度器的2倍。

Conclusion: SwarmX有效解决了Agent AI应用的调度难题，显著降低了尾延迟并提升了吞吐量，证明了面向Agent的低延迟调度系统的可行性与优越性。

Abstract: Agentic AI applications compose multiple model calls and tool executions, creating new scheduling challenges for GPU-CPU clusters. Their inference time and model-call structure often depend on prompt semantics, making conventional scheduling approaches ineffective for low-latency serving. This paper presents SwarmX, a system that implements agentic scheduling for low-latency agentic applications. SwarmX uses scheduling-specific neural predictors to capture prompt, device, runtime, and target-model features; exposes distributional predictions to routers and scalers for tail-aware decisions; and provides mechanisms for predictor training and online adaptation. These predictors and mechanisms are integrated into a scheduler-agent framework that provides a common substrate for integration with existing scheduling and model-serving infrastructure. We evaluate SwarmX using production deployment (nearly one thousand GPUs and one million CPU cores) and controlled experiments on a 128-GPU testbed. Across multi-agent code generation, deep research, and multimodal agentic workflows, SwarmX reduces tail latency by up to 61.5% compared to state-of-the-art schedulers and sustains up to 2x the throughput of production schedulers under the same SLO.

</details>


### [349] [Bridging Design and Execution: A Visual Graph Editor for Edge and Cloud Workflows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21416)
*Katarina-Glorija Grujić,Nikola Stanković,Maja Vukasović,Miloš Simić*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种面向边缘/云计算环境的领域特定可视化图编辑器，通过内核、共享内存节点和事件触发器三种抽象，实现了模块化应用的设计时建模与运行时部署的无缝衔接。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在边缘和云计算环境中设计模块化应用面临协调多个计算内核、共享数据和事件驱动执行的复杂性挑战，传统工作流编辑器和通用图表工具缺乏明确的执行语义和直接可部署性，需要一种统一的设计工具来弥合设计时建模与运行时部署之间的鸿沟。

Method: 开发了一个领域特定的可视化图编辑器，采用三种一等抽象：内核（表示计算单元）、共享内存节点（建模分布式数据）和事件触发器（捕获执行依赖）。用户通过可视化方式构建图、配置节点属性并连接元素以定义数据流和控制流，生成的图自动序列化为JSON/XML格式并传递给执行API。

Result: 编辑器成功实现了图模型到机器可读表示的自动序列化，通过联邦学习工作流案例验证了其适用性。与传统工作流编辑器相比，该系统提供了明确的执行语义、模块化特性和直接可部署性，能够有效推理数据共享、执行顺序和依赖关系。

Conclusion: 该工作为分布式环境中模块化计算的可视化编排奠定了基础，具备对用户定义内核、事件类型和替代执行后端的可扩展性，为未来探索复杂分布式应用提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Designing modular applications for edge and cloud computing environments involves coordinating multiple computational kernels, shared data, and event-driven execution. This paper presents a domain-specific visual graph editor that enables users to model such applications using a unified interface. The editor supports three first-class abstractions: kernels, representing computational units; shared memory nodes, modeling distributed data; and event triggers, capturing execution dependencies. Users can construct graphs visually, configure node properties, and connect elements to define data and control flow. The resulting graphs are automatically serialized into machine-readable representations (JSON/XML) and can be passed to an execution API, bridging the gap between design-time modeling and runtime deployment. The editor's graph-based model improves reasoning about data sharing, execution order, and dependencies, particularly in distributed edge and cloud scenarios. To demonstrate its applicability, we discuss a federated learning workflow, where local training kernels interact with a shared global model through event-driven coordination. Compared to traditional workflow editors and general-purpose diagramming tools, the proposed system provides explicit execution semantics, modularity, and direct deployability. This work lays the foundation for visual orchestration of modular computation in distributed environments and offers extensibility for user-defined kernels, event types, and alternative execution backends, enabling future exploration of complex distributed applications.

</details>


### [350] [rush: Scalable Asynchronous Distributed Computing via Shared State in R](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21430)
*Marc Becker,Bernd Bischl*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 介绍了rush，一个R语言包，通过Redis数据库提供共享状态协调层，支持异步并行迭代算法的去中心化执行，填补了现有R并行计算包不支持此类模式的空白。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有流行的R语言并行计算包均采用中心化的控制器-工作器架构，无法支持统计学和机器学习中日益普遍的去中心化异步并行模式（如现代超参数优化），这限制了相关算法在R生态中的高效实现。

Method: 开发rush包，利用Redis数据库作为共享键值存储。工作器通过数据库读写任务数据，独立执行自身的循环，从而实现去中心化的异步并行。该包提供了管理任务及其生命周期的高级API，具备亚毫秒级单任务开销、鲁棒的错误处理（包括工作器丢失的自动检测）以及高效的缓存机制，并可选择性集成mlr3生态系统。

Result: rush实现了亚毫秒级的单任务开销，并能自动检测丢失的工作器。通过实现异步去中心化贝叶斯优化（ADBO），并在四个数据集上使用448个工作器对LightGBM进行超参数优化基准测试，验证了rush的实际应用价值。

Conclusion: rush成功为R语言提供了高效、稳健的共享状态协调层，支持去中心化异步并行算法，并已集成至bbotk和mlr3tuning等包中，推动了R生态系统在复杂并行优化任务中的应用能力。

Abstract: Many algorithms in statistics and machine learning can be parallelized in an asynchronous manner where workers need to communicate through shared state rather than execute independent tasks dispatched by a central controller. Especially in modern hyperparameter optimization and parallel black-box optimization with expensive objectives, this decentralized approach has become widespread, and several Python frameworks adopt it (e.g., Optuna, DeepHyper, and Hyperopt). However, all popular R packages for parallel computing follow a centralized controller-worker architecture that does not support this pattern. We present rush, an R package that provides a shared-state coordination layer for asynchronously parallelized iterative algorithms. rush uses a Redis database as a shared key-value store: workers read and write task data through the database and independently execute their own loops. The package provides a high-level API for managing tasks and their lifecycle, featuring sub-millisecond per-task overhead, robust error handling with automatic detection of lost workers, and efficient caching. rush optionally integrates with the mlr3 ecosystem, powering asynchronous optimization in the bbotk and mlr3tuning packages. We demonstrate the practical utility of rush by implementing asynchronous decentralized Bayesian optimization (ADBO) and benchmarking it on hyperparameter optimization of LightGBM across four datasets using 448 workers.

</details>


### [351] [Towards Global Multi-Cloud Strategies: Insights into AWS and Alibaba Cloud Synergy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21680)
*Martin G. Zizler,Malte Prieß,Christoph P. Neumann*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文通过IoT工作负载迁移案例，对比分析AWS和阿里云在架构、服务和策略上的差异，为多云互操作提供技术权衡和最佳实践。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代企业为提升敏捷性、弹性并降低供应商锁定风险而采用多云策略，但在AWS与阿里云之间进行跨云工作负载集成仍面临互操作性和迁移挑战。

Method: 结合云厂商原生和开源基础设施即代码工具，针对物联网(IoT)工作负载迁移开展探索性案例研究，对比分析两家云服务商在架构、服务和策略层面的差异。

Result: 揭示了多云部署中的关键技术权衡点，总结了实现安全多云部署的最佳实践，为组织实现AWS与阿里云的互操作性提供了具体指导。

Conclusion: 该研究为企业规划AWS与阿里云之间的工作负载迁移提供了实用的参考框架和决策依据，有助于降低多云架构的实施难度和风险。

Abstract: Multi-cloud strategies are increasingly adopted by modern enterprises to improve agility and resilience and to reduce vendor lock-in. Integrating workloads across providers, such as Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Alibaba Cloud, remains challenging due to interoperability and migration issues. This paper presents a comparative analysis of AWS and Alibaba Cloud, focusing on architectural, service, and policy differences affecting workload migration. Using both provider-native and open source Infrastructure-as-Code tools, we conduct an exploratory case study about the migration of Internet of Things (IoT) workloads. The results highlight key technical trade-offs and best practices for secure multi-cloud deployments, offering guidance for organizations pursuing AWS and Alibaba Cloud interoperability.

</details>


### [352] [Efficient Domain Decomposition for the Helmholtz Equation on GPUs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21695)
*Amit Rotem*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种面向GPU的Helmholtz方程高效并行求解方案，通过块级区域分解与WaveHoltz子域求解器的结合，在A100上实现了相比MINRES 2x-25x的加速，单精度下额外获得2x-10x提速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Helmholtz方程在声学、电磁学和地震学中描述波传播，但其不定性使传统迭代方法难以求解；同时，将高效的Helmholtz求解器映射到现代GPU架构仍具挑战性，需要消除设备级同步并优化内存访问模式。

Method: 提出两个关键贡献：(1) 块级区域分解方案，每个子域分配给单个线程块，所有求解在单次kernel启动中并发执行；(2) 采用WaveHoltz作为子域求解器——一种固定点迭代方法，具有最小内存占用且无归约操作的优势。探索了两种线程策略：小子域采用每线程一个自由度，大子域采用每线程多自由度。该方法消除了设备级同步，将全局内存流量替换为共享内存和寄存器级操作，使子域数据主要驻留在L1和L2缓存中。

Result: 在NVIDIA A100上的CUDA实现基准测试表明：WaveHoltz相比MINRES实现2x-25x加速，优势随子域尺寸增大而增加；关键地，单精度而非双精度评估子域求解器可额外获得2x-10x加速——这是MINRES在低精度下因Krylov向量正交性丢失而无法获得的优势。

Conclusion: 通过块级区域分解与WaveHoltz求解器的协同设计，成功实现了Helmholtz方程在GPU上的高效并行求解，充分发挥了GPU执行模型优势，为大规模波传播问题的高性能计算提供了可行方案。

Abstract: The Helmholtz equation governs wave propagation in acoustics, electromagnetics, and seismology, but its indefinite nature makes it difficult to solve with iterative methods. Domain decomposition methods are a natural fit for massively parallel architectures, yet mapping efficient Helmholtz solvers onto modern GPUs remains a challenge. We address both with two key contributions: (1) a block-level domain decomposition scheme, in which each subdomain is assigned to a single thread block and all solves run concurrently in a single kernel launch, and (2) WaveHoltz as the subdomain solver. WaveHoltz is a fixed-point iteration that is uniquely well-suited to the GPU execution model due to its minimal memory footprint and no reduction operations. Together, these eliminate device-level synchronizations and replace global memory traffic with shared memory and register-level operations, keeping subdomain data largely resident in L1 and L2 cache. We explore two threading strategies: one degree of freedom per thread for small subdomains, and multiple degrees of freedom per thread for larger ones. Benchmarks of our CUDA based implementation on a NVIDIA A100 show that WaveHoltz achieves 2x-25x speedup over MINRES, with the advantage growing with subdomain size. Crucially, evaluating the subdomain solver in single rather than double precision yields an additional 2x-10x speedup--a benefit largely unattainable by MINRES due to loss of Krylov vector orthogonality under reduced precision.

</details>


### [353] [BatchGen: An Architecture for Scalable and Efficient Batch Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21712)
*Tairan Xu,Leyang Xue,Zhan Lu,Jinfu Deng,Hongyang Xiao,Yinsicheng Jiang,Congjie He,Matej Sandor,Le Xu,Luo Mai*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出序列协程计算模型，解决大规模批量推理中的负载变化和利用率问题。基于此实现的BatchGen系统在128-GPU集群上减少完成时间达2.3倍，在内存受限场景下超越基线9.6倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有推理引擎沿用交互式服务执行模型，无法应对大规模批量推理的两个核心挑战：运行时出现的极端序列间和序列内负载变化，以及在GPU大规模集群中维持高利用率。现有系统在吞吐量上存在显著损失。

Method: 提出序列协程计算模型（sequence coroutine compute model），将每个序列表示为细粒度、事件驱动的协程。该模型提供表达性原语，支持运行时动态重组工作：构建更大的专家级批次、缓解落后者问题、跨设备重新分配工作负载，并在性价比或内存受限GPU上保持高利用率。基于此架构实现生产级系统BatchGen。

Result: 在128-GPU集群上，BatchGen将批量完成时间减少高达2.3倍；在内存受限加速器上，相比最强的卸载基线性能提升高达9.6倍。

Conclusion: 序列协程计算模型为批量推理提供了新的架构基础，能够有效解决大规模场景下的负载均衡和资源利用问题，BatchGen已开源，为工业级大规模AI推理提供了高效解决方案。

Abstract: Batch inference has become a central mode of AI computation, yet existing inference engines still rely on execution models designed for interactive serving. When scaled to millions of sequences, batch workloads reveal two fundamental requirements: the ability to handle extreme inter- and intra-sequence load variation that emerges only at runtime, and the ability to sustain high utilization across large fleets of GPUs. Existing systems fail to meet these requirements, losing substantial fractions of achievable throughput.
  We introduce a new architectural foundation for batch inference: the sequence coroutine compute model, which represents each sequence as a fine-grained, event-driven coroutine. This model exposes expressive primitives that allow the runtime to reorganize work dynamically, enabling larger expert-level batches, mitigating stragglers, reallocating work across devices, and maintaining utilization even on cost-effective or memory-constrained GPUs. Building on this abstraction, we implement BatchGen, a production-ready system that uses the coroutine model at cluster scale. On a 128-GPU cluster, BatchGen reduces batch completion time by up to $2.3\times$, and on memory-constrained accelerators it outperforms the strongest offloading baseline by up to $9.6\times$. We will open-source BatchGen at https://github.com/batchgen-project/batchgen

</details>


### [354] [KineticSim: A Lightweight, High-Performance Execution Engine for Real-Time Market Simulators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21784)
*Shakya Jayakody,Prarthinie Jayakody*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 提出了一种基于GPU的高效并行设计模式，通过持久化线程块共享内存缓存和协作清算，实现了大规模金融市场多智能体仿真的数量级加速，峰值吞吐量达547亿事件/秒。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模金融市场多智能体仿真对市场设计、监管压力测试和强化学习至关重要，但传统CPU仿真器受限于串行处理瓶颈，而现有的向量化GPU框架则面临内核启动开销和冗余全局内存往返的性能限制。

Method: 形式化并实现了一种可重用的并行设计模式——持久化状态承载清算机制：通过在线程块共享内存中缓存可变仿真状态、使用共享内存原子操作聚合智能体动作、协作式求解清算函数，将每步关键路径深度从Theta(L+A)降低至Theta(log L + ceil(A/L))，并使全局内存流量独立于步数。该模式在轻量级GPU执行引擎KineticSim中实现，可并行仿真大规模限价订单簿集成。

Result: 在固定工作负载下，相比CPU(NumPy)加速3406倍，相比PyTorch GPU加速27.8倍，相比JAX GPU加速42.8倍，相比朴素CUDA基线加速8.4倍；峰值吞吐量超过547亿智能体事件/秒；GPU内存使用量比PyTorch减少约一个数量级；在53种配置下，两个自定义CUDA引擎产生位级相同的订单簿，聚合统计量与CPU参考实现偏差在0.1%以内。

Conclusion: 该并行设计模式成功解决了大规模多智能体金融市场仿真的性能瓶颈问题，不仅实现了显著的加速效果和资源效率提升，还保持了数值精度。该模式具有良好的通用性，可推广至其他需要状态持久化和块级归约的迭代多智能体工作负载场景。

Abstract: Simulating financial markets at scale with multi-agent (Agent-Based) models is critical for market design, regulatory stress-testing, and reinforcement learning, but traditional CPU simulators are bottlenecked by sequential processing while vectorized GPU frameworks suffer from kernel-launch overhead and redundant global-memory round-trips. We formalize, analyze, and evaluate a reusable parallel design pattern: persistent, state-carrying clearing for iterative multi-agent reductions. By caching mutable simulation state in thread-block shared memory across step boundaries, aggregating agent actions via shared-memory atomics, and resolving the clearing function cooperatively, the pattern reduces the per-step critical-path depth from Theta(L+A) for sequential clearing (L price-grid ticks, A agents) to Theta(log L + ceil(A/L)) and makes global-memory traffic independent of the step count. We implement this in KineticSim, a lightweight GPU execution engine that simulates massive ensembles of limit-order books in parallel, reaching a peak throughput of over 54.7 billion agent-events per second. On a fixed workload it delivers speedups of 3406x over CPU (NumPy), 27.8x over PyTorch GPU, 42.8x over JAX GPU, and 8.4x over a naive custom CUDA baseline, while using roughly an order of magnitude less GPU memory than PyTorch. Across 53 configurations the two custom CUDA engines produce bitwise-identical order books, and aggregate statistics match the CPU reference to within 0.1%. The pattern generalizes to other iterative multi-agent workloads requiring state-persistent, block-localized reductions.

</details>


### [355] [Rethinking Burst Buffer Optimization: Enabling Layout Heterogeneity via Hybrid Analysis and LLM Guidance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21852)
*Yuhan Cai,Huijun Wu,Zhuo Tang,Kehua Guo,Wenzhe Zhang,Zhenwei Wu,Zhouyang Jia,Ruibo Wang,Yong Dong*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 提出了Proteus，一个语义感知的Burst Buffer系统，通过将数据布局作为首要优化维度，利用静态代码结构和轻量级运行时信号重构应用I/O意图，在无需预训练或详尽分析的情况下实现最优数据布局选择。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Burst Buffer文件系统因固定数据布局无法适应多样化应用行为而导致结构性能下降；基于机器学习的优化方法仅调整存储栈参数，在I/O模式与数据组织根本不匹配时收益递减，且训练成本高昂、需要侵入式性能分析。

Method: 提出Proteus系统，采用混合流水线和单次执行探针技术，协同结合静态代码结构与轻量级运行时信号来重构应用I/O意图，从而在生产运行前提取潜在语义线索以确定最优布局，无需预先训练或穷举式性能分析。

Result: 在代表性HPC工作负载上的评估表明，Proteus实现了91.30%的决策准确率；对于写密集型和元数据密集型工作负载，分别实现了高达3.24倍和2.9倍的加速。

Conclusion: 通过将数据布局作为一等优化维度并利用语义感知方法，Proteus成功解决了现有方法在数据布局与应用I/O模式不匹配时的局限性，为HPC系统中的I/O瓶颈问题提供了一种高效、低成本的解决方案。

Abstract: Burst buffers (BBs) are essential for mitigating I/O bottlenecks in modern HPC systems. However, existing BB file systems often suffer from structural performance degradation due to fixed data layouts that fail to align with diverse application behaviors. While current machine-learning-based optimizations focus primarily on tuning storage stack parameters for a given layout, they offer diminishing returns when a fundamental mismatch exists between I/O patterns and the underlying data organization. Furthermore, these approaches typically incur prohibitive costs due to extensive training or intrusive profiling. To bridge this gap, we present Proteus, a semantic-aware BB system that treats data layout as a first-class optimization dimension. The core insight of Proteus is that application I/O intent can be reconstructed by synergetically combining static code structures with lightweight runtime signals. Through a hybrid pipeline and a single execution probe, Proteus extracts latent semantic cues to determine the optimal layout prior to production runs-eliminating the need for prior training or exhaustive profiling. Evaluation with representative HPC workloads shows that Proteus achieves 91.30\% decision accuracy, delivering up to 3.24$\times$ and 2.9$\times$ speedups for write-intensive and metadata-intensive workloads, respectively.

</details>


### [356] [StickyInvoc: Rethinking Task Models for High-throughput Workflows in the LLM Era](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.22175)
*Thanh Son Phung,Douglas Thain*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出StickyInvoc，一种针对高吞吐量LLM工作流的新型任务模型，通过将状态创建与计算执行解耦，避免了重复加载模型参数的开销，实现了3.6倍加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统任务模型在高吞吐量LLM工作流中存在严重的性能瓶颈：每个推理任务都需要从存储系统加载GB级模型参数到GPU内存，这种"创建-销毁"模式产生了巨大的开销，加之LLM本身的高启动成本、大规模任务数量以及资源的异构性和可抢占性，形成了显著的性能障碍。

Method: 提出StickyInvoc双任务模型：(1) "sticky"任务：在计算节点上创建持久化状态，但自身不执行实际计算；(2) "invocation"任务：继承已创建的状态执行实际计算，无需重复创建状态或退出时销毁状态。这种设计将计算状态的创建和销毁解耦，使LLM模型状态只需创建一次，成本分摊到多个后续调用任务中。

Result: 在包含20个GPU的稳定测试平台上，重写后的声明验证工作流（150k次推理）实现了3.6倍加速；通过增量扩展到186个空闲GPU，仅需784秒即可完成。

Conclusion: StickyInvoc通过引入粘性任务和调用任务的共生关系，有效解决了高吞吐量LLM工作流中的状态创建开销问题，显著提升了性能，为HPC环境下的LLM大规模推理提供了高效的解决方案。

Abstract: The integration of LLMs into high-throughput workflows is creating a new class of workloads on HPC clusters that promises to accelerate advances in scientific discovery with unprecedented generative capabilities. However, the traditional task model imposes a prohibitive overhead in this new domain: each task must create its computational state from scratch and destroy it upon completion. For each LLM inference task, this "create-destroy" model forces the repeated and costly transfer of multi-gigabyte model parameters from a long-term, reliable storage to a compute node's local disk, its CPU memory, and finally its GPU memory. This overhead, compounded by the inherently high startup cost of LLM inference, the typical scale of thousands of tasks in high-throughput workflows, and the heterogeneous and preemptible nature of high-throughput resources, presents a significant performance barrier.
  To overcome this barrier, this paper presents StickyInvoc: a symbiotic relationship between two new task models for high-throughput workflows. Specifically, a "sticky" task creates a persistent state on a compute node from a user-provided template, but doesn't execute any goodput computation by itself. Instead, this state is then inherited by subsequent "invocation" tasks, which perform the actual computation without incurring the state creation overhead or destroying the state upon exit. StickyInvoc thus allows the decoupling of the creation and destruction of computational states, allowing the computational state of LLM models to be created once per sticky task and its cost amortized over many subsequent invocation tasks. Our evaluation shows that when rewritten in the StickyInvoc paradigm, a claim verification workflow consisting of 150k inferences achieves a 3.6x speedup on a stable testbed with 20 GPUs, and completes in just 784 seconds by incrementally scaling out to 186 otherwise idle GPUs.

</details>


### [357] [FeLoG: Scalable and Efficient Distributed Graph Embedding with Feedback Loop Mechanism](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.22180)
*Peng Fang,Arijit Khan,Ziqiang Wu,Zhenli Li,Yibo Zhou,Fang Wang,Dan Feng*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: FeLoG是一个反馈循环驱动的分布式图嵌入系统，通过动态优先采样欠训练节点、优化通信策略和流水线设计，在大规模图上实现了27.9倍平均加速，通信成本降低超过53.1%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图嵌入框架采用采样-训练分离的范式，导致对已充分训练区域的冗余探索和对欠训练节点的采样不足，同时在分布式环境中引发过度通信、执行序列化和资源利用率低等系统级问题。

Method: 提出FeLoG系统，包含三个核心技术：(1)反馈耦合的采样与训练，根据实时嵌入质量反馈动态优先采样欠训练节点；(2)活动感知通信，压缩频繁出现的节点序列以减少机内PCIe流量，选择性同步频繁更新的嵌入以减少机间通信；(3)轮次交错流水线，将下一轮采样与当前轮训练重叠以提升CPU-GPU利用率。

Result: 在六个最先进基线方法上的实验表明，FeLoG在大规模图上实现平均27.9倍加速，通信成本降低超过53.1%，CPU-GPU利用率维持在80%以上。

Conclusion: FeLoG成功解决了现有图嵌入系统的采样-训练分离问题，通过反馈驱动机制显著提升了收敛速度和资源利用效率，为大规模图嵌入提供了可扩展的高效解决方案。

Abstract: Graph embedding maps graph nodes into low-dimensional vectors to support applications such as recommendation, fraud detection, and graph-based retrieval-augmented generation (GraphRAG). As graphs scale to billions of edges, scalable and efficient graph embedding has become increasingly important. Existing frameworks commonly adopt a sampling-training paradigm, in which mini-batches are constructed by sampling nodes and their neighbors. However, sampling is typically decoupled from evolving embedding quality, causing redundant exploration of well-trained regions while under-sampling undertrained nodes. At the system level, such decoupling further leads to excessive communication, serialized execution, and low resource utilization in distributed environments. We present FeLoG, a feedback loop-driven system for scalable distributed graph embedding. (1) FeLoG introduces feedback-coupled sampling and training, dynamically prioritizing undertrained nodes according to real-time embedding-quality feedback, thereby reducing redundant computation and accelerating convergence. (2) It employs activity-aware communication that compresses frequently occurring node sequences to reduce intra-machine PCIe traffic and selectively synchronizes frequently updated embeddings to reduce inter-machine communication. (3) It adopts a round-interleaved pipeline that overlaps next-round sampling with current-round training to improve CPU-GPU utilization. Experiments against six state-of-the-art baselines on large-scale graphs show that FeLoG achieves an average speedup of 27.9x, reduces communication cost by more than 53.1%, and sustains over 80% CPU-GPU utilization.

</details>


### [358] [Hardwired Pattern Formation by Mobile Robots with Common Unit Distance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.22386)
*Yuta Kojima,Sébastien Tixeuil,Yukiko Yamauchi*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出了硬连线模式形成(HwPTF)问题，要求机器人在指定尺寸下形成目标模式，并给出了多种模型下可解性结果及算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的模式形成问题允许目标模式进行平移、旋转和缩放，而实际应用中可能需要机器人在指定尺寸下精确形成目标模式。因此，作者提出了硬连线模式形成(HwPTF)问题，要求机器人在给定尺寸下形成目标模式，填补了这一研究空白。

Method: 针对不同计算模型进行研究：(1)分析两个健忘半同步机器人的可解性；(2)分析两个健忘异步机器人配备灯的可解性；(3)为四个以上健忘半同步机器人设计尺寸调整算法，并与现有效模式形成算法结合。

Result: (1)两个健忘半同步机器人无法解决多重性为2的HwPTF问题（即会合问题），但可解决无多重性的HwPTF问题；(2)两个健忘异步机器人无法解决HwPTF问题，但配备灯后可以解决；(3)为四个以上健忘半同步机器人提出了尺寸调整算法。

Conclusion: 硬连线模式形成问题的可解性取决于计算模型和机器人能力。健忘性、同步性和外部设备（如灯）对问题可解性有显著影响，提出的算法为多机器人系统提供了在指定尺寸下形成模式的解决方案。

Abstract: The pattern formation (PTF) problem requires mobile robots to form a specified target pattern. Existing papers investigated the PTF problem and revealed the effect of obliviousness and synchronization on distributed coordination of mobile robots. However, the PTF problem allows translation, rotation, and scaling of the target pattern. In this paper, we introduce a novel pattern formation problem, called the hardwired pattern formation (HwPTF) problem that requires the robots to form a given target pattern in a specified size. Although two oblivious semi-synchronous robots cannot solve the HwPTF problem of multiplicity two (i.e., the rendezvous problem), we show that they can solve the HwPTF problem without multiplicity. We also show that two oblivious asynchronous robots equipped with lights can solve the HwPTF problem, while oblivious asynchronous robots cannot. We finally present a size-adjusting algorithm for more than four oblivious semi-synchronous robots, that yields a HwPTF algorithm when combined with some existing pattern formation algorithms.

</details>


### [359] [ASAP: A Disaggregated and Asynchronous Inference System for MoE Prefill](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.22541)
*Weiwei Chen,Shuang Chen,Lele Li,Qiang Hu,Han Li,Xin Ye,Ming Yan,Zhibin Yu*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出了ASAP系统，通过解耦注意力层和MoE层并实现全异步执行流水线，消除了混合并行策略中的全局同步屏障，将首令牌时间(TTFT)的吞吐量提升了90%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代MoE服务系统采用数据并行(DP)与专家并行(EP)混合策略，在注意力阶段和MoE阶段之间需要频繁的全局同步屏障。由于在线服务中请求到达率和序列长度差异显著，导致DP负载不均衡，引发严重的同步延迟，损害了TTFT和系统吞吐量。

Method: 提出ASAP异步推理系统：1)将注意力层与MoE层解耦；2)实现全异步执行流水线；3)设计专门的异步通信原语；4)在请求调度和模型执行层面实施四项协同优化，彻底消除全局同步屏障。

Result: 在CloudMatrix384超节点上的实验评估表明，与最先进的同步服务方案相比，ASAP将符合SLO要求的预填充阶段吞吐量提升了90%。

Conclusion: ASAP通过异步架构设计有效解决了MoE模型在线服务中的DP负载不均衡和同步延迟问题，显著提升了系统的首令牌时间性能和吞吐量，为大规模MoE模型的高效服务提供了新思路。

Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models have become the de facto standard for scaling large language models. To maintain computational efficiency, modern MoE serving systems typically employ a hybrid parallelism strategy, combining Data Parallelism (DP) for attention stages with Expert Parallelism (EP) for MoE stages. However, this design necessitates frequent global synchronization barriers between attention DP groups and experts. In online serving, significant variance in request arrival rates and sequence lengths inherently leads to DP imbalance, causing severe synchronization stalls that degrade Time-to-First-Token (TTFT) and system throughput. We present ASAP, an asynchronous inference system specifically designed to accelerate the prefill phase of MoE models. ASAP disaggregates the attention and MoE stages and implements a fully asynchronous execution pipeline. This is achieved through a suite of specialized asynchronous communication primitives and four coordinated optimizations across request scheduling and model execution, which collectively dismantle global synchronization barriers. We implement and evaluate ASAP on CloudMatrix384 super-nodes, demonstrating that it improves SLO-compliant prefill throughput by 90% compared to state-of-the-art synchronous serving solutions.

</details>


### [360] [EchoFlow: A Workload-Aware Parameter Tuning Method for Blockchain Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.22934)
*Ben Lian,Linpeng Jia,Xing Chen,Xiaofeng Chen,Yi Sun*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出了EchoFlow，一个自适应的区块链参数调优框架，通过分布式强化学习和遗传算法加速，实现了在不同工作负载下的持续性能优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 区块链系统包含大量可调参数，这些参数显著影响系统性能。然而在实践中，通常对不同的工作负载采用单一参数配置，导致大量性能潜力未被发掘。

Method: 提出EchoFlow框架，采用分布式强化学习方法，通过多个actor并行采样来缓解区块链环境中样本生成耗时巨大的问题。为了进一步加速收敛，在训练初始阶段引入遗传算法生成高质量样本。

Result: 大量实验评估表明，EchoFlow在各种工作负载场景下始终优于现有方法，同时减少了训练时间，证明了其有效性和实用价值。

Conclusion: EchoFlow能够根据工作负载特征自适应调整参数配置，实现持续性能优化，具有良好的有效性和实际应用价值。

Abstract: Blockchain systems expose a large number of tunable parameters that significantly influence system performance. However, in practice, a single parameter configuration is often applied across different workloads, leaving substantial unexploited performance potential. To address this, we propose EchoFlow, a blockchain parameter tuning framework that adaptively adjusts parameter configurations based on workload characteristics, enabling continuous performance optimization. EchoFlow employs a distributed reinforcement learning approach in which multiple actors perform parallel sampling to mitigate the substantial time required for sample generation in blockchain environments. To further accelerate convergence, we introduce a genetic algorithm during the initial phase of training to generate high-quality samples. Extensive experimental evaluations demonstrate that EchoFlow consistently outperforms existing methods across diverse workload scenarios while also reducing training time, highlighting its effectiveness and practical value.

</details>


### [361] [Decentralized Operations of Decarbonized Chemical Plants with Renewable-driven Transmission Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.22973)
*Richard Reed,kazi Arman Ahmed,Saba Ghasemi,Zheyu Jiang,Paritosh Ramanan*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于数据隔离的隐私友好型分散框架，用于联合优化电力系统机组组合问题和电气化乙烷裂解装置微网调度，在保护化工厂运营数据隐私的同时实现了电力系统与化工系统的协同规划。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 乙烷裂解电气化是实现工业脱碳的有前景途径，但将电气化化工厂微网与脱碳电网集成需要独立系统运营商与化工厂进行联合运营规划。由于化工厂运营数据的高度机密性，这种跨系统协作受到严重阻碍，因此需要开发既能保护数据隐私又能实现协同优化的方法。

Method: 采用交替方向乘子法(ADMM)构建分散式优化框架，引入辅助系统级惩罚项加速收敛。该方法允许各子系统求解本地子问题，仅共享最小化的协调信号，从而实现数据隔离。研究基于ACTIVSg2000测试案例(德克萨斯州输电网络合成模型)，将识别的26个德克萨斯州化工厂映射到最近的电网连接点进行数值实验。

Result: 数据隔离导致的分散优化在联合电力和化工系统决策中产生了一致较小的最优性间隙，表明隐私保护与优化质量可以较好平衡。排放后果呈现负荷依赖性和非单调性特征。

Conclusion: 所提出的隐私友好型分散框架能够有效解决电气化化工厂与电网联合运营中的数据隐私问题，在保护商业机密的同时实现了合理的优化性能，为工业脱碳过程中的跨系统协作提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Electrification of ethane cracking offers a promising pathway to industrial decarbonization, provided that the electricity is sourced from renewable energy. However, integrating electrified chemical plant microgrids with a decarbonized power grid requires joint operations planning between Independent System Operators and chemical plants, which is hindered by the highly confidential nature of plant operational data. In this paper, we propose a privacy-friendly decentralized framework based on data isolation that jointly optimizes the Unit Commitment problem in the power system and microgrid scheduling in electrified ethane cracker plants. The framework employs the Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers, augmented with an auxiliary system-level penalty that accelerates convergence, allowing each subsystem to solve its local subproblem and share only minimal coordination signals.
