To reflect real-world conditions, numerical experiments are conducted on the ACTIVSg2000 test case, a synthetic model of the Texas transmission network, with 26 chemical plants identified from Texas mapped to their nearest grid connection points. In doing so, we characterize the cost of privacy-friendly decomposition on joint power and chemical system decisions, showing that data isolation results in consistently small optimality gaps, and that its emissions consequences are load-dependent and non-monotone.

</details>


### [362] [LiveServe: Interaction-Aware Serving for Real-Time Omni-Modal LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.22983)
*Xiangyu Zhi,Peiqi Yin,Sheng Guan,Chenguang Zheng,James Cheng,Xiao Yan*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: LiveServe是一个面向实时全模态大模型的交互感知服务系统，通过感知音频播放进度和用户中断事件来优化调度和KV缓存管理，显著降低了音频首包延迟并提升了吞吐量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的全模态大模型服务系统仍采用面向吞吐量的LLM调度和LRU KV卸载策略，忽略了音频播放进度和多轮对话复用特性，导致在用户打断时产生无效计算，且可能驱逐下一轮所需的KV状态。

Method: LiveServe将播放进度、语音活动和打断事件暴露给服务流水线。调度器优先处理首音频和接近欠运行的会话，同时限制超出播放边界的生成；KV管理器采用下次使用感知的驱逐策略，并在用户说话期间预加载可能需要的KV以隐藏重载延迟。

Result: 在vLLM-Omni上，LiveServe将P90音频TTFP平均降低1.55倍（最高2.21倍），完成请求吞吐量平均提升1.15倍（最高1.56倍），并将大部分KV重载工作移出下一轮的关键路径。

Conclusion: LiveServe证明了在实时全模态大模型交互场景中，引入交互感知的调度和KV管理策略能够显著提升服务性能和用户体验，为实时多模态对话系统的优化提供了有效方案。

Abstract: Realtime omni-modal LMs support speech-centric conversations where users stream inputs, hear generated audio, and interrupt freely. Existing Omni-LM serving systems still rely on throughput-oriented LLM scheduling and LRU KV offloading. These policies ignore audio playback and multi-turn reuse: they may generate tokens far beyond what users hear, wasting work after barge-in, and evict KV state needed in the next turn. LiveServe is an interaction-aware serving system for realtime Omni-LM interaction. It exposes playback progress, speech activity, and barge-in events to the serving pipeline. The scheduler prioritizes first-audio and near-underrun sessions while limiting generation beyond the playback frontier. The KV manager uses next-use-aware eviction and preloads likely-needed KV during user speech to hide reload latency. On vLLM-Omni, LiveServe improves realtime serving across two Omni-LMs and mixed workloads. It lowers P90 audio TTFP by $1.55\times$ on average and up to $2.21\times$, while improving completed-request throughput by $1.15\times$ on average and up to $1.56\times$, and moves most KV reload work off the next-turn critical path.

</details>


### [363] [Nautilus: A Verifiable Hierarchical Federated Learning Framework for Vehicular-Edge-Cloud Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.23017)
*Linyang Wu,Linpeng Jia,Hanwen Zhang,Tiantian Duan,Yi Sun*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出了Nautilus，一个面向车联网场景的可验证高效联邦学习框架，通过多维度资源感知调度算法和零知识证明机制，在保证隐私的前提下解决了资源异构性导致的效率问题以及动态调度带来的信任问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦学习在车联网场景中面临车辆边缘云资源极端异构性问题，严重限制了系统效率；虽然动态调度策略可以缓解该问题，但引入了新的信任挑战：如何验证调度决策的公平性，以及如何在不泄露隐私的情况下验证客户端是否忠实执行优化指令。

Method: 设计了两个核心机制：1）多维度资源感知调度算法，根据车辆的带宽、延迟和计算能力动态分配压缩比率和训练任务，显著提升系统训练效率；2）引入零知识证明(ZKP)机制，确保调度策略生成的公平性和客户端执行的合规性，同时保护隐私。

Result: 实验结果表明，该框架有效降低了通信开销，加速了模型收敛，同时保持了系统完整性。

Conclusion: Nautilus框架成功实现了在保护隐私的前提下，同时解决了车联网联邦学习中的资源异构性效率问题和动态调度的信任问题，为车联网场景下的可信高效联邦学习提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Federated Learning (FL) enables privacy-preserving collaborative learning for Internet of Vehicles (IoV) scenarios, but the extreme heterogeneity of vehicular-edge-cloud resources severely limits system efficiency. While dynamic scheduling strategies can mitigate this issue, they introduce new trust concerns: how to verify that scheduling decisions are fair, and whether clients faithfully execute optimization instructions without disclosing private data? This paper proposes Nautilus, a verifiable and efficient federated learning framework. First, we design a multi-dimensional resource-aware scheduling algorithm that dynamically allocates compression ratios and training tasks based on vehicles bandwidth, latency, and computing power, significantly improving system training efficiency. Second, to address the trust deficit in the scheduling process, we introduce a Zero-Knowledge Proof (ZKP) mechanism that ensures the fairness of scheduling strategy generation and the compliance of client execution while preserving privacy. Experimental results demonstrate that the framework effectively reduces communication overhead and accelerates model convergence while maintaining system integrity.

</details>


### [364] [Solving Approximate Agreement on continuous and discrete spaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.23260)
*Augustin Albert,Sergio Rajsbaum*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文在异步共享内存模型下研究近似一致问题的无等待可解性，证明CUB空间中ε-一致问题总是可解，并证明单纯复形上的单纯一致问题对n+1个进程可解当且仅当该复形是(n-1)-连通的。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近似一致问题是分布式计算中的基础问题，其可解性依赖于输入空间、有效性条件和进程数量。现有研究分别处理连续和离散输入空间，缺乏统一的理论框架。本文旨在为广泛的输入空间类别（包括连续的CUB空间和离散的单纯复形）建立完整的可解性刻画。

Method: 论文分为连续和离散两种情况：(1) 对于连续情况，引入CUB空间概念，这是一类具有唯一凸性定义的度量空间，涵盖经典的ε-一致和m维近似一致问题；(2) 对于离散情况，研究单纯复形上的单纯一致问题，利用代数拓扑工具分析其可解性与复形连通性之间的关系。

Result: 主要结果包括：(1) 在连续设置中，证明了ε-一致问题在每个CUB空间中都是可解的；(2) 在离散设置中，证明了单纯复形C上的单纯一致问题对n+1个进程可解当且仅当C是(n-1)-连通的；(3) 作为推论，证明了Ledent的一个猜想。

Conclusion: 本文为近似一致问题提供了统一的理论框架和完整的可解性刻画。连续情况下的CUB空间条件以及离散情况下单纯复形的连通性条件，为理解和设计分布式算法提供了重要的理论基础，同时揭示了代数拓扑与分布式计算之间的深刻联系。

Abstract: We consider $n$ asynchronous processes prone to crashes, communicating via shared read-write registers, and study the wait-free solvability of approximate agreement: given inputs, processes must output values that are close to each other, and satisfy a validity property. At the very least, if inputs are identical, all outputs must equal that input.
  The problem has been studied for various input spaces: continuous, discrete, one-dimensional or multidimensional. For metric spaces, validity requires outputs to lie in the convex hull of the inputs. For graphs, and more generally simplicial complexes, several conditions exist. We focus on simplex validity: if inputs span a simplex $σ$, then outputs are in $σ$. Agreement requires that outputs span a simplex.
  Solvability depends on the input space, validity condition, and number of processes. For example, the problem is solvable for all $n$ in the plane, but only for $n \leq 2$ when removing a point. For a graph, solvability for $n=2$ holds iff the graph is connected, but $n\geq 3$ requires acyclicity.
  In the continuous setting, we consider CUB spaces: a broad class of metric spaces admitting a unique convexity definition, subsuming classical $ε$-agreement on $[0,1]$ and $m$-dimensional approximate agreement. Our results show that $ε$-agreement is solvable in every CUB space. In the discrete case, we prove that simplex agreement on a simplicial complex $\mathcal{C}$ is solvable for $n+1$ processes iff $\mathcal{C}$ is $(n-1)$-connected. We discuss several consequences, including a proof of a conjecture by Ledent.

</details>


### [365] [Node-Level Performance and Energy Characterization of Flagship Science Applications on SuperMUC-NG Phase 2](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.23265)
*Salvatore Cielo,Elmira Birang,Alexander Pöppl,Sajad Azizi,Plamen Dobrev,Margarita Egelhofer,Ivan Pribec,Gerald Mathias*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文对SuperMUC-NG二期系统上五类科学计算负载进行了系统性能与能效表征，结果显示GPU卸载相比纯CPU执行可获得4-12倍吞吐量提升和最高15倍能效改善，但收益受问题粒度影响显著。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着异构超级计算机的普及，系统化评估CPU+GPU架构在实际科学计算负载上的性能与能效表现变得至关重要。现有研究缺乏对多种领域旗舰应用在最新Intel Xeon CPU与Ponte Vecchio GPU加速器组合上的全面表征。

Method: 在配备Intel Xeon Platinum 8480+ CPU和Intel Data Center GPU Max 1550 (Ponte Vecchio)加速器的SuperMUC-NG系统上，选取五个代表性科学计算负载（分子动力学gromacs和lammps、天体物理学OpenGadget3和AthenaK、有限元PDE求解器dealii-X），在单计算节点层面测量吞吐量和能效指标。对比纯CPU配置(SPR)与CPU+GPU配置(SPR+PVC)，使用轻量级代码插桩工具p3em或系统集成的Energy Aware Runtime (EAR)进行能耗测量。

Result: GPU卸载相比纯CPU执行实现4-12倍吞吐量提升，能效改善最高达15倍，其中lammps和AthenaK收益最为显著。但性能和能效增益对问题粒度高度敏感：GPU tile上工作负载不足会削弱加速器优势，这在AthenaK小mesh-block尺寸时表现明显。CPU的功耗预算利用率系统性低于GPU，表明即使在峰值有效工作率下，CPU上运行的大多数应用仍有相当部分节点热设计功耗未被利用。

Conclusion: 异构CPU+GPU架构能显著提升科学计算应用的吞吐量和能效，但实际收益取决于问题粒度与GPU工作负载的匹配程度。应用开发者需关注问题规模与GPU架构的协同优化，以充分利用加速器潜力并改善系统能效。

Abstract: We present a systematic performance and energy-efficiency characterization of five flagship scientific workloads on SuperMUC-NG phase 2, the 28 PetaFLOPs system at the Leibniz Supercomputing Center (LRZ) equipped with Intel Xeon Platinum 8480+ and Intel Data Center GPU Max 1550 (Ponte Vecchio, PVC) accelerators. The selected codes span molecular dynamics (gromacs, lammps), astrophysics and cosmology (OpenGadget3, AthenaK), and finite-element PDE solvers from the dealii-X Center of Excellence. For each code we measure throughput and energy efficiency expressed as compute-elements per wall-clock second (or per Joule of consumed energy) on a single compute node, comparing CPU-only (SPR) against combined CPU+GPU (SPR+PVC) configurations where available. Energy measurements rely on lightweight code instrumentation with p3em, or the Energy Aware Runtime (EAR) present on the system. Our results show that GPU offload yields $4-12\times$ higher throughput and up to $15\times$ better energy efficiency compared to CPU-only execution, with lammps and AthenaK benefiting most. However, both throughput and energy gains are sensitive to problem granularity: insufficient work per GPU tile erodes the accelerator advantage, as clearly observed in AthenaK at small mesh-block sizes. The power-budget utilization is systematically lower for CPUs than it is for GPUs, indicating that even at peak useful-work rate, most applications running on CPUs leave a significant fraction of the node's thermal envelope unused.

</details>


### [366] [When Staking Rewards Compound: Measuring the Impact of Ethereum's Pectra Upgrade](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.23337)
*Mohammed Benseddik,Benjamin Kraner,Claudio J. Tessone*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文研究以太坊Pectra升级引入的0x02复利验证者机制对质押收益的影响。模拟显示复利机制为小额质押者提供约5%的共识层APR提升，大型质押服务商的收益增幅不足1%。实证分析表明，尽管单节点验证者采用率较高，但运营障碍和基础设施成本限制了迁移速度，该转型仍将缓慢推进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 以太坊信标链拥有超过92万个活跃验证者，这一庞大数量是由传统32 ETH质押上限导致的。Pectra升级（2025年5月）通过引入0x02复利验证者来解决此问题，将每个验证者的最大质押额度从32 ETH提升至2,048 ETH，并支持奖励自动再投资。研究旨在分析复利机制对共识层奖励的影响、较高余额是否带来执行层优势，以及APR提升是否足以证明不同类型质押者进行迁移的合理性。

Method: 采用仿真模拟方法分析复利机制对不同规模质押者共识层APR的影响；对信标链所有活跃验证者进行实证分析，比较0x02验证者与传统验证者的中位CL APR差异；研究单节点验证者和质押服务商的采用模式；分析整合机制（将多个32 ETH验证者合并为一个）在早期迁移中的作用；识别阻碍迁移的关键障碍。

Result: 复利机制为小额质押提供约+5%的相对共识层APR提升，对大型质押服务商的APR提升不足1%；实证数据显示0x02验证者实现了略高的中位CL APR；单节点验证者表现出更高的相对采用率，但面临运营障碍；质押服务商则面临基础设施成本和协议约束；整合机制在早期迁移中发挥了重要作用。

Conclusion: 研究结果表明，尽管0x02迁移具有网络效率优势，但在缺乏改进的奖励可及性和更强经济激励的情况下，该转型仍将保持渐进式发展，难以实现快速普及。收益提升的空间有限，特别是对大型质押服务商而言，激励力度不足以抵消迁移成本。

Abstract: Ethereum's beacon chain hosts over 920,000 active validators, a number inflated by the legacy 32 ETH stake cap. The Pectra upgrade (May 2025) addresses this by introducing 0x02 compounding validators, raising the maximum stake per validator from 32 to 2,048 ETH and enabling automatic reward reinvestment. This paper examines how compounding affects consensus-layer rewards, whether higher balances provide execution-layer advantages, and whether the APR uplift justifies migration for different staker types. We analyse adoption patterns across solo stakers and staking providers, investigate the role of consolidation (merging multiple 32 ETH validators into one) in early migration, and identify barriers slowing the transition. Through simulation, we find that compounding provides roughly +5% relative consensus-layer APR uplift for small balances, diminishing to under 1% for large staking providers. Empirical analysis of all active beacon chain validators shows 0x02 validators achieving modestly higher median CL APR. Solo stakers show higher relative adoption but face operational barriers, whilst providers cite infrastructure costs and protocol constraints. The results suggest that without improved reward accessibility and stronger economic incentives, 0x02 migration will remain gradual despite its network efficiency benefits.

</details>


### [367] [Development and Design of FLKit: A Structured Onboarding Toolkit for Federated Learning in Health and Life Sciences](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.23500)
*Ashkan Pirmani,Ilse Vermeulen,Goran Vinterhalter,Lotte Geys,Axel Faes,Muhammad Quamber Ali,Nishkala Sattanathan,Geert Vandeweyer,Yves Moreau,Liesbet M. Peeters*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: FLKit是一个面向联邦学习的开放式入门工具包，为多学科团队提供结构化的全生命周期指导，解决医疗生命科学领域联邦学习项目启动困难的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦学习虽适用于隐私监管严格的医疗生命科学研究，但实践团队面临框架分散、治理义务复杂、角色定位不清等障碍，缺乏符合其背景的结构化起始点，导致项目启动困难。

Method: 参考ELIXIR研究数据管理工具包设计，由多学科核心团队、更广泛的联盟以及外部从业者共同构建。工具包包含四个生命周期阶段（治理、基础设施、数据整理、分析），11个角色特定入口点，跨学科术语表，FAIR对齐的可复用FL Story模板，以及工具框架社区目录。

Result: 自2024年12月演示以来，FLKit已发展为8个章节共39页，包含7个已记录的FL Stories，涵盖多发性硬化症残疾预测、炎症性肠病、基因组学和脑机接口等多个领域的已完成和进行中的项目。工具包已在GitHub公开提供。

Conclusion: FLKit成功填补了联邦学习实践入门的空白，通过角色感知的入口点和跨学科协作框架，降低了多学科团队启动联邦学习项目的门槛，为医疗生命科学领域的联邦学习推广提供了实用支撑。

Abstract: Federated learning lets institutions train shared models without moving their data, which makes it a natural fit for health and life sciences research under strict privacy regulation. The methods are maturing fast, but the practical barrier now comes earlier: a team starting a federated project meets a scattered mix of frameworks, governance obligations, and unfamiliar roles, with no structured place to begin that fits its own background. FLKit closes that gap. It is an open, community-maintained onboarding toolkit that takes a multidisciplinary team through the full federated learning lifecycle and gives every contributor, clinical, legal, governance, or technical, a role-aware entry point instead of assuming fluency across all four. We modeled it on the ELIXIR Research Data Management Kit and built it with a multidisciplinary core team, a wider consortium supplying milestone reviews and roadmap direction, and external practitioners interviewed to keep the content grounded in real practice. FLKit sits on four lifecycle stages, Governance, Infrastructure, Wrangling, and Analysis, and connects them through 11 role-specific entry points, a cross-disciplinary glossary, a reusable FAIR-aligned FL Story template for planning and documenting projects, and a curated directory of tools, frameworks, and communities. Since the December 2024 demo it has grown to 39 pages across eight sections, with seven FL Stories documenting completed and ongoing projects in multiple sclerosis disability prediction, inflammatory bowel disease, genomics, and brain-computer interfaces. It is openly available at https://uhasselt-biomedicaldatasciences.github.io/federated-learning-toolkit/ and welcomes contributions from across the life sciences.

</details>


### [368] [Concordia: JIT-Compiled Persistent-Kernel Checkpointing for Fault-Tolerant LLM Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.23521)
*Yuhang Gan,Yiwei Yang,Yuyi Li,Xiangyu Gao,Yichen Wang,Rain Jiang,Xiaoning Ding,Andi Quinn,Chen Qian*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 提出了Concordia运行时系统，通过GPU驻留的持久化内核实现LLM推理容错，在不修改应用代码的情况下支持KV缓存等状态的检查点和恢复。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时间运行的LLM代理在GPU上保存有价值的运行时状态（KV缓存、请求调度器、通信状态等），GPU或通信故障会导致这些状态丢失，造成数分钟到数小时的工作损失。现有恢复机制要么重启整个服务栈，要么需要在每个注意力和运行时组件中实现应用特定的检查点逻辑，缺乏高效的故障容忍机制。

Method: 设计并实现了Concordia运行时，核心创新包括：(1) 使用GPU驻留的持久化内核作为容错LLM推理的基础；(2) 通过拦截GPU模块加载，支持PTX和SASS级别的插桩，在框架代码和库边界之下插入检查点和暂停钩子；(3) 为每个注册的LLM状态区域JIT编译专用的增量检查点处理器（如KV块扫描器、适配器页扫描器、恢复应用器等），并热交换到持久化内核的操作符表中；(4) 持久化内核使用无锁环形缓冲区管理计算、检查点、追加日志和恢复任务，同一执行器触发脏页检测、增量阶段提交，并将已提交记录追加到CXL内存或主机DRAM中的CPU可见日志。

Result: Concordia能够在设备同步点运行检查点钩子，观察框架和库实际执行的二进制内核，并在不将主机CPU置于关键路径的情况下实现恢复，为LLM推理提供了高效的故障容忍能力，支持KV缓存、适配器等状态的增量检查点和快速恢复。

Conclusion: 通过GPU驻留的执行上下文实现故障容忍，Concordia为长时间运行的LLM工作负载提供了透明、高效的容错机制，避免了应用层修改，显著降低了故障恢复的开销，为构建可靠的LLM服务系统提供了新的技术路径。

Abstract: Long-running LLM agents keep valuable state resident on GPUs: KV caches, request schedulers, communication state, and sometimes online adapters. Losing this state after a GPU or communicator failure can discard minutes to hours of work, yet existing recovery mechanisms either restart the whole serving stack or require application-specific checkpoint logic inside every attention and runtime component. This paper argues that fault tolerance for such workloads needs a GPU-resident execution context: checkpoint hooks must run at device synchronization points, observe binary kernels that frameworks and libraries actually execute, and recover without putting the host CPU on the critical path.
  We present Concordia, a runtime that uses a device-resident persistent kernel as the substrate for fault-tolerant LLM inference. Concordia interposes on GPU module loading and supports PTX- and SASS-level instrumentation, allowing checkpoint and pause hooks to be inserted below framework code and library boundaries. For each registered LLM state region, Concordia JIT-compiles a specialized delta-checkpoint handler -- for example, a KV-block scanner, adapter-page scanner, or recovery applier -- and hot-swaps it into the persistent kernel's operator table. The persistent kernel consumes a lock-free ring buffer of compute, checkpoint, append-log, and recovery tasks, so the same always-on executor triggers dirty-page detection, stages deltas, and appends committed records to a CPU-visible log in CXL memory or host DRAM.

</details>


### [369] [Kamera: Unified Position-Invariant Multimodal KV Cache for Training-Free Reuse](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.23581)
*Bole Ma,Jan Eitzinger,Harald Koestler,Gerhard Wellein*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 提出了一种低成本、免训练的低秩条件补丁机制，用于修复多模态智能体中KV缓存跨块复用时丢失的跨块条件信息，显著降低了重计算开销并准确恢复了多跳推理性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态智能体在滑动窗口和迭代推理过程中，经常重复审视相同的视频帧、UI截图等，但每次都需要从头重新编码，因为现有的前缀缓存只能在固定前导位置复用。这种重复计算造成了巨大的资源浪费，而之前的位置无关缓存方案未能解决跨块条件信息丢失的问题，导致多跳推理准确率显著下降。

Method: 1. 理论分析：揭示了朴素KV复用丢失的核心是跨块条件信息，且这种损失具有不对称性——直接读取可精确恢复，但深层的低秩残差信息丢失会影响多跳推理。
2. 提出训练无关的低秩条件补丁：随每个位置无关块存储一个小型低秩补丁，包含精确的RoPE重旋转和跨块绑定恢复信息。
3. 实现三种低成本窗口操作：重排序（一个补丁服务缓存集的所有排序）、滑动窗口存活（存活块仅通过旋转重定位，零重编码）、召回（被驱逐块通过补丁重新激活，从不重编码）。
4. 在生产级SGLang内核中实现，支持MLA、GQA和MHA多种注意力机制。

Result: 1. 在跨块绑定基准测试上，低秩补丁（秩-m）完全恢复了任务准确率。
2. 在MM-NIAH（两种注意力家族）和两页文档问答任务上验证了有效性。
3. KV缓存占用仅为原始的一小部分。
4. 在生产级SGLang内核中，在六种骨干网络上重构重预填充KV达到bf16精度。
5. 单跳召回准确率保持完整，多跳推理准确率从被减半恢复至完整水平。

Conclusion: 该方案成功解决了多模态智能体中KV缓存跨块复用的核心难题，实现了几乎零成本的位置无关KV复用，同时保持了多跳推理能力。该机制在冗余视觉和视频流中最有效，这正是多模态智能体重计算预算的主要消耗场景，具有重要的实际应用价值。

Abstract: Multimodal agents repeatedly re-examine the same video frames, UI screenshots, and rendered artifacts as their context window slides and reasoning iterates, yet every look-back re-encodes from scratch, because prefix caches serve reuse only at a fixed leading position. We show this recompute is avoidable, and identify exactly what naive KV reuse loses: the cross-chunk conditioning a chunk absorbs from its neighbours. This loss is asymmetric. The direct readout of a cached chunk is recovered exactly and for free by the standard state-merge. What remains is a diffuse, low-rank residue concentrated in deep layers, invisible to single-hop retrieval but precisely what multi-hop reasoning binds on. Blind reuse therefore leaves single-hop recall intact while halving multi-hop accuracy; this is the failure mode prior position-independent caches, designed for single-context or single-image reuse, do not address. We repair it with a small, training-free low-rank conditioning patch stored alongside each position-free chunk. Reuse reduces to one operator across MLA, GQA, and MHA: exact RoPE re-rotation to any target position, plus the patch that restores cross-chunk binding. This makes three window operations cheap: reorder (one patch serves every ordering of a cached set), sliding-window survival (surviving chunks relocate via rotation only, zero re-encode), and recall (an evicted chunk is rehydrated by its patch, never re-encoded). A rank-m patch recovers full task accuracy on cross-chunk-binding benchmarks, MM-NIAH across two attention families and two-page doc-QA, at a fraction of the KV footprint, and reconstructs re-prefill KV to within bf16 rounding in a production SGLang kernel across six backbones. The conditioning signal is strongest in redundant vision and video streams, making our solution most impactful where multimodal agents spend their recompute budget.

</details>


<div id='cs.AI'></div>

# cs.AI [[Back]](#toc)

### [370] [On the Identifiability of User Adaptation in Co-Adaptive Neural Interfaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20569)
*Philip Waggoner*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文揭示了在协同适应的人机系统中，闭环编码器估计无法唯一识别用户适应性，而是反映了联合系统的整体特性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在人机交互研究中，识别用户如何适应系统至关重要，但在协同适应的闭环系统中，如何准确识别用户适应性仍是一个未解决的理论问题。

Method: 采用理论分析方法，对协同适应的人机系统中的可识别性问题进行数学推导和逻辑论证。

Result: 证明了在闭环条件下，编码器估计不能唯一确定用户的适应性策略，而是与机器的适应性相互耦合，呈现出联合系统的特性。提出了解决该问题的识别条件。

Conclusion: 解释了现有研究中对行为适应性解读的局限性，并为未来实验设计和数据分析提供了理论指导，以实现更准确的用户适应性识别。

Abstract: We analyze identifiability in co-adaptive human-machine systems. We show that closed-loop encoder estimates do not uniquely identify user adaptation, but instead reflect properties of the joint system. We discuss implications for interpreting behavioral adaptation and propose conditions for identification.

</details>


### [371] [Beyond Fixed Budgets: Characterizing the Inelasticity and Limitations of Tree-of-Thought Reasoning Strategies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20599)
*Atkia Mahila,Avinash Maurya,M. Mustafa Rafique,Bogdan Nicolae*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文系统评估了两种树状思维搜索方法（DPTS和SSDP）在不同计算预算、模型规模和问题难度下的表现，发现两者存在相反的局限性：DPTS在低预算时受冷启动瓶颈影响，SSDP则面临前沿枯竭问题，表明需要自适应的搜索策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管树状思维搜索已成为提升大语言模型推理能力的有前景方向，但在实际部署中，不同搜索策略在变化的计算预算、模型规模和问题难度下的行为表现尚未得到系统性研究，这促使作者对该问题进行深入分析。

Method: 选择两种代表性树状思维方法：基于蒙特卡洛树搜索的DPTS和基于语义去重的SSDP，在两个数学推理基准（Math500和GSM8K）、两种模型规模（Llama-3B和Llama-8B）以及四个令牌预算范围（3k-10k）下进行系统性评估。

Result: 两种方法呈现相反方向的局限性：DPTS在低预算时遭遇冷启动瓶颈，需要充分探索才能获得可靠价值估计，不适合资源受限场景，但在高预算时具有良好扩展性；SSDP能高效找到候选解，但易受前沿枯竭影响，激进的节点合并会永久丢弃未探索路径，导致无法继续改进。

Conclusion: 单一固定的探索策略或剪枝策略不足以应对连续计算资源场景，有效的科学推理智能体搜索需要能够根据搜索进度和可用资源自适应调整行为的策略。

Abstract: Tree of Thought (ToT) search has become a promising direction for improving the reasoning capabilities of large language models, but deploying these methods in practice raises a question that has received little systematic attention: how do different search strategies behave under varying compute budgets, model sizes, and problem difficulties? In this work, we evaluate two representative ToT methods; DPTS, a Monte Carlo tree search based approach, and SSDP, a semantic deduplication based approach, across two mathematical reasoning benchmarks (Math500 and GSM8K), two model scales (Llama-3B and Llama-8B), and four token budgets (3k--10k). Our analysis reveals that the two methods exhibit limitations that pull in opposite directions. DPTS suffers from a cold-start bottleneck at low budgets: it requires sufficient exploration before its value estimates become reliable, making it a poor fit for resource-constrained settings despite strong scaling behavior at higher budgets. SSDP, on the other hand, reaches candidate solutions efficiently but is prone to frontier depletion; its aggressive node merging permanently discards unexplored paths, leaving it unable to improve regardless of how much budget remains. Together, these findings suggest that neither a fixed exploration strategy nor a fixed pruning strategy is sufficient across compute continuum. We argue that effective search for scientific reasoning agents requires strategies that can adapt their behavior based on search progress and available resources.

</details>


### [372] [AOHP: An Open-Source OS-Level Agent Harness for Personalized, Efficient and Secure Interaction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.23449)
*Shanhui Zhao,Jiacheng Liu,Guohong Liu,Jichao Yan,Jialei Ye,Yuhao Yang,Hao Wen,Shizuo Tian,Yizhen Yuan,Yuxuan Chen,Yunxin Liu,Ju Ren,Ya-Qin Zhang,Chao Huang,Yao Guo,Yuanchun Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了AOHP，一个基于AOSP的操作系统级AI代理支持平台，通过将代理视为一等公民，显著提升了任务完成率(+21.12%)并降低了执行成本(-51.55%)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有终端用户操作系统以应用为中心设计，缺乏对AI代理的原生支持，这种不匹配限制了代理的广泛应用，并导致执行开销和安全风险；同时研究社区缺乏开放的测试平台来探索代理介导交互所需的架构原语。

Method: 基于Android开源项目(AOSP)构建OS级代理框架AOHP，将代理作为操作系统的一等公民，引入三种面向代理的系统机制：个性化服务组合、高效代理接口和安全信息流，同时保持成熟的Android软硬件生态系统。

Result: 在覆盖操作系统代理关键能力的挑战性任务实验中，AOHP在任务完成率上提升21.12%，令牌成本降低51.55%，安全策略合规性明显改善。

Conclusion: AOHP证明了代理原生操作系统的可行性，为AI代理提供了有效的系统级支持方案，为代理介导的交互研究提供了开放测试平台。

Abstract: AI agents are driving a new software paradigm, with the ability to autonomously call tools, extract information, manage memory, and complete tasks that span applications and data sources. Most existing end-user operating systems, however, are designed for application-centric workflows and offer little native support for AI agents. This mismatch limits the wider adoption of agents and leads to execution overhead and safety risks when running agents on conventional systems. While the concept of agent-native operating systems is emerging, the research community lacks an open testbed to explore the architectural primitives desired for agent-mediated interaction. We present AOHP (Android Open Harness Project), an OS-level agent harness built on the Android Open Source Project (AOSP). The core design principle of AOHP is to treat agents as first-class OS actors, enabling adaptive user interfaces and agent-friendly runtime environments. AOHP preserves the mature Android software and hardware ecosystem while introducing three agent-oriented system mechanisms: personalized service composition, efficient agent interfaces, and secure information flow. Based on preliminary experiments on challenging tasks covering key capabilities of OS agents, AOHP shows clear advantages in task completion (+21.12% completion rate), execution cost (-51.55% token cost), and security-policy compliance.

</details>


### [373] [The New Associationism: Lessons from Deep Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20600)
*Daniel Rothschild*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 现代AI的成功支持了一种适度但真正的联想主义，监督学习作为统一、渐进、错误驱动的学习机制，在从大型语言模型到游戏智能体等广泛AI系统中起核心作用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者试图通过分析现代AI的成功案例，探讨其对人类学习机制的启示，重新审视联想主义在认知科学中的地位，回应以往对联想主义机制能力有限的批评。

Method: 通过考察当代AI系统（包括大型语言模型和游戏智能体）的学习机制，分析监督学习在这些系统中的核心作用，比较不同系统中反馈信号生成的差异，并将这些发现与经典联想主义理论进行对照。

Result: 发现监督学习——由评价性反馈驱动的学习——是当代广泛AI系统的共同基础，这证实了联想主义关于跨领域统一、渐进、错误驱动学习机制的理念。同时，深度学习的成功依赖于超越经典联想主义构想的计算架构，监督学习仅作为其中的一个组件而非学习的完整解释。

Conclusion: 认真对待AI作为人类学习模型支持了一种适度但真正的联想主义：联想主义机制并非过于局限而无法解释人类认知能力，但现代AI的成功表明学习机制需要结合更复杂的计算架构，监督学习是核心组件但非全貌。

Abstract: What can the success of modern AI tell us about how humans learn? This paper argues that taking AI seriously as a model of human learning supports a modest but genuine associationism. The central finding is that supervised learning -- learning driven by evaluative feedback -- underlies a surprisingly wide range of contemporary AI systems, from large language models to game-playing agents, differing primarily in how much work is required to generate the relevant feedback signal. This vindicates associationist ideals of a uniform, gradual, error-driven learning mechanism operating across domains, and defuses the once-influential argument that associationist mechanisms are too limited to account for human cognitive capacities. At the same time, the successes of deep learning depend on computational architectures that go well beyond anything classical associationists envisaged, and supervised learning operates within these as one component rather than a complete account of learning.

</details>


### [374] [Specifying AI-SDLC Processes: A Protocol Language for Human-Agent Boundaries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20615)
*Ylli Prifti*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个领域特定语言，用于将AI-软件开发生命周期（AI-SDLC）流程规范为协议，解决了人机协作中责任边界、审批门控和治理约束缺乏规范语言的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法存在局限性：将流程编码在代理提示中容易产生漂移、针对相邻领域（工作流管理、业务流程）或仅解决碎片化问题（访问控制、审批门控），缺乏专门表达人机责任边界、审批门控和治理约束的规范语言。

Method: 提出一个领域特定语言，将AI-SDLC流程规范为协议，具有形式化语法、良构性条件、操作语义和执行不变量。该语言区分策略（声明性意图）与机制（结构性执行），通过验证令牌和能力边界等原语约束过程的非确定性。

Result: 三个主要结果：（1）失败率分析表明，结构性执行将系统失败率限制在代理和验证器失败率的加权积水平，而行为合规性允许累积或近饱和增长；（2）提出2+N团队模式（两个人类控制角色加N个专业化代理成员），形式化了AI-SDLC的经典职责分离；（3）编排循环的Kleene闭包和自反协议遵循验证作为设计属性而非特例构造出现。

Conclusion: 工作实现证明了可行性；实证评估是未来工作。该贡献的新颖性在于特定集成，而非任何单一原语。

Abstract: AI agents now participate as first-class team members across the software development lifecycle, yet no specification language exists for expressing the human-agent responsibility boundaries, approval gates, and governance constraints this collaboration requires. Existing approaches encode process in agent prompts (subject to drift), target adjacent domains (workflow management, business processes), or address only fragments (access control, approval gates).
  We propose a domain-specific language for specifying AI-SDLC processes as protocols, with formal syntax, well-formedness conditions, operational semantics, and enforcement invariants. The language distinguishes policy (declared intent) from mechanism (structural enforcement), enabling implementations to bound process non-determinism through primitives such as validation tokens and capability boundaries.
  Three results follow. A failure rate analysis shows that structural enforcement bounds system failure rates at a weighted product of agent and validator rates, while behavioral compliance permits cumulative or near-saturating growth. The 2+N team pattern (two human-in-control roles plus N specialized agent members) formalizes classical Separation of Duties for AI-SDLC. Kleene closure of orchestration loops and reflexive protocol-adherence validation emerge as design properties rather than special-case constructs.
  We position the contribution against multi-agent frameworks (MetaGPT), workflow specification (FlowAgent, BPMN extensions), and capability-based security (SAGA): the novelty lies in the specific integration, not any single primitive. A working implementation demonstrates feasibility; empirical evaluation is future work.

</details>


### [375] [PEAR: Permutation-Equivariant Adaptive Routing Multi-Agent Debate](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20621)
*Yang Feng,Ziwei Xu,Xia Hu,Fengxiang He*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: PEAR是一种推理时动态路由协议，通过在辩论轮次间重新配置代理角色和稀疏拓扑结构，有效缓解了多智能体辩论中的位置偏见和角色敏感性问题，在多个推理基准上显著提升了准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多智能体辩论方法采用固定拓扑结构，容易引入持续的位置偏见、放大不可靠智能体的影响，并对角色分配高度敏感，这些缺陷限制了辩论系统的可靠性和稳定性。

Method: 提出置换等变自适应路由多智能体辩论（PEAR）协议，在推理时动态重构通信角色和稀疏拓扑结构。该方法根据智能体状态的演化策略性地切换代理到角色的分配，确保没有智能体永久占据特权网络位置，从而更均匀地分配影响力。理论证明PEAR具有等变性：在智能体重新标记下保持准确性，同时降低路由复杂度并提升泛化能力。

Result: 在四个推理基准和六个不同LLM骨干网络上的全面实证评估表明，PEAR相比最强辩论基线显著提升了平均准确率。

Conclusion: PEAR通过动态置换等变路由机制成功解决了固定拓扑多智能体辩论的关键缺陷，为提升大语言模型推理可靠性提供了一种有效且理论完备的解决方案。

Abstract: Multi-agent debate improves the reliability of large language models (LLMs) through iterative peer critiques. However, fixed topologies often introduce persistent positional biases, amplify unreliable agents, and cause high sensitivity to role assignments. We introduce \textit{Permutation-Equivariant Adaptive Routing Multi-Agent Debate (PEAR)}, an inference-time protocol that dynamically reconfigures communication roles and sparse topologies across consecutive debate rounds. By strategically switching agent-to-role assignments based on evolving agent states, PEAR prevents any agent from permanently occupying a privileged network position or distributes influence more evenly across the debate. We theoretically characterize PEAR as an equivariant sparse router: it preserves accuracy under agent relabeling while reducing routing complexity and improving generalization. Comprehensive empirical evaluations across four reasoning benchmarks and six diverse LLM backbones demonstrate PEAR significantly improves average accuracy over the strongest debate baselines. The code is at https://github.com/EVIEHub/PEAR.

</details>


### [376] [Darwin Mobile Agent: A Roadmap for Self-Evolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20622)
*Daniel Beechey,Derek Yuen,Jianheng Liu,Dezhao Luo,Tiantian He,Weilin Luo,Jun Wang,Kun Shao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出了一种通过移除人类先验知识、在复杂环境中自主演化智能的新范式，以移动GUI作为环境代理，构建了Darwin Mobile Agent开源基础设施，用于自主强化学习，并提出了逐步移除人类先验的路线图。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 根据"苦涩教训"（Bitter Lesson），人类先验知识限制了智能体的泛化能力。真正通用的智能应该通过与远比自身复杂的环境交互自然涌现，而非依赖精心设计的人类知识。现有移动GUI智能体面临数据收集瓶颈和过度依赖人工设计的任务等问题。

Method: 提出Darwin Mobile Agent框架：（1）以移动GUI作为"大世界"的实用代理环境；（2）采用异步agent-environment循环，跨并行云手机实例解决真实移动交互的数据收集瓶颈；（3）提出概念路线图，系统性地从任务课程、结果验证和记忆管理三个基本支柱中移除人类先验；（4）验证基础设施在GUI策略优化阶段的稳定性和可扩展性。

Result: Darwin基础设施成功验证了在GUI域进行策略优化所需的稳定性和可扩展性，能够支撑自主强化学习的第一阶段，为构建真正自主、自演化的GUI智能体奠定了实践和理论基础。

Conclusion: 该工作建立了向真正自主、自演化GUI智能体发展的实践和理论基础，通过系统性地移除人类先验（任务课程、结果验证、记忆管理），使智能体能够在复杂环境中自然涌现通用智能能力。

Abstract: The goal of artificial intelligence is to create agents capable of general, adaptive behaviour in open-ended environments. Guided by the "Bitter Lesson", we argue that the most effective path toward this goal is to systematically remove human priors and allow intelligence to naturally emerge through interaction with a "Big World" that is orders of magnitude more complex than the agent itself. We propose the mobile Graphical User Interface (GUI) as a practical proxy for such a world and introduce Darwin Mobile Agent, an open-source infrastructure designed as a foundation for autonomous reinforcement learning in this domain. This framework addresses the data-collection bottleneck in real-world mobile interactions by using an asynchronous agent-environment loop across parallel cloud-phone instances. We further propose a conceptual roadmap to systematically remove human priors from three fundamental pillars of a self-evolving agent: task curricula, outcome verification, and memory management. We validate that the Darwin infrastructure provides the stability and scalability required for the first stage of this roadmap: policy optimisation in the GUI domain. This work establishes the practical and theoretical foundation necessary to move toward truly autonomous, self-evolving GUI agents.

</details>


### [377] [Path-dependent program induction under resource constraints explains human sequence learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20623)
*Hanqi Zhou,David G. Nagy,Peter Dayan,Charley M. Wu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种层次适配器文法(HAG)模型，将率失真理论与程序归纳相结合，用于解释有限认知资源下人类如何从序列经验中构建抽象、可重用的知识。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究人类在有限认知资源约束下如何从序列经验中构建抽象、可重用的知识，这是一个认知科学的核心问题。

Method: 整合率失真理论与程序归纳方法，构建具有局部（任务内）和全局（跨任务）库的层次适配器文法(HAG)模型，该模型受记忆和计算资源约束的共同调控。

Result: 仿真实验中，HAG相比固定文法和浅层组块方法实现了更优的率失真权衡和更强的泛化能力。在线旋律序列学习实验中，被试的回忆错误反映了系统性简化，反应时在推断的程序边界处增加。层次库模型最好地解释了个体在回忆和样本外续写选择上的差异。

Conclusion: 结构化学习可被视为受限程序归纳过程，其中经验顺序塑造了学习者构建的未来抽象。

Abstract: How do people build abstract, reusable knowledge from sequential experience under bounded cognitive resources? To answer this question, we integrate rate-distortion theory with recent advances in program induction to describe how prior knowledge shapes which future structures are cheap to encode and easy to discover. We formalize this in a hierarchical Adaptor Grammar (HAG) with distinct local (within-task) and global (across-task) libraries, governed jointly by constraints on memory and computation. In simulations, HAG achieves better rate-distortion trade-offs and stronger generalization than fixed grammars or shallow chunking methods. In an online melodic sequence-learning experiment, participants' recall errors reflected systematic simplifications and reaction times increased at inferred program boundaries. Trial-by-trial fits further showed that hierarchical libraries best explained individual differences in both recall and out-of-sample continuation choices, outperforming all alternative models. These findings cast structured learning as bounded program induction in which the order of experience shapes future abstractions a learner builds.

</details>


### [378] [In LLM Reasoning, there is Irrationality on top of Value Misalignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20624)
*Kejiang Qian,Fengxiang He*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了“理性价值风险”概念，用于量化对齐后的LLM在推理过程中未能最大化预期效用的差距，并通过大规模实验验证了该风险的普遍性及其特性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管LLM在训练阶段已进行了价值对齐，作者认为模型在实际推理过程中仍可能无法最大化对齐的价值。需要从数学角度形式化这一差距，以理解对齐模型的实际表现与其理论最优表现之间的差异。

Method: 将理性价值风险形式化为模型部署推理策略与其理性对应策略（在最陡方向上最大化预期效用的响应）之间的效用差异。将估计误差分解为三个来源：有限候选、有限提示和不完美的验证器。在多个模型家族（Llama-3.1、Qwen-2.5、Tülu-3、GPT-5.x、DeepSeek-V4）和多个基准（UltraFeedback、AlpacaEval、GSM8K、MATH、HumanEval、MathArena）上进行广泛实验。

Result: 实验验证了四个核心发现：(1) 理性价值风险普遍存在；(2) 价值对齐可以降低但无法消除该风险；(3) 该风险对推理时的推理策略高度敏感；(4) 更长的推理链能提升理性，但存在边际收益递减效应。

Conclusion: 理性价值风险揭示了价值对齐在训练与推理阶段之间的差距，强调了对齐工作需关注推理时的策略选择，并为理解和缓解这一风险提供了理论框架和实证依据。

Abstract: Significant progress has been made in aligning LLMs with target value functions. We argue that, even when an LLM has been well aligned in (post-)training, it may still fail to maximise the aligned value in reasoning. We mathematically formalise this gap as rational value risk: the utility discrepancy between a model's deployed reasoning strategy and its rational counterpart, which is defined to be the responses that maximise expected utility in the steepest direction. The estimation error of rational value risk is further decomposed into three components from finite candidates, finite prompts, and imperfect verifiers. Extensive experiments are conducted, covering models Llama-3.1, Qwen-2.5, T{\"}ulu-3 families (7B-72B), GPT-5.2, GPT-5.5, and DeepSeek-V4, and benchmarks UltraFeedback, AlpacaEval, GSM8K, MATH, HumanEval, and MathArena. The results validate that (1) rational value risk is widespread; (2) value alignment can reduce, but cannot eliminate, it; (3) the risk is highly sensitive to inference-time reasoning strategy; and (4) longer reasoning improves rationality with diminishing returns. The code is at https://github.com/EVIEHub/LLM-Rationality.

</details>


### [379] [AlphaMemo: Structured Search-Process Memory for Self-Evolving Alpha Mining Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20625)
*Hang Yu,Zifan Zheng,Jeff Z. Pan,Tongliang Liu,Zhiyong Wang,Fengxiang He*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出了AlphaMemo，一个具有结构化搜索过程记忆的自演化alpha挖掘智能体，通过记录可复用的编辑模式证据来解决LLM在alpha挖掘中面临的组合搜索空间、噪声反馈和过拟合等挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体在alpha挖掘中面临组合搜索空间大、非平稳噪声反馈、冗余发现和因简单复用过去成功经验导致的过拟合风险等问题，需要一种更有效的记忆和搜索机制。

Method: 提出AlphaMemo，采用结构化搜索过程记忆：从抽象语法树(AST)差异中提取编辑模体(motifs)，在搜索账本先验之上应用置信度门控残差记忆，并使用非对称否决控制来抑制高置信度失败模式。不仅记忆最终因子或完整轨迹，而是记录关于特定父因子上下文下哪些编辑模体有效或失败的可复用证据。

Result: 在中证500和标普500数据集上的实验表明，该方法提高了样本外性能和固定预算发现效率，消融实验验证了残差学习、置信度门控、AST差异模体和否决记忆的作用。

Conclusion: AlphaMemo通过结构化搜索过程记忆有效解决了alpha挖掘中的关键挑战，实现了更好的泛化性能和发现效率，代码已开源。

Abstract: LLM agents are promising for alpha mining via combining financial priors, symbolic reasoning, executable factor generation, and feedback-driven refinement. Yet, they face a combinatorial search space, noisy non-stationary feedback, redundant discoveries, and overfitting risks from naively reusing past successes. To address these challenges, we propose AlphaMemo, a self-evolving alpha mining agent with Structured Search-Process Memory. Rather than memorizing only final factors or full trajectories, AlphaMemo records reusable evidence about which edit motifs work or fail under specific parent-factor contexts. It extracts motifs from Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) differences, applies confidence-gated residual memory on top of a search-ledger prior, and uses asymmetric veto control to suppress high-confidence failure patterns. Experiments on CSI 500 and S\&P 500 show improved out-of-sample performance and fixed-budget discovery efficiency, with ablations validating the roles of residual learning, confidence gating, AST-diff motifs, and veto memory. Code is at https://github.com/jarrettyu/AlphaMemo.

</details>


### [380] [Latent Goal Prediction from Language for Model-Based Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20627)
*Samuel Barbeau,Simon Roy,Giovanni Beltrame,Christian Desrosiers,Nicolas Thome*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出LAGO框架，通过预测潜在子目标序列解决语言指导的长期规划问题，在长视野任务中表现鲁棒。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于世界模型的规划方法存在累积预测误差和目标定义困难。视觉目标提供精确局部梯度但缺乏远距离引导，语言目标灵活但受噪声对齐或依赖不适合高频规划的大模型限制。

Method: LAGO框架在统一潜在空间中预测语言指令对应的中间目标状态序列和动作条件的轨迹，动态将指令分解为显式预测的局部可处理潜在子目标，在规划过程中在线更新子目标并使用软最小轨迹成本进行规划。

Result: 在多个环境和规划视野的评估中，LAGO避免了以往方法随规划视野增大出现的急剧性能退化，实现了稳健的长期规划性能。

Conclusion: LAGO成功将视觉目标的精确性与文本引导控制的灵活性相结合，实现了纯粹基于语言的鲁棒且精确的长期规划。

Abstract: Planning with world models is bottlenecked by compounding prediction errors and the difficulty of defining optimizable goals. Visual targets provide precise local gradients but poor distant guidance, while language is flexible yet limited by noisy cross-modal alignment or dependence on large generative models unsuited for the high-sampling nature of model-based planning. To address these challenges, we introduce Latent Goal Prediction from Language (LAGO), a framework that predicts both sequences of intermediate goal states from language instructions and action-conditioned rollouts, all within the same latent space. Rather than optimizing toward a single global objective, LAGO dynamically decomposes instructions into explicitly predicted, locally tractable latent subgoals. By updating these subgoals online and using a soft minimum trajectory cost during planning, LAGO enables an agent to follow coherent latent trajectories over long horizons. Evaluation across multiple environments planning horizons shows that LAGO avoids the sharp degradation of prior methods. By achieving robust and precise long-horizon planning purely from language, LAGO bridges the precision of visual goals with the flexibility of text-guided control.

</details>


### [381] [Human Decision-Making with AI Assistance under Correlated Features](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20628)
*Yanru Guan,Naveen Raman,Fei Fang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 在特征存在相关性时，AI辅助决策系统应采用"先探索后承诺"策略，而非固定推荐策略，以平衡短期决策质量和长期人类学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着AI辅助决策日益普及，一个关键问题浮现：当特征（如诊断测试结果）存在相关性时，AI应推荐哪些测试来平衡短期决策质量和长期人类学习？现有研究表明，当特征独立时，固定推荐策略是最优的，但特征相关性对该策略的影响尚未明确。

Method: 提出一种"先探索后承诺"（explore-then-commit）策略结构：初始阶段AI提供多样化测试使人类学习准确的特征系数，随后承诺于单一测试集。证明了计算最优策略是NP难问题，并开发了基于动态规划的有限视界最优策略算法，以及一个规划更短视界并附加固定后缀的近似算法。

Result: 理论证明：1）特征相关性导致固定策略表现任意差；2）任何最优策略必须遵循先探索后承诺结构；3）探索阶段长度取决于特征相关程度；4）计算最优策略是NP难问题。实证结果表明更强的特征相关性导致更长的探索阶段。

Conclusion: 当特征存在相关性时，AI辅助决策系统必须采用动态策略而非固定策略，通过初始探索让人类学习特征关系，再转向承诺阶段，从而实现短期决策质量和长期学习的最优平衡。

Abstract: Humans increasingly make decisions with AI assistance; for example, doctors may follow AI-recommended diagnostic tests and base their diagnoses on the results. A natural question is which tests should AI recommend to balance short-term decision quality and long-term human learning when different features (e.g., test results) are correlated. While prior work establishes that stationary policies that recommend the same tests repeatedly are optimal when features are independent, we prove that feature correlations lead such policies to perform arbitrarily poorly. Instead, we prove that any optimal policy must follow an explore-then-commit structure; initially, the AI should offer diverse tests so humans can learn accurate feature coefficients, then the AI should commit to a single set of tests, with exploration length that depends on the degree of feature correlation. We prove that computing the optimal policy is NP-hard and derive a dynamic programming-based algorithm that finds the optimal policy for finite horizons. We additionally develop an approximation that plans for shorter horizons and appends a stationary suffix, achieving near-optimal performance. Our empirical results complement our theory by showing that stronger feature correlation leads to longer exploration phases.

</details>


### [382] [Harnessing Agent Skills: Architectural Patterns and a Reference Architecture for Skill-Mediated LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20631)
*Boming Xia,Liming Zhu,Zhenchang Xing,Qinghua Lu,Dino Sejdinovic,Xiwei Xu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个包含10种架构模式（5个核心、5个支撑）的技能驾驭（skill harnessing）参考架构，分为供应链、中介、执行控制和证据反馈四个责任层，为LLM代理技能管理提供了系统化的设计方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 代理技能将可重用的代理面向行为知识和指导外部化为持久工件，虽然静态技能工件在闲置时是静止的，但其架构责任在使用时产生——当工件被选中运行、绑定上下文和权限约束、被随机代理解释并记录为运行证据时，形成了"使用中技能"（skill-in-use）的关系。研究代理技能驾驭的架构责任成为必要。

Method: 通过实证研究归纳出10种技能驾驭架构模式（5个核心模式、5个支撑模式），并将其综合为包含四个责任层的参考架构：供应链层、中介层、执行控制层、证据与反馈层。通过在8个选定系统中进行跨实例化来评估该架构。

Result: 形成了技能驾驭的模式目录和参考架构，提供了分析代理系统中技能驾驭责任的词汇表和诊断框架，并通过8个系统的跨实例化验证了架构的有效性。

Conclusion: 所提出的模式和参考架构为理解和设计代理技能驾驭机制提供了系统化的理论基础和实践指导，能够帮助开发者更好地分析和实现LLM代理的技能管理责任。

Abstract: Agent skills externalise reusable agent-facing behavioural knowledge and guidance as persistent artefacts that can be discovered, activated, and interpreted by LLM agents. Although a skill artefact is static at rest, its architectural responsibilities arise in use, when the artefact is selected for a run, bound to context and authority constraints, interpreted by a stochastic agent, and recorded as run evidence. We call this run-specific relation skill-in-use. This paper studies agent skill harnessing: the architectural responsibilities that govern the transition from skill artefacts to skill-in-use, bound the executable consequences associated with skill-in-use, and capture evidence for attribution, verification, repair, and evolution. This paper provides a catalogue of ten empirically grounded architectural patterns (five core, five supporting) for skill harnessing and synthesises them into a reference architecture with four responsibility layers: Supply Chain, Mediation, Execution Control, and Evidence & Feedback. We evaluate the architecture through cross-instantiation across 8 selected systems. The resulting patterns and reference architecture provide a vocabulary and diagnostic frame for analysing skill-harnessing responsibilities across agent systems.

</details>


### [383] [DEMM-Bench: A Cross-Regime Benchmark for Agent-Runtime Governance-Evidence Sufficiency](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20634)
*Oleg Solozobov*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: DEMM-Bench是一个跨机制基准测试，用于评估智能体运行时治理证据的充分性。在64个测试案例中，现有的基线方法（trace-present和schema-present）存在75%的过度声明，而本文提出的红acted属性级候选评分器实现了零过度声明，平均属性充分性准确率为56.25%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前智能体运行时系统生成多种记录容器（追踪、账本、来源图、策略日志、委托令牌、缓存事件、工具防火墙记录），但这些容器不一定能回答关于特定决策的治理问题。现有系统仅能呈现记录，而无法充分重构决策级别的属性，缺乏对治理证据充分性的系统性评估方法。

Method: 提出DEMM-Bench基准测试，基于决策证据成熟度模型（DEMM），通过以下步骤实现：1）通过适配器标准化八个证据机制；2）针对参与者、权限、行动、策略、决策依据、资源接触、生命周期上下文和验证强度提出属性问题；3）应用八种确定性降级条件；4）评估记录是否足以重构决策级别属性，而非仅仅呈现记录。

Result: 在64个手稿案例的评估中：trace-present和schema-present基线在75%的案例上过度声明；ledger-present基线在50%的案例上过度声明；红acted属性级候选评分器实现零过度声明，平均属性充分性准确率为56.25%。提供完整的数据集、构建预言机标签、基线和适配器。

Conclusion: DEMM-Bench为异构智能体运行时证据基质的决策证据成熟度提供了可重现的评估方法。该基准揭示了现有证据容器的局限性，证明了决策级别属性重构比简单记录呈现更具挑战性，为零过度声明的治理证据评估提供了有效解决方案。

Abstract: Agent-runtime systems emit traces, ledgers, provenance graphs, policy logs, delegation tokens, cache events, and tool-firewall records, but those containers do not necessarily answer governance questions about a specific decision. DEMM-Bench is a cross-regime benchmark for agent-runtime governance-evidence sufficiency, grounded in the Decision Evidence Maturity Model (DEMM): it measures whether records across eight evidence regimes are sufficient to reconstruct decision-level properties rather than merely present. The benchmark normalizes the regimes through adapters, asks property questions over actor, authority, action, policy, decision basis, resource touch, lifecycle context, and verification strength, and applies eight deterministic degradation conditions. Across 64 manuscript cases, trace-present and schema-present baselines overclaim on 75% of cases, ledger-present overclaims on 50%, and the redacted property-level candidate scorer has zero overclaim with 56.25% mean Property Sufficiency Accuracy. The deposited package provides the 64-case dataset, construction-oracle labels, baselines, and adapters, supporting reproducible evaluation of decision-evidence maturity across heterogeneous agent-runtime evidence substrates.

</details>


### [384] [SkillHarness: Harnessing Safe Skills for Computer-Use Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20636)
*Yurun Chen,Biao Yi,Keting Yin,Shengyu Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出SkillHarness框架，通过建模技能边界和选择性重用，解决了动态环境中计算机使用代理(CUAs)的安全技能学习问题，将学习技能的不安全率降低57.1%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有技能学习方法假设环境静态且安全，忽视了对抗性交互（如提示注入）和环境动态性（如弹窗）带来的风险。在动态环境中，这些假设会导致有风险的技能学习和脆弱的执行，削弱CUAs的可靠性。

Method: 提出SkillHarness框架，将技能学习和利用建模为安全约束的交互过程。引入技能边界概念，利用多源监督信号从交互轨迹中识别安全技能，并在技能生命周期中构建自改进的安全约束。同时提出选择性技能重用机制，根据上下文引导任务分解并通过选择性激活技能子集来完成任务。

Result: SkillHarness将学习技能的不安全率显著降低57.1%，在动态环境变化下持续改善执行稳定性，优于现有基线方法。

Conclusion: 通过建模技能学习和利用为安全约束的交互过程，SkillHarness成功解决了动态环境中CUAs的安全技能学习挑战，为实际部署提供了更可靠的解决方案。

Abstract: Computer-Use Agents (CUAs) are increasingly deployed in dynamic interactive environments, creating a growing need for continual skill learning during interaction. Recent approaches address this challenge by learning reusable skills from successful trajectories. However, these skill learning methods largely assume static and safe environments, overlooking risks from adversarial interactions (e.g., prompt injections) and environmental dynamics (e.g., pop-ups). In dynamic settings, such assumptions can lead to risky skill learning and brittle execution, undermining the reliability of CUAs. This raises the question: how can CUAs learn and use skills safely in dynamic environments? To address this problem, we propose SkillHarness, a framework for safe skill harnessing in dynamic environments. SkillHarness moves beyond static skill abstractions by modeling skill learning and utilization as a safety-constrained interaction process. Specifically, we introduce the skill boundary that leverages multi-source supervision signals to identify safe skills from interaction trajectories, and construct self-improving safety constraints throughout the skill lifecycle. In addition, SkillHarness introduces selective skill reuse, where tasks are guided to decompose according to context and completed through the selective activation of skill subsets. Our experiments demonstrate that SkillHarness significantly reduces the unsafe rate of learned skills by 57.1% and consistently improves execution stability under dynamic environmental changes, outperforming existing baselines.

</details>


### [385] [Constituency Optimisation Through Hamiltonian Representation Of Mandates (COTHROM): Algorithmic Redistricting of Irish Election Boundaries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20637)
*Ruaidhrí Campion,Matthew Fenlon,Joshua Cooney Mercedal,Casey Farren-Colloty,Eliza Somerville,Michael A. J. Mitchell*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了首个针对爱尔兰PR-STV选举制度的计算重划框架，利用统计物理方法（Potts模型、MCMC、模拟退火）在多重宪法目标间实现优化权衡，在科克郡的实验中优于现有法定边界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 爱尔兰比例代表单记可转让投票（PR-STV）系统的选区重划面临从海量可能配置中选择最优代表性边界的挑战，而"代表性"是多个相互冲突的宪法目标之间的微妙平衡，缺乏系统性计算框架来处理这些权衡。

Method: 将选区重划问题建模为统计物理问题，宪法目标作为Potts哈密顿量中的项；使用马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）方法和模拟退火最小化目标函数，耦合常数作为目标权重代理；采用多准则决策分析（MCDA）和帕累托最优性解决目标权重组合选择的不确定性。

Result: 在科克郡针对比例代表性和紧凑性目标进行评估，COTHROM框架在一系列目标权重设置下均持续优于现行的法定选区边界。

Conclusion: 该计算框架成功实现了爱尔兰选区重划的多目标系统性优化，使权衡显性化且可量化，为宪法目标的平衡决策提供了透明的方法论支持。

Abstract: Electoral redistricting in Ireland's Proportional Representation Single Transferable Vote (PR-STV) system faces the challenge of selecting an optimally representative set of electoral boundaries from an enormous set of possible configurations, and where ``representative'' is a delicate balance of constitutional objectives that are often in tension with one another. We present the first computational framework for Irish electoral redistricting that systematically optimises across multiple constitutional requirements while making trade-offs explicit and quantifiable. The electoral redistricting problem is parsed using statistical physics, where constitutional objectives are considered as terms in a Potts Hamiltonian. Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) methods and simulated annealing are employed to minimise this objective function, systematically exploring this configuration space, with coupling constants as proxies for objective weightings. Multi Criterion Decision Analysis (MCDA) and Pareto Optimality is then utilised to remedy the ambiguity in choosing a certain objective weighting combination over others. With respect to proportional representation and compactness objectives evaluated in County Cork, COTHROM consistently improves on the existing legal constituency boundaries for a range of objective weightings.

</details>


### [386] [Confidence Laundering in Agent Systems: Why Uncertainty Needs a Latent Carrier](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20662)
*Kaiwen Shi,Zheyuan Zhang,Han Bao,Colby Nelson,Yanfang Ye*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 现代智能体系统存在"置信度清洗"问题，即上游的不确定决策被包装为可靠的中间产物传递给下游，导致错误放大。本文提出"潜在不确定性"作为接口载体来保持决策的不确定性，从而实现更可恢复的智能体系统。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代智能体系统将不确定性转化为过度自信：上游脆弱的决策以清晰的中间产物形式暴露给下游组件，而决策背后的不确定性在接口处丢失。这导致局部歧义演变为系统级错误放大。作者认为这揭示了智能体不确定性传播中的接口瓶颈：不确定性的传播不仅取决于轨迹包含不确定步骤，更取决于其能否在组件交接中存活。

Method: 1. 定义"不确定决策交接"为在不确定性下做出的中间决策的转移过程；2. 识别"置信度清洗"这一失败模式——脆弱的上游状态被重新包装为程序上有效的产物，导致下游智能体过度信任；3. 提出"潜在不确定性"作为附着在决策交接上的不确定性承载载体，而非用隐藏状态替代文本，旨在以下游组件可用的形式保留预承诺脆弱性。

Result: 将智能体不确定性传播的关注点从逐步不确定性估计转向不确定性保持的接口设计，为构建更可恢复的智能体系统提供了新的理论框架。潜在不确定性机制能够在组件交接过程中保存不确定性信息，而非使其在接口处丢失。

Conclusion: 核心问题不在于单个步骤的不确定性估计，而在于接口设计是否能够保持和传递不确定性。通过在决策交接点引入潜在不确定性载体，可以有效防止置信度清洗现象，实现更鲁棒、更可恢复的智能体系统架构。

Abstract: Modern agent systems can turn uncertainty into overconfidence. Fragile upstream decisions are often exposed to downstream components as clean intermediate artifacts, while the uncertainty behind those decisions is lost at the interface. As a result, local ambiguity can become system-level error amplification. We argue that this reveals an interface bottleneck in agent uncertainty propagation: uncertainty does not propagate simply because a trajectory contains uncertain steps; it propagates only when it survives the handoff between components. We define uncertain decision handoff as the transfer of an intermediate decision made under uncertainty, and identify confidence laundering as a failure mode in which fragile upstream states are repackaged as procedurally valid artifacts that downstream agents over-trust. To address this bottleneck, we propose latent uncertainty as an uncertainty-bearing carrier attached to decision handoffs. Rather than replacing text with hidden states, latent uncertainty aims to preserve pre-commitment fragility in a form that downstream components can use. This position shifts agent uncertainty propagation from step-wise uncertainty estimation toward uncertainty-preserving interface design for more recoverable agent systems.

</details>


### [387] [RIZZ: Routing Interactions to Near Zero-Interference Zones for Continual Adaptation of Black-Box Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20638)
*Sonali Goel,Pranav Vaidhyanathan,Lucas Schorling,Natalia Ares,Maike Osborne*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出了RIZZ框架，通过验证器门控的记忆、路由和提示编译机制，实现了大语言模型作为长期代理的黑盒持续自适应，有效控制了非平稳输入流中的任务干扰问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有黑盒自适应方法（单一提示优化、无差异记忆、重型搜索）在面对非平稳输入流、稀疏反馈和任务间干扰时表现不佳，无法满足大语言模型作为长期代理的适应需求。

Method: RIZZ框架包含四个核心组件：1）动态生成记忆分支组织输入流；2）上下文感知路由器选择/创建分支；3）编译器整合分支局部、全局、图结构和工作记忆上下文；4）验证器评分机制，仅允许已验证交互更新记忆、规则和反模式。

Result: 在竞争性基准测试上，RIZZ相比最先进的基线方法展现出优越性能，证明了该方法在在线适应和上下文预算限制场景下的有效性。

Conclusion: RIZZ成功实现了大语言模型在黑盒设置下的持续自适应，通过显式控制干扰和利用自然语言反馈，为构建可靠的长期代理系统提供了有效解决方案。

Abstract: Large language models are increasingly deployed as long-lived agents that must adapt across users, tasks, domains, modalities, and feedback regimes without access to model weights. Existing black-box adaptation methods typically optimize a single prompt, maintain an undifferentiated memory, or rely on repeated rollout-heavy search. However, these designs struggle when streams of input are nonstationary, feedback is sparse, and failures from one task family can contaminate behavior on another. We introduce RIZZ (Routing Interactions to Near Zero-interference Zones), a continual adaptation framework for compound language-model systems that learns entirely through verifier-gated memory, routing, and prompt compilation. RIZZ organizes input streams into dynamically spawned memory branches. At inference time, either while online or offline, a context-aware router selects or creates a branch that retrieves branch-local, global, graph-structured, and working-memory context, which is compiled into a bounded prompt together with retrieved task evidence. After the model acts, task verifiers score the output, and only verified interactions can update memory, promote reusable rules, demote harmful rules, or create anti-patterns. This yields a black-box agent that improves through persistent natural-language feedback while explicitly controlling interference. RIZZ targets the regime where adaptation must occur online under context budgets. Finally, we demonstrate the effectiveness of our framework against state-of-the-art baselines on competitive benchmarks.

</details>


### [388] [Process-Reward Tactic Evolution for Long-Horizon Bioinformatics Workflows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20839)
*Lingzhi Yang,Yubo Fan,Song Wu,Gilchan Park*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了Process-Reward Tactic Evolution框架，通过将验证过的工作流轨迹转化为可复用的策略（tactics），提升了LLM智能体在Galaxy生物信息学工作流中的长期执行能力和生物正确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM智能体虽然能够编写代码和调用工具，但在生物信息学领域缺乏可靠的长期交互能力，难以处理工作流软件、类型化数据对象、溯源和生物验证等复杂需求。

Method: 提出基于Galaxy的训练框架Process-Reward Tactic Evolution，在Agent Gym中通过课程式训练让智能体练习Galaxy任务；使用过程验证器对工作流构建、软件交互、执行和生物正确性进行评分；将成功和失败的轨迹提炼为策略库。推理时，训练好的执行器利用该策略库执行未见过的BioWorkflow Bench和BioAgent Bench任务。

Result: 在隔离环境中评估了Process-Reward Tactic Evolution在同行评审的Galaxy工作流转换任务上的表现，证明了过程监督的策略积累相比无记忆和反思式基线方法，能够提升长期生物信息学工作流完成度、生物正确性和执行效率。

Conclusion: 过程监督的策略积累可以有效改善LLM智能体在长期生物信息学工作流任务中的表现，为构建可靠的生物信息学自动化系统提供了可行路径。

Abstract: LLM agents can write code and call tools, but reliable bioinformatics work requires long-horizon interaction with workflow software, typed data objects, provenance, and biological checks. We study this setting through Galaxy workflow execution. The agent must explore task data, construct or adapt an executable workflow DAG, bind inputs and dataset collections, monitor execution, debug failures, and validate biological outputs. We propose Process-Reward Tactic Evolution, a Galaxy-based training framework that turns verified workflow rollouts into reusable \tactics. During training, agents practice on curriculum-organized Galaxy tasks in Agent Gym; process verifiers score workflow construction, software interaction, execution, and biological correctness; successful and failed traces are distilled into a tactic library. At inference, the trained executor, Process-Reward Tactic Evolution, uses this library to execute held-out peer reviewed Galaxy workflow converted BioWorkflow Bench and BioAgent Bench tasks in isolated environments. The paper evaluates whether process-supervised tactic accumulation improves long-horizon bioinformatics workflow completion, biological correctness, and execution efficiency over no-memory and reflection-style baselines.

</details>


### [389] [An LLM-Explainable DRL Framework for Passenger-Directed Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20640)
*Ouided Braoui,Meriem Bouali,Nadir Farhi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个结合深度强化学习(DRL)和大型语言模型(LLM)的自动驾驶框架，通过DRL实现自适应驾驶控制，利用LLM提供决策解释，在安全性、适应性和可解释性之间取得了平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动驾驶车辆虽然具有提高安全性和效率的潜力，但由于决策过程缺乏透明度，公众对其信任度仍然有限。为了解决这一问题，需要开发能够向乘客解释其行为决策的系统。

Method: 采用Dueling Double Deep Q-Network训练DRL智能体，实现快速、舒适和停车三种驾驶模式的切换；同时引入LLM模块来解释乘客请求、判断何时需要解释，并生成以安全为导向的简明理由。整个系统在仿真环境中进行训练和验证。

Result: DRL智能体展现出稳定的学习能力、对交通规则的安全遵守以及在单次行程中可靠的驾驶模式切换能力；当请求被延迟或因安全约束被覆盖时，该框架的LLM解释模块最为有效，成功平衡了安全性、适应性和可解释性。

Conclusion: 该框架作为整合强化学习决策和LLM的概念验证，证明了将RL决策与语言模型结合用于自动驾驶的可行性，为提高自动驾驶系统的透明度和公众信任度提供了新的技术路径。

Abstract: Autonomous vehicles offer the potential for safer and more efficient mobility, yet public trust remains limited due to the lack of transparency in their decision-making. This work addresses this issue by combining deep reinforcement learning (DRL) for adaptive driving control with large language model (LLM)-based explainability modules designed to communicate agent behavior to passengers. DRL agents were trained in simulation using a Dueling Double Deep Q-Network to follow distinct driving requests: \textit{fast}, \textit{comfort}, and \textit{stop}. They demonstrated stable learning, safe compliance with traffic rules, and reliable switching between modes within a single trip. In parallel, LLM modules were introduced to interpret passenger requests, determine when explanations were needed, and generate concise, safety-oriented justifications. Results show that this framework, serving as a proof of concept for integrating RL decision-making and LLMs, balances safety, adaptability, and explainability, and is most effective when requests are delayed or overridden due to safety constraints.

</details>


### [390] [Negative Knowledge as Failure-aware Shared Memory for AutoResearch](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21024)
*Hanchun Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种负面知识记忆层，通过将AI辅助研究中的失败尝试转化为结构化记录，显著提升了科学研究任务的解决效率和跨任务泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI辅助研究系统在探索过程中会产生大量失败尝试，但这些失败经验往往未被有效保存和利用，未能转化为可共享的持久知识资产。作者认为结构化的负面知识（失败经验）应作为科学记忆的重要组成部分，与正面发现共同构成科学研究的集体基础设施。

Method: 提出负面知识记忆层框架，包含两个核心组件：(1) 管理智能体，负责将每次失败尝试转化为有界、类型化的记录并存储于共享知识库；(2) 下游研究智能体，在提出新实验前显式地采纳或拒绝知识库中的负面记录。该层可集成到AutoResearch流程中。

Result: 在ScienceAgentBench同任务重试和两个非线性数学-物理PDE问题的跨任务研究中，负面知识层在减少token使用量的同时超越了标准AutoResearch基线。在PDE系统研究中，配备负面知识库的智能体成功解决了所有基线均失败的新任务。此外，已有负面知识库可迁移至不同PDE问题并增强AutoResearch性能。

Conclusion: 结构化负面知识是一种应被显式维护的知识资产，其在AI驱动的科学研究中不应仅被视为记忆压缩或调试辅助工具，而应与正面发现并存，作为科学记忆的集体基础设施的重要组成部分。

Abstract: AI-assisted research systems generate many failed attempts, but those failures rarely become a durable, shared knowledge asset. We propose a negative knowledge memory layer: a curator agent converts each failed attempt into a bounded, typed record in a shared bank, and a downstream research agent explicitly adopts or rejects those records before proposing its next experiment. We evaluate this layer in two settings: same-task retry on ScienceAgentBench and cross-task scientific research on two nonlinear math-physics PDE problems. The negative knowledge layer outperforms vanilla AutoResearch baselines while using fewer tokens; agents with the negative knowledge bank solve new tasks that all baselines fail to solve in PDE systems research. We also show that the previous negative knowledge bank can transfer and enhance AutoResearch on different PDE problems. These results suggest that structured negative knowledge is a knowledge asset that should be explicitly maintained in broader AI-engaged scientific research beyond a memory-compression or debugging aid, alongside positive findings, as a collective infrastructure for scientific memory. Code is available at https://github.com/hch-wang/Negative_Knowledge.

</details>


### [391] [Hypothesis-Disciplined Multi-Agent Automated Formalization of Asymptotic Statistical Theory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20642)
*Tingzhou Wei,Zeyu Zheng,Ethan X. Fang,Junwei Lu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个基于假设约束的多智能体Lean 4形式化流水线，用于渐近统计理论的形式化，通过审计代理确保每个定理假设与源文本锚定，实现了参数与半参数模型渐近分布与效率核心定理的无公理、源忠实的形式化证明。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 渐近统计理论是AI辅助形式化中的挑战性领域：其核心结果混合了收敛性陈述、渐近展开、泛函分析与正则性条件，与现有Lean 4形式化基础设施存在较大鸿沟，亟需一套系统化方法来处理其复杂性并确保形式化过程的正确性。

Method: 提出假设约束的Lean 4形式化流水线，由协调七个专家角色（证明规划、骨架搭建、Mathlib侦察、证明构建、整合、独立审查、审计）的管理器组成。核心方法是假设约束审计：每个主定理假设和概念层字段必须锚定于源数学文本，作为Lean编码适配器证明其合理性，标记为源隐含，或作为不受支持的强化予以拒绝。

Result: 构建了渐近统计理论的系统化形式化，特别是参数和半参数模型的渐近分布与效率结果。所得Lean开发无公理且源忠实，核心定理经过Lean检查与人工审计，定理无关的基础设施与统计概念定义与特定定理组装相分离，代码已开源。

Conclusion: 通过假设约束的多智能体协作流程，成功弥合了渐近统计理论与Lean 4形式化基础设施间的差距，建立了高质量的形式化框架，为统计理论的机器验证提供了可行的方法论范例。

Abstract: Asymptotic statistical theory is a challenging domain for AI-assisted formalization: its central results mix convergence statements, asymptotic expansions, functional analysis, and regularity conditions that have a large gap from existing infrastructure in Lean 4 formalization. To address these challenges, we propose a hypothesis-disciplined Lean 4 formalization pipeline built from multiple agents: a manager that coordinates seven specialist roles for proof planning, skeleton scaffolding, Mathlib reconnaissance, proof construction, integration, independent review, and audit. The main methodological discipline is the hypothesis-disciplined audit, implemented by the Auditor agent: every main-theorem hypothesis and concept-layer field must be anchored in the source mathematical prose, justified as a Lean encoding adapter, marked as source-implied, or rejected as an unsupported strengthening. Using this workflow, we build a systematic formalization of asymptotic statistical theory, especially the parametric and semi-parametric models' asymptotic distribution and efficiency results. The resulting Lean development is axiom-clean and source-faithful, with Lean-checked and human-audited proofs of core parametric and semi-parametric theorems organized so that theorem-agnostic infrastructure and statistical concept definitions are separated from theorem-specific assembly. The formalization results are available at https://github.com/junwei-lu/Lean-Asymptotic-Statistical-Theory.

</details>


### [392] [Hallucination as Context Drift: Synchronization Protocols for Multi-Agent LLM Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21666)
*Carson Rodrigues*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 多智能体LLM系统中的幻觉问题常源于智能体间的上下文漂移（知识状态不一致）。本文提出CDS指标量化这种分歧，并设计SSVP协议通过周期性交换压缩状态摘要来同步上下文。实验表明，简单的全广播同步反而会增加34%的幻觉率，而SSVP在减少58% API调用的情况下有效降低了幻觉率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体LLM系统中频繁出现无法单纯用模型缺陷解释的幻觉输出。研究发现，这类失败的重要来源是上下文漂移（context drift）：协作智能体之间内部知识状态的分歧。当智能体对共享世界状态存在不匹配或过时的表示时，其联合推理会产生矛盾并表现为幻觉。现有方法缺乏对这种分布式知识不一致性的有效度量与干预机制。

Method: 提出Context Divergence Score (CDS)，一个轻量级标量度量，量化智能体对之间在空间、时间和任务维度上的知识状态差异。设计Shared State Verification Protocol (SSVP)，允许智能体周期性交换压缩的状态摘要，并在联合推理前标记高分歧条件。在两个领域（多智能体旅行和软件项目规划）使用Claude Haiku进行对照实验，比较无同步、全广播同步和SSVP三种条件。

Result: 在旅行领域实验(n=30/条件)中，朴素全广播同步导致幻觉率比无同步基线高34%(HR: 0.658 vs 0.492, p=0.0022, d=1.18)，即传播错误智能体状态的污染效应。SSVP避免了该问题，幻觉率为0.463(d=0.30)，显著低于全广播(p=0.0005, d=1.47)，且API调用减少58%。软件领域未复现污染效应，所有条件HR均低于0.2，确认该效应特定于错误共享信念会在评估维度间级联的任务。

Conclusion: 本研究将幻觉缓解重新定义为分布式系统问题，并确立上下文同步为多智能体LLM设计的一等公民原语。关键发现是：简单同步反而有害，需要智能化的状态验证机制；SSVP提供了低成本、有效的解决方案；污染效应具有任务特异性。这为多智能体系统的设计提供了新的理论基础和实践指导。

Abstract: Multi-agent LLM systems routinely produce hallucinated outputs that cannot be explained by model deficiencies alone. A significant class of these failures arises not from model incapacity but from context drift: the divergence of internal knowledge states between concurrent agents. When agents enter a collaborative task with mismatched or stale representations of shared world state, their joint reasoning produces contradictions that manifest as hallucination. We define the Context Divergence Score (CDS), a lightweight scalar metric quantifying knowledge-state discrepancy between agent pairs across spatial, temporal, and task dimensions, and propose the Shared State Verification Protocol (SSVP), which lets agents periodically exchange compressed state summaries and flag high-divergence conditions before joint reasoning. We evaluate SSVP across two domains (multi-agent travel and software project planning) using Claude Haiku. In controlled experiments (n=30 per condition, travel; n=10, software) across 8 scenarios, naive full-broadcast synchronization increases hallucination rate by 34% above the no-sync baseline (HR: 0.658 vs. 0.492, p=0.0022, d=1.18), a contamination effect from propagating erroneous agent states. SSVP avoids this failure mode while showing modest, consistent reduction (HR: 0.463, d=0.30) and achieves significantly lower hallucination than full-broadcast (p=0.0005, d=1.47) using 58% fewer API calls. The contamination effect does not replicate in the software domain, where all conditions converge to low HR (<0.2), confirming it is specific to tasks where one erroneous shared belief cascades across evaluation dimensions. Our results reframe hallucination mitigation as a distributed systems problem and establish context synchronization as a first-class primitive in multi-agent LLM design.

</details>


### [393] [SPARC: A Multi-Agent System for Electrical Circuit Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20643)
*Mushtari Sadia,Zhenning Yang,Umme Habiba Lamia,Nishat Shawrin,Ang Chen,Amrita Roy Chowdhury*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出了SPARC多智能体系统，通过基于物理的可执行仿真来回答电路图问题，准确率达83%，相比基线最高提升58%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电路图问答任务需要复杂的数学推理，这对多模态大语言模型来说仍然是一个具有挑战性的问题。

Method: 提出了SPARC多智能体系统，利用LLM智能体来合成、执行和分析基于物理的仿真程序，将推理过程建立在可执行的仿真基础上，从而从设计层面提高准确性和可靠性。

Result: 在电路图问答任务上达到83%的准确率，相比基线方法获得了高达58%的绝对性能提升，同时能够实现系统性的错误诊断。

Conclusion: 通过将推理过程建立在可执行的物理仿真基础上，SPARC系统有效地解决了多模态LLM在电路图问答任务中的推理挑战，显著提升了性能并增强了可解释性。

Abstract: Electrical circuit diagram QA tasks require complex mathematical reasoning, which remains challenging for multimodal LLMs. We present SPARC, a multi-agent system that answers questions over circuit diagrams by grounding reasoning in executable physics-based simulations. SPARC uses LLM agents to synthesize, execute, and analyze simulation programs, improving accuracy and reliability by design. It achieves 83% accuracy, with up to a 58% absolute improvement over baselines, while enabling systematic error diagnosis.

</details>


### [394] [Bridging Multi-Valued Heuristics and Dimensionality Reduction in Multi-Objective Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20644)
*Maya Wolff,Ariel Felner,Oren Salzman*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出L-NAMOA*_dr-mvh算法，首次解决了多值启发式与降维技术结合的正确性问题，实现了精确搜索并在部分基准测试中获得了超过10倍加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统多目标最短路径算法依赖单值启发式，无法捕捉Pareto前沿的权衡结构，导致搜索指导性弱。多值启发式虽然能更好地近似权衡关系，但与降维技术结合时会破坏排序不变性，导致搜索不正确且不完整。

Method: 首先提出理论基准算法NAMOA*_dr-mvh，通过强制启发式一致性恢复搜索正确性；然后提出主要贡献L-NAMOA*_dr-mvh算法，采用惰性乐观方法处理降维，通过动态检测和修复局部排序违规来保持正确性，仅需要可采纳的多值启发式。

Result: 在多个基准测试中，L-NAMOA*_dr-mvh算法匹配或超越现有最先进的多目标最短路径算法；在多值启发式提供额外指导转化为更强剪枝的实例中，实现了超过10倍的速度提升。

Conclusion: 成功建立了多值启发式与降维技术安全结合的理论框架，提出的L-NAMOA*_dr-mvh算法在保证精确性的前提下，充分利用了多值启发式的优势，显著提升了多目标最短路径问题的求解效率。

Abstract: Multi-objective shortest-path (MOSP) algorithms traditionally rely on single-valued heuristics (SVHs), which associate each state with a single admissible cost vector. While SVHs provide safe lower bounds, they fail to capture the trade-off structure of the Pareto frontier and often yield weak search guidance. Multi-valued heuristics (MVHs) address this limitation by mapping states to sets of cost estimates, enabling a richer approximation of possible trade-offs. Modern MOSP algorithms are highly dependent on dimensionality reduction (DR) techniques to efficiently perform dominance checks. However, integrating MVHs with DR introduces subtle correctness challenges. We show that naively combining DR with MVHs destroys the ordering invariants required for DR, leading to unsound and incomplete search. To address this issue, we develop the first theoretical frameworks for safely integrating MVHs with DR. First, we introduce $\text{NAMOA}^*{\text{dr}\text{-}\text{mvh}}$, a theoretical baseline that restores search correctness by enforcing heuristic consistency. Recognizing the practical limitations of this approach, we then introduce our primary contribution, $\text{L}\text{-}\text{NAMOA}^*{\text{dr}\text{-}\text{mvh}}$. This algorithm employs a "lazy," optimistic approach to DR, preserving exact correctness with only an admissible MVH by dynamically detecting and repairing local ordering violations. Across a range of benchmarks, $\text{L}\text{-}\text{NAMOA}^*{\text{dr}\text{-}\text{mvh}}$ matches or improves over state-of-the-art MOSP algorithms, and achieves speedups of over 10x in instances where the additional guidance provided by the MVH translates into stronger pruning.

</details>


### [395] [Closed-loop Auto Research for Molecular Property Prediction: Discovering and Certifying Generalizable Improvements](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.22731)
*Jingjie Ning,Xiaochuan Li,Ji Zeng,Chenyan Xiong,Guolin Ke*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本研究探索了闭环自动研究系统在分子性质预测中的效果，发现三个研究轴（特征、模型、外部证据）的改进在不同基准测试中表现不同，模型搜索在验证集上的收益在测试集上大幅下降，而外部数据的引入需要污染过滤才能实现正向迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 闭环自动研究将自动机器学习从固定数据集拟合扩展到动态研究工作流，但需要验证这种扩展的行动空间（特征、模型、外部证据）所产生的改进是否能泛化到验证信号之外。分子性质预测涵盖许多小终点，为研究这一问题提供了合适场景。

Method: 在三个基准套件的36个终点上进行文件级消融锁定，将每个收益归因于单一研究轴；采用路由管道为每个终点选择最佳验证轴；设置污染过滤机制拒绝与测试集重叠64-89%的同源文件；与匹配试验的自动机器学习控制和8400万参数预训练3D模型进行对比。

Result: 路由管道在三个基准套件上分别获得0.013、0.011和0.042的保留测试集正向收益，但可迁移轴因套件而异；最大模型搜索收益从验证集0.041降至测试集0.003，外部数据在测试集上出现负收益-0.019；经过污染过滤的外部数据使CYP2C9底物性能提升0.17，半衰期提升0.08；自动机器学习控制仅达0.006对比代理的0.042。

Conclusion: 将发现与保留认证分离是任何优化代理量的闭环系统的领域无关教训，验证信号不能保证向保留量的迁移，需要专门的污染过滤机制和恰当的研究轴选择。

Abstract: Closed-loop Auto Research extends automated machine learning from fixed-dataset fitting to changing the research workflow, with language-model agents editing representations and model code and acquiring external evidence. Molecular property prediction spans many small endpoints. We ask whether this action space yields improvements generalizing beyond the validation signal selecting them.
  We isolate three Auto Research axes, features, models, and external evidence, under a file-level ablation lock attributing each gain to one axis over a strong baseline. Across 36 endpoints in three benchmark suites we score each selected configuration once on a held-out test whose labels the search never read. A routed pipeline taking each endpoint's best validation axis reaches positive held-out gains of 0.013, 0.011, and 0.042, the transferable axis differing by suite, data on TDC, model on Polaris, feature and model on MoleculeNet. The largest model-search gain falls from 0.041 on validation to 0.003 on test, while curated data reaches 0.022 but negative 0.019 on test, two non-transfer signatures. Curated external data raises held-out CYP2C9-substrate performance by 0.17 and half-life by 0.08, admitted through a contamination filter rejecting same-source files overlapping 64 to 89 percent of test structures, necessary but not sufficient for transfer. A matched-trial automated machine learning control did not reproduce the agent's code-level model intervention, reaching 0.006 against 0.042, and the pipeline stays competitive with an 84M-parameter pretrained 3D model on the shared training split.
  The experiments stay within molecular property prediction, but separating discovery from held-out certification is a domain-agnostic lesson for any closed-loop system optimising a proxy for a held-out quantity.

</details>


### [396] [Learning Splitting Heuristics for Parallel String Solvers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20656)
*Chenhao Gao,Peisen Yao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种数据驱动的方法来自动生成字符串约束求解器的分裂启发式算法，通过将分裂原子的选择建模为学习任务，在Z3seq和Z3str4中实现并验证了其优于手动设计的启发式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 字符串约束求解器对推理字符串操作程序至关重要，但许多实际字符串约束是不可判定的，且实际应用中的复杂约束对当前求解器构成挑战。虽然多核架构为并行求解提供了机会，但立方体-征服方法中分裂启发式的质量对有效划分搜索空间至关重要，而手动设计启发式不仅耗时且往往次优。

Method: 将选择分裂原子的问题建模为学习任务，利用输入公式的特征和求解器执行的动态数据，采用数据驱动方法自动生成分裂启发式算法，并在两个流行的字符串求解器Z3seq和Z3str4中实现该方法。

Result: 学习到的启发式算法在求解公式数量和平均求解时间方面均优于手动设计的启发式算法，证明了该方法的有效性。

Conclusion: 数据驱动方法能够自动生成高质量的分裂启发式，有效提升了并行字符串约束求解器的性能，为解决复杂约束问题提供了新的技术途径。

Abstract: String constraint solvers are crucial for reasoning about string-manipulating programs. However, many practical string constraints are undecidable, and real-world applications often present complex constraints that challenge current solvers. The rise of multi-core architectures offers an opportunity for parallel solving. A key parallel solving method is \emph{cube-and-conquer}, in which the quality of splitting heuristics is critical to effectively dividing the search space. Unfortunately, manually designing the heuristics is labor-intensive, and handcrafted heuristics are often sub-optimal. This paper introduces a data-driven approach to automatically generating splitting heuristics. We frame the problem of selecting a splitting atom as a learning task, using features from input formulas and dynamic data from solver execution. We implement this approach in two popular string solvers, Z3seq and Z3str4, demonstrating that the learned heuristics outperform manually designed ones in the number of solved formulas and the average solving time.

</details>


### [397] [RaMem: Contextual Reinstatement for Long-term Agentic Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.22844)
*Wei Yang,Bryce Kan,Shixuan Li,Li Li,Yuehan Qin,Jiate Li,Paul Bogdan,Jesse Thomason*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了RaMem框架，通过四个阶段解决LLM代理长期记忆中的“上下文坍塌”问题，在多个基准上实现了超过10%的平均F1提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有长期记忆系统虽能持久化和压缩过去经验，但仅靠检索无法确保记忆为当前查询提供有效证据。当经验被压缩为可复用片段时，来自不同情境的记忆若涉及重复实体或用户状态，可能显得同等相关，导致上下文坍塌：记忆丧失判断其有效性的周围上下文。

Method: 提出RaMem框架，包含四个协调阶段：(i) 证据锚定：将每条记忆锚定于其原始情景条件（如事件时间、提及时间、会话跨度、参与者）；(ii) 回忆条件归纳：从查询中推导隐含的证据条件；(iii) 感知有效性的检索：利用这些条件优先检索上下文兼容的记忆，同时保留内容相关的候选作为后备证据；(iv) 上下文保留合成：在生成器中保持所选记忆的结构化上下文可用。

Result: 在长期记忆基准测试上的实验表明，RaMem在多个主干网络上持续优于强记忆基线，平均F1提升超过10%。

Conclusion: RaMem有效缓解了上下文坍塌问题，将检索到的记忆片段转化为上下文可验证的证据，显著提升了LLM代理在长期交互和演进任务语境中的性能。

Abstract: Long-term memory has become increasingly important for LLM agents that operate across extended interactions and evolving task contexts. Recent memory systems have made past experiences more persistent, compact, and retrievable, but retrieval alone does not ensure that a memory provides valid evidence for the current query. When experiences are compressed into reusable fragments, memories from different situations may appear equally relevant if they involve recurring entities or user states. We refer to this failure as context collapse: memories lose the surrounding context needed to judge whether they provide valid evidence for the current query. To address this problem, we propose Contextual Reinstatement for Agentic Memory (RaMem), a framework that turns retrieved memory fragments into contextually verifiable evidence. RaMem operates through four coordinated stages: (i) evidence anchoring grounds each memory in its original episodic conditions, especially event time, mention time, session span, and participants; (ii) recall condition induction derives the evidence conditions implied by the query; (iii) validity-aware retrieval uses these conditions to prioritize context-compatible memories while retaining content-relevant candidates as fallback evidence; and (iv) context-preserved synthesis keeps the selected memories' structured context available to the generator. Experiments on long-term memory benchmarks show that RaMem consistently improves performance over strong memory baselines, with average F1 gains of more than 10% across several backbones.

</details>


### [398] [A-Evolve-Training: Autonomous Post-Training of a 30B Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20657)
*Zhan Shi,Bing He,Yisi Sang,Hanqing Lu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文报告了一个完全自主的后训练系统，成功对300亿参数的Nemotron模型进行多轮优化，在公开榜单上达到接近人类顶级提交的性能（0.86 vs 0.87），排名第8/4000，这是首个公开报道的大规模自主后训练案例，系统甚至能自主检测到内部指标的失效并调整搜索策略，展现了超越单纯优化的发现能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前沿模型的后训练通常需要数周的人工工作，包括提议数据和配方变更、启动运行、阅读评估、决策保留内容等。作者希望构建一个完全自主的系统来执行这个闭环，验证自主系统是否能在前沿模型的后训练规模上实现有效的自我改进，探索自动化机器学习研究的边界。

Method: 开发了一个完全自主的后训练系统，在无需人类干预的情况下，对300亿参数的Nemotron模型进行跨越数周的四个轮次的后训练。系统自主完成数据提议、配置调整、运行监控、评估分析和决策的完整闭环。当系统检测到开发集指标不再追踪外部性能时，能够自主修改搜索策略，不再最大化已失效的代理指标，转而寻求能提升外部目标的方法。系统还在120B和550B规模的Nemotron上进行了验证。

Result: 自主训练的300亿参数模型在NVIDIA Nemotron-Reasoning Challenge公开排行榜上取得0.86的分数，接近人类顶级提交的0.87，在约4000个参赛者中排名第8。更重要的是，系统展示了发现能力：当检测到最弱领域的开发集指标失效（候选模型在开发集上达到新高但外部目标未改善）时，自主修订搜索策略。这是首个公开报道的大规模自主后训练运行（此前公开的自主ML研究演示仅在GPT-2级别，约124M参数）。系统也成功完成了120B和550B模型的后训练，证明基础设施可在该规模闭环运行。
